AngularGaugeChart A complete angular gauge chart visualization that composes ChartHeader, ChartLegend, a standalone DataDisplay, AngularGaugeGroup (diverging arc + needle), and ChartFooter into a cohesive chart layout. @jds4/oneui-datavis @jds4/oneui-datavis/components/charts/AngularGaugeChart # AngularGaugeChart ## Overview A complete angular gauge chart visualization that composes ChartHeader, ChartLegend, a standalone DataDisplay, AngularGaugeGroup (diverging arc + needle), and ChartFooter into a cohesive chart layout. All design tokens resolve from the live CSS cascade — no runtime JS token resolver, no `modes` prop. DataVis palette tokens (`--DataVis-DivergingSemantic-N`, `--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-{n}`) are supplied by `generateDataVisCSS → useStyleInjection`; surface/typography tokens by the brand CSS engine. **Features:** - Full chart layout: title, subtitle, legend, standalone DataDisplay, gauge arc, and source/notes - D3-powered semicircular arc with 11 diverging semantic color segments (step mode) or smooth gradient (blend mode) - Standalone DataDisplay for summary values above the gauge; separate center DataDisplay inside the gauge - `data[0].value` drives the gauge needle; additional points auto-generate tick values and legend items - `fullWidth` prop stretches the container to 100% of its parent - ARIA live region announces hovered segments to screen readers - Full keyboard navigation via `useRovingTabIndex` inside `AngularGaugeGroup` ## Figma Reference - **Node ID**: `767:4884` - **Figma URL**: https://www.figma.com/design/uA5ExvS0cNXbDEKzT9Rnrt/DataVis-Components?node-id=767-4884 ## Architecture ``` AngularGaugeChart ├── ChartAccessibility (wrapper — role="figure", live region, hidden data table) │ ├── ChartHeader (title + subtitle) │ ├── ChartLegend (categorical legend, up to 6 items) │ ├── DataDisplay (standalone, above the gauge) │ ├── AngularGaugeGroup (gauge arcs · needle · ticks · center DataDisplay) │ └── ChartFooter (source + notes) ``` Token supply: ``` Convex (dataVisPalettes) → generateDataVisCSS → useStyleInjection → --DataVis-Categorical-Bold-{n} (legend colors) → --DataVis-DivergingSemantic-{n} (arc segment fills, inside AngularGaugeGroup) Brand CSS engine (useBrandCSSNew) → --Spacing-5 (container gap via two-layer pattern) → --Label-*, --Body-*, --Text-* (typography) ``` ## Import ```tsx import { AngularGaugeChart } from '@oneui/datavis'; // or from the package barrel: import { AngularGaugeChart } from '@oneui/datavis/AngularGaugeChart'; ``` ## Data Format `data` accepts `ChartDataPoint[]`: ```typescript interface ChartDataPoint { category: string; // Label for the data point value: number; // The value (data[0].value → gauge needle) color?: string; // Optional color override for legend item colorIndex?: number; } const data: ChartDataPoint[] = [{ category: 'Score', value: 0.72 }]; ``` The **first** data point's `value` drives the gauge needle, overriding `gaugeGroupConfig.value`. Additional points auto-generate tick positions (`tickValues`) and legend items when no explicit config is provided. ## Props ### Parent Props | Prop | Type | Default | Description | | ------------------- | --------------------- | ---------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------- | | `data` | `ChartDataPoint[]` | `[]` | Chart data — `data[0].value` drives the gauge needle | | `width` | `number \| string` | `420` | Width of the chart container | | `height` | `number \| string` | `"auto"` | Height of the chart container | | `fullWidth` | `boolean` | `false` | Stretch container to 100% of parent width; overrides `width` | | `chartHeader` | `boolean` | `true` | Show the chart header (title + subtitle) | | `chartFooter` | `boolean` | `true` | Show the chart footer (source + notes) | | `chartLegend` | `boolean` | `false` | Show the categorical legend | | `dataDisplay` | `boolean` | `false` | Show the standalone DataDisplay above the gauge | | `animated` | `boolean` | `false` | Entry animation on mount via motion tokens | | `accessibility` | `AccessibilityConfig` | — | Screen reader configuration | ### Child Config Props | Prop | Type | Description | | ------------------- | ---------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------- | | `chartHeaderConfig` | `ChartHeaderConfig` | `{ chartTitleValue, chartSubtitleValue, subtitle }` | | `chartLegendConfig` | `ChartLegendConfig` | `{ items, categoryLabelValue, type }` | | `dataDisplayConfig` | `AngularGaugeChartDataDisplayConfig` | Full `DataDisplay` API minus `id` | | `gaugeGroupConfig` | `GaugeGroupConfig` | `AngularGaugeGroup` configuration (see below) | | `chartFooterConfig` | `ChartFooterConfig` | `{ annotationLeftValue, annotationRightValue }` | ### GaugeGroupConfig | Property | Type | Default | Description | | ---------------------------- | --------------------------------------- | --------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------ | | `value` | `number` | `0.5` | Fallback needle value (overridden by `data[0].value`) | | `min` | `number` | `0` | Minimum scale value | | `max` | `number` | `1` | Maximum scale value | | `numberOfSteps` | `number` | `5` | Steps per side of neutral (1–5). Total segments = 2n + 1 | | `tickValues` | `(string \| number)[]` | 3 evenly spaced | Explicit arc tick label positions | | `showGaugeTicks` | `boolean` | `true` | Show tick labels along the arc | | `showEndpointTicks` | `boolean` | `true` | Show non-rotating endpoint ticks at min/max | | `endpointTickValues` | `[string \| number, string \| number]` | auto | Custom labels for min/max endpoint ticks | | `showDataDisplay` | `boolean` | `true` | Show the center DataDisplay inside the gauge | | `showSupportingLabelsTop` | `boolean` | `false` | Show top supporting label row | | `showSupportingLabelsBottom` | `boolean` | `false` | Show bottom supporting label row | | `arcWidth` | `"auto" \| "XS" \| "S" \| "M" \| "L" \| "XL" \| "2XL"` | `"auto"` | Arc thickness | | `type` | `"step" \| "blend"` | `"step"` | Discrete segments or smooth gradient arc | | `valueFormat` | `ValueFormatConfig` | — | Auto-format numeric tick labels | | `interactive` | `boolean` | `true` | Enable hover/focus/keyboard interactivity on segments | | `onSegmentHover` | `(data: GaugeSegmentHoverData) => void` | — | Callback on segment hover/focus change | | `dataDisplayConfig` | `GaugeDataDisplayConfig` | — | Center DataDisplay inside the gauge | | `supportingLabelsTop` | `SupportingLabelsConfig` | — | Top supporting label row config | | `supportingLabelsBottom` | `SupportingLabelsConfig` | — | Bottom supporting label row config | ### AccessibilityConfig | Property | Type | Default | Description | | ----------- | --------- | ------- | ---------------------------------------- | | `enabled` | `boolean` | `true` | Enable the accessibility wrapper | | `summary` | `string` | auto | Custom summary (overrides auto-generate) | | `dataTable` | `boolean` | `true` | Hidden data table for screen readers | | `ariaLabel` | `string` | — | Custom aria-label override | ## Usage Examples ### Minimal gauge ```tsx import { AngularGaugeChart } from '@oneui/datavis'; ``` ### With header and footer ```tsx ``` ### Full layout (all sections) ```tsx ``` ### Custom scale (NPS −100 to +100) ```tsx ``` ### Blend mode (smooth gradient) ```tsx ``` ### Full width ```tsx ``` ### Dark mode ```tsx
``` Setting `data-theme="dark"` on any ancestor switches all CSS cascade tokens to dark-mode values automatically — no prop change required. ### With supporting labels ```tsx ``` ### Segment hover callback ```tsx { console.log(data.segmentLabel, data.isHovered); }, dataDisplayConfig: { mainLabelValue: 'Score', dataHead: { dataLeadValue: '72%' }, }, }} /> ``` ## Design Tokens All tokens resolve from the CSS cascade — no runtime JS token resolver. | Token | Source | Usage | | ---------------------------------- | --------------------------- | --------------------------- | | `--AngularGaugeChart-containerGap` | Component override hook | Container gap (two-layer) | | `--Spacing-5` | Brand CSS engine | Container gap fallback | | `--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-{n}` | generateDataVisCSS | Legend item colors | | `--DataVis-DivergingSemantic-{n}` | generateDataVisCSS | Arc segment fills | | `--Label-*`, `--Body-*` | Brand CSS engine | Typography in all sub-components | ## Legend Resolution Legend items resolve in priority order: 1. **Explicit items** — `chartLegendConfig.items` takes highest priority 2. **Label shortcut** — `chartLegendConfig.categoryLabelValue` creates one entry using `--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-1` 3. **Auto-generated** — each `data` point becomes a legend entry (up to 6), using `data[i].color ?? var(--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-{i+1})` ## Tick Value Resolution Tick positions resolve in priority order: 1. **Explicit** — `gaugeGroupConfig.tickValues` 2. **Data-driven** — `data[1..N].value` (when `data.length > 1` and no explicit `tickValues`) 3. **Default** — `AngularGaugeGroup` renders 3 evenly spaced ticks at 25%, 50%, 75% of the range Endpoint ticks at min/max resolve separately: 1. **Explicit** — `gaugeGroupConfig.endpointTickValues` 2. **Auto-derived** — formatted from `min`/`max` using `valueFormat` (or raw numeric display) ## Accessibility - `ChartAccessibility` wraps all content in `role="figure"` with a generated or custom `aria-label` - `ChartAccessibility` renders a visually-hidden `` for screen reader data access - The ARIA live region (via `useChartAccessibility`) announces hovered segments: `"Negative 3 zone, segment 3 of 11"` - Arc segments use `useRovingTabIndex`: **Tab** enters the group; **ArrowLeft/ArrowRight** moves between segments; **Home/End** jumps to first/last ## Files | File | Description | | --------------------------------- | ----------------------------- | | `AngularGaugeChart.tsx` | Component implementation | | `AngularGaugeChart.module.css` | Structural CSS (container gap) | | `index.ts` | Named exports | | `AngularGaugeChart.stories.tsx` | Storybook documentation | | `AngularGaugeChart.test.tsx` | Unit tests | | `AngularGaugeChart.md` | This documentation | ## Related - [`AngularGaugeGroup`](../../groups/AngularGaugeGroup/AngularGaugeGroup.md) — the core gauge arc component - [`ChartHeader`](../../groups/ChartHeader/ChartHeader.md) - [`ChartLegend`](../../groups/ChartLegend/ChartLegend.md) - [`DataDisplay`](../../groups/DataDisplay/DataDisplay.md) - [`ChartFooter`](../../groups/ChartFooter/ChartFooter.md) - [`ChartAccessibility`](../../ChartAccessibility.tsx)

title: AreaChart
AreaHeatMapChart
text:
AreaHeatMapChart
A complete heatmap chart component that combines ChartHeader, SequentialChartKey or DivergingChartKey (legend), DataDisplay, AreaHeatMapGroup (heatmap grid), and ChartFooter. Supports both sequential and diverging color schemes with automatic detection from data.
@jds4/oneui-datavis
@jds4/oneui-datavis/components/charts/AreaHeatMapChart
# AreaHeatMapChart

## Overview

A complete heatmap chart component that combines ChartHeader, SequentialChartKey or DivergingChartKey (legend), DataDisplay, AreaHeatMapGroup (heatmap grid), and ChartFooter. Supports both sequential and diverging color schemes with automatic detection from data.

**This component follows the [Organized Props Pattern](./OrganizedPropsPattern.md).**

**Features:**

- Complete chart wrapper with header, legend, data display, heatmap, and footer
- Sequential and diverging color legends synchronized with heatmap colors
- **Auto colour detection**: automatically switches to diverging when data contains negative values
- Manual `colourType` override for explicit control
- **High values → dark colors**, low values → light colors (matching legend)
- Automatic min/max value derivation for legend labels
- **Handles duplicate row/column labels** (e.g., "T" for Tuesday/Thursday)
- Axis labels are centered with their corresponding rows/columns
- Full design token integration for responsive theming
- Interactive hover with optional HoverBadge or DataDisplay
- DataDisplay supports static values or dynamic hover-driven updates
- **Data transition animation**: smooth cross-fade when switching datasets via `animated` prop
- **Indicator tracker**: optional circle on chart key gradient bar showing the hovered cell's value position
- Accessibility: roving tab index, 2D keyboard navigation, ARIA live region, `aria-controls` linking to DataDisplay

## Figma Reference

- **Node ID**: `240:9565`
- **Design File**: DataVis-Components
- **Figma URL**: https://www.figma.com/design/uA5ExvS0cNXbDEKzT9Rnrt/DataVis-Components?node-id=240-9565

## Architecture

```
AreaHeatMapChart (Organized Props Pattern)
├── Layer 2 – Parent Props
│   ├── chartHeader          → boolean toggle
│   ├── sequentialChartKey   → boolean toggle (controls both key types)
│   ├── chartFooter          → boolean toggle
│   ├── dataDisplay          → boolean toggle
│   ├── colourType           → "sequential" | "diverging" (manual override)
│   ├── autoColourDetection  → boolean (default true)
│   ├── animated             → boolean (default false)
│   ├── fullWidth            → boolean (stretch to container width)
│   ├── interactive, colorLevels, sequentialColorSet, ...
│   └── data, width, height
└── Layer 3 – Child Configs
    ├── chartHeaderConfig         → ChartHeaderConfig
    ├── sequentialChartKeyConfig  → SequentialChartKeyConfig
    ├── divergingChartKeyConfig   → DivergingChartKeyConfig
    ├── dataDisplayConfig         → DataDisplayConfig (mirrors DataDisplayProps)
    ├── heatmapGroupConfig        → AreaHeatMapGroupConfig
    └── chartFooterConfig         → ChartFooterConfig
```

### Component Tree

```
AreaHeatMapChart
├── ChartAccessibility (wrapper)
│   └── Container
│       ├── ChartHeader (optional, chartHeader=true)
│       │   ├── ChartTitle
│       │   └── ChartSubtitle
│       ├── SequentialChartKey (when colourType="sequential", sequentialChartKey=true)
│       │   ├── mainLabel (inline typography tokens)
│       │   ├── Gradient bar (9 color segments)
│       │   │   └── indicatorTracker (optional, hover-driven)
│       │   └── XAxis (Low/High labels)
│       ├── DivergingChartKey (when colourType="diverging", sequentialChartKey=true)
│       │   ├── mainLabel (inline typography tokens)
│       │   ├── Gradient bar (diverging segments)
│       │   │   └── indicatorTracker (optional, hover-driven)
│       │   └── XAxis (tick value labels)
│       ├── DataDisplay (optional, dataDisplay=true)
│       │   ├── contentLeft
│       │   │   ├── mainLabel (inline typography + optional InfoIcon)
│       │   │   └── DataHead (DataLead + SupportingData + SupportingLabel)
│       │   └── contentRight (DataBadgeSemantic)
│       ├── AreaHeatMapGroup
│       │   ├── YAxis (row labels, aria-hidden="true")
│       │   └── Visual Container
│       │       ├── Rows Container (role="group", aria-label="Chart data")
│       │       │   └── Cell[] (role="button", data-roving-item, aria-roledescription="data point")
│       │       └── XAxis (column labels, aria-hidden="true")
│       └── ChartFooter (optional, chartFooter=true)
│           ├── Source text
│           └── Notes text
```

## Import

```tsx
import { AreaHeatMapChart } from '@oneui/datavis';
import type { AreaHeatMapChartProps } from '@oneui/datavis';
```

## Data Formats

### Canonical Format (Recommended)

```typescript
import type { ChartSeriesDataPoint } from '@oneui/datavis';

// series = row (Y-axis), category = column (X-axis)
const data: ChartSeriesDataPoint[] = [
  { category: "12am", series: "M", value: 3 },
  { category: "2", series: "M", value: 2 },
  { category: "4", series: "M", value: 6 },
  // ...
];
```

## Props Interface (Organized Props Pattern)

```typescript
interface AreaHeatMapChartProps {
  // Layer 2: Parent Props
  data: ChartSeriesDataPoint[] | HeatMapDataPoint[];
  width?: number | string;
  height?: number | string;
  fullWidth?: boolean;           // Stretch to container width (default: false)
  chartHeader?: boolean;         // Toggle ChartHeader (default: true)
  sequentialChartKey?: boolean;  // Toggle SequentialChartKey (default: true)
  chartFooter?: boolean;         // Toggle ChartFooter (default: true)
  dataDisplay?: boolean;         // Toggle DataDisplay (default: false)
  interactive?: boolean;         // Enable hover/click (default: true)
  animated?: boolean;            // Entry wave + data-change transition (default: false)
  colorLevels?: number;          // Intensity levels 1–9 (default: 9)
  sequentialColorSet?: 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6; // Color palette (default: 1)
  colourType?: 'sequential' | 'diverging'; // Manual colour scheme override
  autoColourDetection?: boolean; // Auto-detect from data (default: true)
  valueFormat?: ValueFormatConfig; // Format for hover badge, hover-mode DataDisplay, ARIA live text

  // Layer 3: Child Configs
  chartHeaderConfig?: ChartHeaderConfig;
  sequentialChartKeyConfig?: SequentialChartKeyConfig;
  divergingChartKeyConfig?: DivergingChartKeyConfig;
  dataDisplayConfig?: DataDisplayConfig;
  heatmapGroupConfig?: AreaHeatMapGroupConfig;
  chartFooterConfig?: ChartFooterConfig;

  // Accessibility
  accessibility?: AccessibilityConfig;
}
```

## Props

### Layer 2: Parent Props

| Prop                  | Type                                           | Default | Description                                                                     |
| --------------------- | ---------------------------------------------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `data`                | `ChartSeriesDataPoint[] \| HeatMapDataPoint[]` | `[]`    | Chart data (canonical or legacy format)                                         |
| `width`               | `number \| string`                             | `346`   | Total chart width                                                               |
| `height`              | `number \| string`                             | `500`   | **Total height of the chart.** HeatMapGroup fills remaining space.              |
| `fullWidth`           | `boolean`                                      | `false` | Stretch chart to fill parent container width                                    |
| `chartHeader`         | `boolean`                                      | `true`  | Toggle chart header                                                             |
| `sequentialChartKey`  | `boolean`                                      | `true`  | Toggle chart key legend (renders sequential or diverging based on `colourType`) |
| `chartFooter`         | `boolean`                                      | `true`  | Toggle chart footer                                                             |
| `dataDisplay`         | `boolean`                                      | `false` | Toggle DataDisplay section                                                      |
| `interactive`         | `boolean`                                      | `true`  | Enable hover/click on cells                                                     |
| `animated`            | `boolean`                                      | `false` | Diagonal wave entry animation on mount + `background-color` cross-fade on data change |
| `colorLevels`         | `number`                                       | `9`     | Number of color intensity levels (1–9)                                          |
| `sequentialColorSet`  | `1–6`                                          | `1`     | Sequential color category to use                                                |
| `colourType`          | `"sequential" \| "diverging"`                  | —       | Manual colour scheme override. When set, overrides auto-detection.              |
| `autoColourDetection` | `boolean`                                      | `true`  | Auto-detect diverging when data contains negative values.                       |
| `valueFormat`         | `ValueFormatConfig`                            | `undefined` | Format for cell values in the hover badge, hover-mode DataDisplay lead value, and ARIA live text (when the corresponding `formatHoverLeadValue`/`formatHoverBadgeValue`/`hoverBadgeConfig.formatValue` isn't supplied). |

### Layer 3: Child Component Configs

#### `chartHeaderConfig`

| Prop                 | Type      | Default     | Description              |
| -------------------- | --------- | ----------- | ------------------------ |
| `chartTitleValue`    | `string`  | `undefined` | Chart title              |
| `chartSubtitleValue` | `string`  | `undefined` | Chart subtitle           |
| `subtitle`           | `boolean` | `true`      | Whether to show subtitle |

#### `sequentialChartKeyConfig`

| Prop                  | Type                  | Default    | Description                                                                 |
| --------------------- | --------------------- | ---------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `mainLabel`           | `boolean`             | `true`     | Toggle label above gradient                                                 |
| `mainLabelValue`      | `string`              | `""`       | Legend label text                                                           |
| `lowestDataValue`     | `string \| number`    | (data min) | Low (left) tick. Defaults to data-derived minimum when omitted.             |
| `highestDataValue`    | `string \| number`    | (data max) | High (right) tick. Defaults to data-derived maximum when omitted.           |
| `barHeight`           | `number`              | `8`        | Height of gradient bar in pixels                                            |
| `type`                | `"step" \| "blend"`   | `"step"`   | Discrete color segments or smooth gradient                                  |
| `numberFormatOptions` | `NumberFormatOptions` | -          | Formatting options for numeric tick values                                  |
| `valueFormat`         | `ValueFormatConfig`   | -          | Structured format config for numeric tick values — overrides `numberFormatOptions` when set |
| `indicatorTracker`    | `boolean`             | `false`    | Toggle indicator circle on the gradient bar (requires `interactive={true}`) |

#### `divergingChartKeyConfig`

| Prop                  | Type                   | Default                    | Description                                                                 |
| --------------------- | ---------------------- | -------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `mainLabel`           | `boolean`              | `true`                     | Toggle label above gradient                                                 |
| `mainLabelValue`      | `string`               | `""`                       | Legend label text                                                           |
| `tickValues`          | `(string \| number)[]` | `[min, 0, max]`            | Axis tick values (defaults to data range)                                   |
| `lowestDataValue`     | `string \| number`     | -                          | Override for the first tick value (replaces tickValues[0])                  |
| `highestDataValue`    | `string \| number`     | -                          | Override for the last tick value (replaces tickValues[last])                |
| `numberOfSteps`       | `number`               | derived from `colorLevels` | Color steps per side (1-5)                                                  |
| `barHeight`           | `number`               | `8`                        | Height of gradient bar in pixels                                            |
| `type`                | `"step" \| "blend"`    | `"step"`                   | Discrete color segments or smooth gradient                                  |
| `numberFormatOptions` | `NumberFormatOptions`  | -                          | Formatting options for numeric tick values                                  |
| `valueFormat`         | `ValueFormatConfig`    | -                          | Structured format config for numeric tick values — overrides `numberFormatOptions` when set |
| `indicatorTracker`    | `boolean`              | `false`                    | Toggle indicator circle on the gradient bar (requires `interactive={true}`) |

#### `heatmapGroupConfig`

| Prop                    | Type                           | Default     | Description                                                          |
| ----------------------- | ------------------------------ | ----------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `yAxis`                 | `boolean`                      | `true`      | Toggle Y-axis labels                                                 |
| `xAxis`                 | `boolean`                      | `true`      | Toggle X-axis labels                                                 |
| `hoverBadge`            | `boolean`                      | `false`     | Toggle DataBadge on hover                                            |
| `onCellHover`           | `(data) => void`               | —           | Cell hover callback                                                  |
| `onCellClick`           | `(data) => void`               | —           | Cell click callback                                                  |
| `yAxisConfig`           | `{ labels?: CategoryValue[] }` | `{}`        | Y-axis configuration (string, number, or Date labels)                |
| `xAxisConfig`           | `{ labels?: CategoryValue[] }` | `{}`        | X-axis configuration (string, number, or Date labels)                |
| `hoverBadgeConfig`      | `{ formatValue, formatBadge }` | `{}`        | HoverBadge formatting configuration                                  |
| `highlightedRowIndices` | `number[]`                     | `undefined` | External row highlight — dims all other rows; overrides hover highlight |

#### `chartFooterConfig`

| Prop                   | Type     | Default     | Description        |
| ---------------------- | -------- | ----------- | ------------------ |
| `annotationLeftValue`  | `string` | `undefined` | Source attribution |
| `annotationRightValue` | `string` | `undefined` | Additional notes   |

#### `dataDisplayConfig`

Mirrors the `DataDisplayProps` structure with additional chart-specific hover props.

**Chart-Specific Props:**

| Prop                    | Type                                                       | Default     | Description                                         |
| ----------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- | ----------- | --------------------------------------------------- |
| `mode`                  | `"static" \| "hover"`                                      | `"static"`  | Static uses provided values; hover updates on hover |
| `formatHoverLeadValue`  | `(value: number, row?: string, column?: string) => string` | `undefined` | Custom formatter for lead value in hover mode       |
| `formatHoverBadgeValue` | `(value: number, row?: string, column?: string) => string` | `undefined` | Custom formatter for badge value in hover mode      |

**DataDisplay Layer 2 Props:**

| Prop                       | Type                        | Default  | Description                                 |
| -------------------------- | --------------------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------- |
| `mainLabelValue`           | `string`                    | -        | Main label text above the data value        |
| `formatLabelText`          | `boolean`                   | `true`   | Auto-format label per Figma text rules      |
| `formatOptions`            | `FormatLabelOptions`        | -        | Options for label formatting                |
| `type`                     | `"Left" \| "Center"`        | `"Left"` | Layout type: horizontal or vertical stacked |
| `rightBadgeWrapper` | `boolean`                   | `true`   | Toggle rightBadgeWrapper section     |
| `badgeTop`                 | `boolean`                   | `false`  | Toggle badgeTop slot                        |
| `badgeBottom`              | `boolean`                   | `true`   | Toggle badgeBottom slot                     |
| `dataBadgeSemantic`        | `boolean`                   | `true`   | Toggle all DataBadgeSemantic instances      |
| `supportingBadgeLabel`     | `boolean`                   | `true`   | Toggle supporting label next to badge       |
| `supportingBadgeLabelValue`     | `string`                    | -        | Supporting label text next to badge         |
| `size`                | `"S" \| "M" \| "L" \| "XL"` | `"L"`    | Typography size variant                     |

**DataDisplay Layer 3 Configs:**

| Prop         | Type             | Description                                |
| ------------ | ---------------- | ------------------------------------------ |
| `dataHead`   | `DataHeadConfig` | Configuration for the DataHead child       |
| `badgeConfig`| `BadgeConfig`    | Configuration for the badge (value + semantic direction) |

### Accessibility Config (`accessibility`)

| Prop        | Type      | Default  | Description                                 |
| ----------- | --------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------- |
| `enabled`   | `boolean` | `true`   | Enable accessibility wrapper                |
| `summary`   | `string`  | `"auto"` | Custom summary or "auto" for auto-generated |
| `dataTable` | `boolean` | `true`   | Hidden data table for screen readers        |
| `ariaLabel` | `string`  | -        | Custom aria-label override                  |

### Theme / Brand

Theme, density, platform, and dark/light mode are injected globally by the `useBrandCSSNew` hook
and the OneUI CSS cascade — not via component props. Wrap the chart in a `<Surface>` if you need
a specific surface context; use `data-theme` / `data-density` on a parent element to control
density and dark mode.

## Usage Examples

### Basic Weekly Activity Heatmap

```tsx
import { AreaHeatMapChart } from '@oneui/datavis';
import type { ChartSeriesDataPoint } from '@oneui/datavis';

const days = ["M", "T", "W", "T", "F", "S", "S"];
const hours = ["12am", "2", "4", "6", "8", "10", "12pm", "2", "4", "6", "8", "10"];

const data: ChartSeriesDataPoint[] = [];
days.forEach((day) => {
  hours.forEach((hour) => {
    data.push({
      category: hour,
      series: day,
      value: Math.floor(Math.random() * 9) + 1,
    });
  });
});

function WeeklyActivityChart() {
  return (
    <AreaHeatMapChart
      data={data}
      width={346}
      height={448}
      chartHeaderConfig={{
        chartTitleValue: "Weekly Activity",
        chartSubtitleValue: "Hour-by-hour activity levels.",
      }}
      sequentialChartKeyConfig={{
        mainLabelValue: "Activity level",
        lowestDataValue: "Low",
        highestDataValue: "High",
      }}
      heatmapGroupConfig={{
        yAxisConfig: { labels: days },
        xAxisConfig: { labels: hours },
      }}
      chartFooterConfig={{
        annotationLeftValue: "Source: Analytics.",
        annotationRightValue: "Last 7 days.",
      }}
    />
  );
}
```

### With Numeric Legend Labels

```tsx
<AreaHeatMapChart
  data={salesData}
  sequentialChartKeyConfig={{
    mainLabelValue: "Revenue ($K)",
    lowestDataValue: 0,
    highestDataValue: 1000,
  }}
/>
```

### With Hover Badge and Click Handler

```tsx
<AreaHeatMapChart
  data={data}
  heatmapGroupConfig={{
    hoverBadge: true,
    hoverBadgeConfig: {
      formatValue: (value, row, column) => `${row} at ${column}: ${value}`,
    },
    onCellClick: (data) => {
      console.log(`Clicked: ${data.row} at ${data.column} = ${data.value}`);
    },
  }}
/>
```

### Full Width

```tsx
<AreaHeatMapChart data={data} fullWidth />
```

### Controlled Row Highlight

```tsx
const [activeDay, setActiveDay] = useState<string | null>(null);

<AreaHeatMapChart
  data={weeklyData}
  heatmapGroupConfig={{
    highlightedRowIndices: activeDay !== null ? [days.indexOf(activeDay)] : undefined,
  }}
/>
```

## Design Tokens Used

| Token                          | Purpose                               | Default                        |
| ------------------------------ | ------------------------------------- | ------------------------------ |
| `Dimensions/Spacings/5`        | Gap between chart sections            | 20px                           |
| `Dimensions/Spacings/2`        | Gap within sections                   | 8px                            |
| `sequential/category{1-6}/1-9` | Heatmap cell colors (sequential mode) | Orange scale                   |
| `diverginSemantic/negative1-5` | Diverging negative-side colors        | Red scale                      |
| `diverginSemantic/neutral`     | Diverging center color                | `#ebebec`                      |
| `diverginSemantic/positive1-5` | Diverging positive-side colors        | Green scale                    |
| `transitionAnimation.easing`   | Easing curve for data-change fade     | `cubic-bezier(0.5, 0, 0.3, 1)` |
| `transitionAnimation.duration` | Duration per fade phase               | `400ms`                        |

## Colour Type Detection

The chart supports two colour schemes: **sequential** (for positive-only data) and **diverging** (for data spanning negative and positive values). The resolved type controls which ChartKey is rendered and which palette the heatmap group uses.

**Resolution precedence:**

1. If `colourType` is explicitly set, that value is used (manual override).
2. If `autoColourDetection` is `true` (default) and the data contains any negative values, `"diverging"` is selected.
3. Otherwise `"sequential"` is used.

When diverging, the `DivergingChartKey` renders with `tickValues` defaulting to `[min, 0, max]` from the data, and the heatmap cells use `diverginSemantic/*` tokens centred on zero. The gradient bar and tick positions are **proportional to the data range** — if `|min| ≠ |max|`, the negative and positive sides have different widths and the zero tick sits at its true proportional position rather than the visual center.

## Legend

The `sequentialChartKey` boolean prop controls visibility of the legend regardless of colour type. In sequential mode, `SequentialChartKey` renders with data-derived min/max labels. In diverging mode, `DivergingChartKey` renders with data-derived tick values and a proportional bar layout (the negative and positive sides scale to the actual magnitudes of the data extremes). Both are configured through their respective `*Config` props.

Both key components receive `width="100%"` from `AreaHeatMapChart` so they stretch to match the chart container. Neither `SequentialChartKey` nor `DivergingChartKey` can infer the chart container width on their own — their standalone default is `"328px"`. Passing `width="100%"` is required for any chart shell that composes these components inside a fixed-width container.

## Animation

`animated={true}` activates two phases:

### Entry wave (mount)

On first render each cell fades in via a CSS `opacity` keyframe. Cells on the same anti-diagonal
animate together, producing a wave that travels from top-left to bottom-right:

```
delay = (rowIndex + columnIndex) × motionOffsetM
```

`animation-fill-mode: backwards` keeps cells invisible during their delay — no grey flash before
the wave reaches them, because the fill colour is written to every cell immediately on mount.

### Data-change transition

When `animated={true}` and the `data` prop changes, **heatmap tiles** perform a **cross-fade**: the CSS `background-color` transition smoothly interpolates from the old colour to the new colour in a single pass. There is no opacity flicker — React re-renders with new colours and the browser handles the interpolation using motion tokens (duration, easing).

**Chart key legends** also animate. The `animated` prop is passed to both `SequentialChartKey` and `DivergingChartKey`:

- **DivergingChartKey**: segment `flex` widths and tick `left` positions transition smoothly as the proportional layout adjusts to new data ranges. When data switches from mixed (spanning zero) to single-sign (all positive or all negative), segments on the absent side collapse (`flex: 0`, `opacity: 0`) and the zero tick fades out; both animate back in when the data returns to a mixed range. In blend mode, the gradient automatically narrows to only the active-side colors for single-sign data.
- **SequentialChartKey**: segment `background-color` transitions smoothly.

The animation tokens are resolved through the standard `useDataTransition` hook:

| Token                          | Purpose                  | Fallback                       |
| ------------------------------ | ------------------------ | ------------------------------ |
| `transitionAnimation.mode`     | Selects motion intensity | `"Moderate"`                   |
| `transitionAnimation.easing`   | Transition curve         | `cubic-bezier(0.5, 0, 0.3, 1)` |
| `transitionAnimation.duration` | Cross-fade duration      | `400ms`                        |

```tsx
<AreaHeatMapChart data={currentData} animated={true} />
```

## Height Behavior

The `height` prop controls the **total height** of the AreaHeatMapChart container. The AreaHeatMapGroup child component automatically stretches to fill the remaining vertical space after header, legend, DataDisplay, and footer are rendered.

### Layout Diagram

```
┌───────────────────────────────────────┐
│  ChartHeader (title + subtitle)       │  ← Auto height
├───────────────────────────────────────┤
│  SequentialChartKey (legend)          │  ← Auto height
├───────────────────────────────────────┤
│  DataDisplay (optional)               │  ← Auto height
├───────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                       │
│                                       │
│         AreaHeatMapGroup              │  ← flex: 1 (fills remaining)
│    (YAxis + Grid + XAxis)             │
│                                       │
│                                       │
├───────────────────────────────────────┤
│  ChartFooter (source + notes)         │  ← Auto height
└───────────────────────────────────────┘
        Total height: `height` prop
```

### How It Works

1. **Fixed Container**: The root AreaHeatMapChart container uses `height: [prop value]` and `display: flex; flex-direction: column`.
2. **Auto-sized Elements**: Header, Legend, DataDisplay, and Footer take their natural height.
3. **Stretching HeatMapGroup**: The AreaHeatMapGroup is wrapped in a div with `flex: 1`, which fills all remaining space.
4. **Dynamic Measurement**: AreaHeatMapGroup receives `height="100%"` and uses `ResizeObserver` to measure its actual pixel height.

### Usage Examples

```tsx
// Standard fixed height (default 500px)
<AreaHeatMapChart data={data} height={500} />

// Taller chart for more visibility
<AreaHeatMapChart data={data} height={700} />

// Compact dashboard widget
<AreaHeatMapChart
  data={data}
  height={380}
  chartFooter={false}
/>

// Chart without header/footer - heatmap fills entire height
<AreaHeatMapChart
  data={data}
  height={350}
  chartHeader={false}
  chartFooter={false}
  sequentialChartKey={false}
/>
```

## Hover Interaction

Hovering over cells highlights the cell and can drive DataDisplay and HoverBadge updates. Set `interactive={true}` (default) and optionally `heatmapGroupConfig.hoverBadge` to show a cursor-following badge.

## Indicator Tracker

The indicator tracker shows a small circle on the chart key gradient bar at the position corresponding to the hovered cell's data value. This gives users immediate visual feedback of where the hovered value sits within the color scale.

**Activation requirements** (both must be true):

1. `indicatorTracker={true}` in `sequentialChartKeyConfig` or `divergingChartKeyConfig`
2. `interactive={true}` at the parent level (default)

When both conditions are met, hovering a heatmap cell automatically passes its numeric value to the chart key's `indicatorTrackerValue` prop. The indicator position is calculated internally by the chart key component from its data range. When no cell is hovered, the indicator is hidden.

No manual `indicatorTrackerValue` is needed in the config — the value is derived from the internal hover state.

```tsx
<AreaHeatMapChart
  data={data}
  interactive={true}
  sequentialChartKeyConfig={{
    mainLabelValue: "Activity level",
    indicatorTracker: true,
  }}
  divergingChartKeyConfig={{
    mainLabelValue: "Revenue change",
    indicatorTracker: true,
  }}
/>
```

## Hover Badge

AreaHeatMapGroup supports a cursor-following DataBadge that displays hover information when `heatmapGroupConfig.hoverBadge` is enabled. Use `hoverBadgeConfig.formatValue` or `hoverBadgeConfig.formatBadge` for custom formatting.

## DataDisplay Integration

This chart supports an optional DataDisplay component positioned between SequentialChartKey (legend) and AreaHeatMapGroup. See **[DataDisplay Integration](./DataDisplayIntegration.md)** for full configuration including static/hover modes, custom formatters, and requirements.

**Chart-specific formatter signatures:**

- `formatHoverLeadValue`: `(value: number, row?: string, column?: string) => string`
- `formatHoverBadgeValue`: `(value: number, row?: string, column?: string) => string`

The formatters receive heatmap-specific data (value, row label, column label). This allows you to:

- Show the cell value with row/column context
- Display custom formatting (e.g., "Monday at 12am: 42 interactions")
- Calculate percentages or other derived values

When hovering in hover mode, the default label shows: `{row} at {column}` (e.g., "M at 12am")

### DataDisplay vs HoverBadge

AreaHeatMapGroup has its own `hoverBadge` option. When using DataDisplay in hover mode:

- Consider setting `heatmapGroupConfig.hoverBadge: false` to avoid duplicate hover information
- DataDisplay shows richer data (label, value, badge) in a fixed location
- HoverBadge follows the cursor and shows value only

### DataDisplay Config Example

```tsx
<AreaHeatMapChart
  data={data}
  dataDisplay={true}
  dataDisplayConfig={{
    mode: "hover",
    mainLabelValue: "Hover a cell",
    supportingBadgeLabelValue: "of total activity.",
    dataHead: {
      dataLeadValue: "–",
    },
    badgeConfig: {
      value: "–",
    },
    formatHoverLeadValue: (value, row, column) => `${value} (${row} @ ${column})`,
  }}
/>
```

## Color Synchronization

The `sequentialColorSet` and `colorLevels` props control both the SequentialChartKey legend and the AreaHeatMapGroup cells:

```tsx
<AreaHeatMapChart colorLevels={9} sequentialColorSet={1} />
```

**Color Mapping:**

- **High values** → Dark colors (`sequential/category1/1`)
- **Low values** → Light colors (`sequential/category1/9`)

This matches the SequentialChartKey legend where "Low" (light) is on the left and "High" (dark) is on the right.

## Duplicate Label Handling

The component correctly handles duplicate labels in **both rows AND columns**:

```typescript
// Row duplicates: "T" for Tuesday/Thursday, "S" for Saturday/Sunday
const days = ["M", "T", "W", "T", "F", "S", "S"];

// Column duplicates: "2", "4", etc. for AM and PM
const hours = ["12am", "2", "4", "6", "8", "10", "12pm", "2", "4", "6", "8", "10"];
```

The algorithm uses combined occurrence tracking to ensure each cell maps to the correct data point, even when using the canonical data format where labels (not indices) are stored.

## Accessibility

Wrapped by `ChartAccessibility` (enabled by default). Provides `role="figure"`, auto-generated summaries, hidden data tables, and an ARIA live region. See **[ChartAccessibility.md](./ChartAccessibility.md)** for configuration.

```tsx
<AreaHeatMapChart
  data={data}
  accessibility={{
    enabled: true,
    dataTable: true,
    summary: "auto",
  }}
/>
```

### ARIA Live Region

AreaHeatMapChart builds an announcement string from hover/focus state and passes it through `useChartAccessibility` (which debounces via `useAriaLiveRegion` at 150ms) to `ChartAccessibility`. When a cell is hovered or focused, screen readers announce:

```
"{row}, {column}: {value}, {pct}% of total"
```

This works regardless of whether DataDisplay is enabled.

### Keyboard Navigation

The heatmap grid uses **roving tab index** so the entire grid is a single tab stop:

| Key         | Action                                 |
| ----------- | -------------------------------------- |
| Tab         | Enter/exit the grid (single tab stop)  |
| ArrowLeft   | Move to previous column                |
| ArrowRight  | Move to next column                    |
| ArrowUp     | Move to same column in previous row    |
| ArrowDown   | Move to same column in next row        |
| Home        | Move to first cell                     |
| End         | Move to last cell                      |
| Enter/Space | Trigger `onCellClick` for focused cell |

### `aria-controls` Linking

When `dataDisplay={true}`, AreaHeatMapChart forwards the stable `dataDisplayId` returned by `useChartAccessibility` and:

1. Passes `id={dataDisplayId}` to `<DataDisplay>`
2. Passes `ariaControlsId={dataDisplayId}` to `<AreaHeatMapGroup>`
3. Each interactive cell receives `aria-controls={dataDisplayId}`, linking it to the DataDisplay region

### Decorative Element Hiding

YAxis, XAxis, and HoverBadge are `aria-hidden="true"` to avoid redundant screen reader announcements (data is conveyed via cell `aria-label` and the live region).

## Type Exports

```typescript
import type {
  AreaHeatMapChartProps,
  AreaHeatMapGroupConfig,
  DataDisplayConfig as AreaHeatMapChartDataDisplayConfig,
} from '@oneui/datavis';

import type {
  HeatMapDataPoint,
  HeatMapCellHoverData,
  ChartSeriesDataPoint,
} from '@oneui/datavis';
```

## Migration from Previous API

| Old Prop          | New Prop                   | Notes                                   |
| ----------------- | -------------------------- | --------------------------------------- |
| `showHeader`      | `chartHeader`              | Boolean toggle                          |
| `showLegend`      | `sequentialChartKey`       | Boolean toggle                          |
| `showFooter`      | `chartFooter`              | Boolean toggle                          |
| `showDataDisplay` | `dataDisplay`              | Boolean toggle                          |
| `chartHeader`     | `chartHeaderConfig`        | Config object + `Config` suffix         |
| `chartLegend`     | `sequentialChartKeyConfig` | Renamed + `Config` suffix               |
| `dataDisplay`     | `dataDisplayConfig`        | Restructured to mirror DataDisplayProps |
| `heatmapGroup`    | `heatmapGroupConfig`       | Config object + `Config` suffix         |
| `chartFooter`     | `chartFooterConfig`        | Config object + `Config` suffix         |

### DataDisplayConfig Migration

The `dataDisplayConfig` now mirrors the `DataDisplayProps` structure with Layer 2 + Layer 3 organization:

```tsx
// BEFORE
dataDisplay={{
  label: "Total",
  leadValue: "1,234",
  badgeValue: "23.5",
  badgeAutoDetect: true,
  showSupportingValue: false,
}}

// AFTER
dataDisplayConfig={{
  mainLabelValue: "Total",
  dataHead: {
    dataLeadValue: "1,234",
    supportingData: false,
  },
  badgeConfig: {
    value: "23.5",
    autoDetect: true,
  },
}}
```

## Child Components

- **ChartHeader**: Title and subtitle component
- **SequentialChartKey**: Sequential color legend
- **DivergingChartKey**: Diverging color legend
- **AreaHeatMapGroup**: The heatmap grid component
- **ChartFooter**: Source and notes component
- **DataDisplay**: Data display with label, value, and badge

## Performance Notes

- Uses `useMemo` for mode mapping and legend generation
- Token resolution benefits from `resolvedCache`

## Related Documentation

- **[OrganizedPropsPattern.md](./OrganizedPropsPattern.md)** - Props pattern documentation
- **[ChartAccessibility.md](./ChartAccessibility.md)** - Accessibility wrapper
- **[useChartAccessibility.md](./useChartAccessibility.md)** - Composite ARIA hook used by the chart
- **[useAriaLiveRegion.md](./useAriaLiveRegion.md)** - Lower-level debounce hook composed by `useChartAccessibility`
- **[AreaHeatMapGroup.md](./AreaHeatMapGroup.md)** - Standalone heatmap grid
- **[SequentialChartKey.md](./SequentialChartKey.md)** - Sequential color legend
- **[DivergingChartKey.md](./DivergingChartKey.md)** - Diverging color legend
- **[DataDisplay.md](./DataDisplay.md)** - Data display with label, value, and badge
- **[ChartHeader.md](./ChartHeader.md)** - Chart title and subtitle
- **[ChartFooter.md](./ChartFooter.md)** - Chart source and notes

| File                                | Description                           |
| ----------------------------------- | ------------------------------------- |
| `AreaHeatMapChart.tsx`              | Component implementation (named export) |
| `AreaHeatMapChart.module.css`       | Chart-level shell layout — CSS module |
| `AreaHeatMapChart.stories.tsx`      | Storybook stories (14 stories, 9 sections) |
