text:
CircularProgressChart
`CircularProgressChart` is a top-level compound chart that visualises multiple metrics as concentric progress rings. Each ring represents progress toward its own goal (`value / max`). Use this chart to compare several KPIs against their own targets at a glance.
@jds4/oneui-datavis
@jds4/oneui-datavis/components/charts/CircularProgressChart
# CircularProgressChart

## Overview

`CircularProgressChart` is a top-level compound chart that visualises multiple metrics as concentric progress rings. Each ring represents progress toward its own goal (`value / max`). Use this chart to compare several KPIs against their own targets at a glance.

It composes `ChartHeader`, `ChartLegend`, optional `DataDisplay`, `CircularProgressGroup`, optional `InlineChartKeyGroup`, and `ChartFooter` via the **Organized Props Pattern** (two layers: Parent Props, Child Configs). All design tokens are resolved via the CSS cascade — no runtime JS token resolver, no `modes` prop.

## Figma Reference

- **Node ID**: `977:148753`
- **Design File**: DataVis-Components
- **Figma URL**: https://www.figma.com/design/uA5ExvS0cNXbDEKzT9Rnrt/DataVis-Components?node-id=977-148753

## Architecture

```
CircularProgressChart
└── ChartAccessibility (role="figure", summary, data table, aria-live)
    ├── ChartHeader (title + subtitle)
    ├── ChartLegend (auto-generated from data, up to 6 items)
    ├── DataDisplay (optional summary block)
    ├── CircularProgressGroup (concentric progress rings)
    │   ├── path.pathTrack × N (decorative background)
    │   ├── path.progress × N (interactive, keyboard-navigable)
    │   └── Badge (optional, cursor-following hover badge)
    ├── InlineChartKeyGroup (optional detailed legend with values)
    └── ChartFooter (source + notes)
```

## Import

```tsx
import { CircularProgressChart } from "./charts/CircularProgressChart";
```

## Data Formats

### Canonical Format (Recommended)

```typescript
import { CircularProgressDataPoint } from "./charts/CircularProgressChart";

const data: CircularProgressDataPoint[] = [
  { category: "Revenue", value: 72 },
  { category: "Users",   value: 48 },
  { category: "Sessions", value: 35 },
];
```

`CircularProgressDataPoint` extends `ChartDataPoint` with an optional per-ring `max`:

```typescript
interface CircularProgressDataPoint extends ChartDataPoint {
  max?: number;
}
```

### Per-Ring Max

```typescript
const data: CircularProgressDataPoint[] = [
  { category: "Steps", value: 7820, max: 10000 },
  { category: "Active minutes", value: 42, max: 60 },
  { category: "Calories", value: 1620, max: 2200 },
];
```

Each ring scales against its own `max`. When `max` is omitted, the chart-level `max` prop is used (default `100`).

### Ring Order

By default, `data[0]` renders as the **outermost** ring. Set `circularProgressGroupConfig.ringOrder` to `"inner-first"` to flip this — useful when the most important metric should be the focal point in the centre. Legend order always reflects source-data order, independent of ring order.

## Props Interface (Organized Props Pattern)

```typescript
interface CircularProgressChartProps {
  // Layer 2: Parent component props
  data: CircularProgressDataPoint[];
  width?: number | string;
  height?: number | string;
  fullWidth?: boolean;
  max?: number;
  chartHeader?: boolean;
  chartLegend?: boolean;
  dataDisplay?: boolean;
  inlineChartKeyGroup?: boolean;
  chartFooter?: boolean;
  interactive?: boolean;
  animated?: boolean;

  // Layer 3: Child component configurations
  chartHeaderConfig?: ChartHeaderConfig;
  chartLegendConfig?: ChartLegendConfig;
  dataDisplayConfig?: CircularProgressDataDisplayConfig;
  circularProgressGroupConfig?: CircularProgressGroupConfig;
  inlineChartKeyGroupConfig?: InlineChartKeyGroupConfig;
  chartFooterConfig?: ChartFooterConfig;

  // Accessibility
  accessibility?: AccessibilityConfig;
}
```

## Props

### Parent Component Props (Layer 2)

| Prop                  | Type                          | Default | Description                                                |
| --------------------- | ----------------------------- | ------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- |
| `data`                | `CircularProgressDataPoint[]` | `[]`    | One data point per ring; `data[0]` is outermost by default |
| `width`               | `number \| string`            | `432`   | Total chart width                                          |
| `height`              | `number \| string`            | `auto`  | Optional explicit height                                   |
| `fullWidth`           | `boolean`                     | `false` | Stretch chart to fill parent container width               |
| `max`                 | `number`                      | `100`   | Chart-level default max when a data point omits its own    |
| `chartHeader`         | `boolean`                     | `true`  | Show ChartHeader                                           |
| `chartLegend`         | `boolean`                     | `true`  | Show ChartLegend                                           |
| `dataDisplay`         | `boolean`                     | `false` | Show summary DataDisplay block between legend and rings    |
| `inlineChartKeyGroup` | `boolean`                     | `false` | Show InlineChartKeyGroup below the rings                   |
| `chartFooter`         | `boolean`                     | `true`  | Show ChartFooter                                           |
| `interactive`         | `boolean`                     | `true`  | Enable hover/click/keyboard interactivity                  |
| `animated`            | `boolean`                     | `false` | Enable entry + data-change animations                      |
| `valueFormat`         | `ValueFormatConfig`           | `undefined` | Format config for ring values in the hover badge, InlineChartKeyGroup legend, and ARIA live text — used whenever the corresponding local formatter (`hoverBadgeConfig.formatValue`, `inlineChartKeyGroupConfig.formatValue`/`formatMax`) isn't explicitly supplied. |

### ChartHeader Config (`chartHeaderConfig`)

| Prop                 | Type      | Default | Description            |
| -------------------- | --------- | ------- | ---------------------- |
| `chartTitleValue`    | `string`  | -       | Chart title text       |
| `chartSubtitleValue` | `string`  | -       | Chart subtitle text    |
| `subtitle`           | `boolean` | `true`  | Show/hide the subtitle |

### ChartLegend Config (`chartLegendConfig`)

| Prop    | Type                | Default        | Description                      |
| ------- | ------------------- | -------------- | -------------------------------- |
| `items` | `ChartLegendItem[]` | auto-generated | Manual override for legend items |

### DataDisplay Config (`dataDisplayConfig`)

Accepts every prop from the underlying `DataDisplay` component except `id` (managed internally by the chart). Common fields:

| Prop                  | Type                  | Default    | Description                                                |
| --------------------- | --------------------- | ---------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- |
| `mainLabelValue`      | `string`              | -          | Main label above the value                                 |
| `dataHead`            | `DataHeadConfig`      | -          | `{ dataLeadValue, dataSupportingValue, ... }`              |
| `badgeConfig`         | `BadgeConfig`         | -          | Badge value and appearance                                 |
| `supportingBadgeLabelValue`| `string`              | -          | Label text next to the badge                               |
| `size`           | `"S" \| "M" \| "L"`  | `"L"`      | Typography scale                                           |

See **[DataDisplay.md](./DataDisplay.md)** for the complete list.

### CircularProgressGroup Config (`circularProgressGroupConfig`)

| Prop               | Type                               | Default              | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| ------------------ | ---------------------------------- | -------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `arcWidth`         | `number \| ArcWidthSize`           | `20`                 | Arc thickness in px. T-shirt sizes (`XS`–`2XL`) resolve spacing tokens. The gap between concentric rings is auto-derived from this value.                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `startAngle`       | `number` (degrees)                 | `0`                  | Starting angle — 0 = 12 o'clock, positive values rotate clockwise                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `ringOrder`        | `"outer-first" \| "inner-first"`   | `"outer-first"`      | Whether `data[0]` renders as outermost or innermost                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `showTrack`        | `boolean`                          | `true`               | Show the neutral track behind each progress arc                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `cornerRadius`     | `"pill" \| number`                 | `"pill"`             | End-cap corner radius                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `hoverBadge`       | `boolean`                          | `false`              | Show cursor-following badge on hover                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `onRingHover`      | `(data: RingHoverData) => void`    | -                    | Fires when any ring hover/focus state changes                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `onRingClick`      | `(data: RingHoverData) => void`    | -                    | Fires when any ring is clicked or keyboard-activated                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `hoveredRingIndex` | `number`                           | -                    | Controlled hover index                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `hoverBadgeConfig` | `CircularProgressHoverBadgeConfig` | `{}`                 | Custom formatters for the hover badge                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `hitAreaArcWidth`  | `number`                           | `arcWidth + ringGap` | Total radial thickness (px) of the invisible full-360° hover overlay per ring. Defaults to the full ring slot so hit areas tile with zero dead zones. Clamped to `[arcWidth, arcWidth + ringGap]`. See [`CircularProgressGroup.md`](./CircularProgressGroup.md#hit-area-overlay) for details. |

### InlineChartKeyGroup Config (`inlineChartKeyGroupConfig`)

| Prop                    | Type                             | Default                       | Description                                 |
| ----------------------- | -------------------------------- | ----------------------------- | ------------------------------------------- |
| `data`                  | `InlineChartKeyGroupItem[]`      | auto-generated                | Manual override for inline key rows         |
| `formatValue`           | `(value: number) => string`      | `v.toLocaleString()`          | Formatter for the main data value           |
| `showSecondary`         | `boolean`                        | `true`                        | Show the secondary slot (max or percentage) |
| `secondaryMode`         | `"max" \| "percentage"`          | `"max"`                       | What to show in the secondary slot          |
| `formatMax`             | `(max: number) => string`        | `\`/ ${m.toLocaleString()}\`` | Formatter for the `max` value               |
| `formatPercentage`      | `(percentage: number) => string` | `\`${p.toFixed(1)}%\``        | Formatter for the percentage value          |
| `defaultType`           | `"circle" \| "dashed" \| "line"` | `"circle"`                    | Default indicator shape for all rows        |
| `defaultShapeIndicator` | `boolean`                        | `true`                        | Show or hide the shape indicator            |

### ChartFooter Config (`chartFooterConfig`)

| Prop                   | Type     | Default | Description             |
| ---------------------- | -------- | ------- | ----------------------- |
| `annotationLeftValue`  | `string` | -       | Source attribution text |
| `annotationRightValue` | `string` | -       | Additional notes text   |

### Accessibility Config (`accessibility`)

| Prop        | Type      | Default  | Description                                   |
| ----------- | --------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------- |
| `enabled`   | `boolean` | `true`   | Enable accessibility wrapper                  |
| `summary`   | `string`  | `"auto"` | Custom summary or `"auto"` for auto-generated |
| `dataTable` | `boolean` | `true`   | Hidden data table for screen readers          |
| `ariaLabel` | `string`  | -        | Custom `aria-label` override                  |

## Usage Examples

### Basic Chart

```tsx
<CircularProgressChart
  data={[
    { category: "Revenue", value: 72 },
    { category: "Users",   value: 48 },
    { category: "Sessions", value: 35 },
  ]}
  max={100}
  chartHeaderConfig={{
    chartTitleValue: "Quarterly Targets",
    chartSubtitleValue: "Progress toward quarterly goals",
  }}
/>
```

### With DataDisplay Summary

```tsx
<CircularProgressChart
  data={data}
  dataDisplay
  dataDisplayConfig={{
    mainLabelValue: "Total progress",
    dataHead: { dataLeadValue: "2,390", dataSupportingValue: "/ 3,000" },
    badgeConfig: { value: "+2.34" },
    supportingBadgeLabelValue: "Than last month.",
  }}
/>
```

### Per-Ring Max

```tsx
<CircularProgressChart
  data={[
    { category: "Steps", value: 7820, max: 10000 },
    { category: "Active minutes", value: 42, max: 60 },
    { category: "Calories", value: 1620, max: 2200 },
  ]}
  inlineChartKeyGroup
  inlineChartKeyGroupConfig={{
    secondaryMode: "max",
    formatValue: (v) => v.toLocaleString(),
    formatMax: (m) => `/ ${m.toLocaleString()}`,
  }}
/>
```

### Full Configuration

```tsx
<CircularProgressChart
  data={data}
  width={432}
  max={100}
  chartHeader
  chartLegend
  dataDisplay
  inlineChartKeyGroup
  chartFooter
  interactive
  animated
  chartHeaderConfig={{
    chartTitleValue: "Quarterly Targets",
    chartSubtitleValue: "Progress toward quarterly goals",
  }}
  dataDisplayConfig={{
    mainLabelValue: "Total progress",
    dataHead: { dataLeadValue: "2,390", dataSupportingValue: "/ 3,000" },
    badgeConfig: { value: "+2.34" },
    supportingBadgeLabelValue: "Than last month.",
  }}
  circularProgressGroupConfig={{
    arcWidth: 20,
    ringOrder: "outer-first",
    showTrack: true,
    hoverBadge: true,
  }}
  inlineChartKeyGroupConfig={{
    showSecondary: true,
    secondaryMode: "max",
  }}
  chartFooterConfig={{
    annotationLeftValue: "Source: Analytics",
    annotationRightValue: "Updated daily",
  }}
  accessibility={{ enabled: true, dataTable: true }}
/>
```

### Full-Width Chart

```tsx
<CircularProgressChart
  data={data}
  fullWidth
  chartHeaderConfig={{ chartTitleValue: "Full-Width View" }}
/>
```

## Design Tokens Used

| Property    | CSS Token                           | Fallback       | Purpose                                            |
| ----------- | ----------------------------------- | -------------- | -------------------------------------------------- |
| Section gap | `--CircularProgressChart-gap`       | `--Spacing-5`  | Gap between chart sections (header, legend, rings) |
| Ring 1–12   | `--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-{1–12}` | extended CSS   | Per-ring progress colour via DataVis pipeline      |
| Track fill  | `--Neutral-Minimal`                 | CSS cascade    | Decorative track behind each progress arc          |
| Pill radius | `--Shape-Pill`                      | `9999px`       | End-cap corner radius                              |
| Arc width   | `--Spacing-{2–8}`                   | `20px`         | T-shirt size to px mapping for arc thickness       |

All DataVis categorical tokens (`--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-{n}`) are injected at `@layer brand` by `generateDataVisCSS` → `useStyleInjection` from Convex palette data. Surface / typography tokens (`--Neutral-Minimal`, `--Shape-Pill`, `--Spacing-*`) are injected by the brand CSS engine via `useBrandCSSNew`.

## Legend Auto-Generation

When `chartLegend` is `true` and `chartLegendConfig.items` is not provided:

- One legend item per data point (up to 6), using `var(--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-1)` through `var(--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-6)`
- Custom `data[i].color` overrides the categorical token for that ring

Legend order always reflects source-data order, independent of `ringOrder`.

## InlineChartKeyGroup Auto-Generation

When `inlineChartKeyGroup` is `true` and `inlineChartKeyGroupConfig.data` is not provided, rows are generated from the chart data. Each row displays:

- Shape indicator + category label
- Formatted main value (`formatValue`)
- Optional secondary slot: `"/ max"` or `"percentage %"` depending on `secondaryMode`

## Responsive Sizing

The ring area is a flex child of the chart with `aspect-ratio: 1 / 1` as its preferred natural size, capped by `max-height: 100%` + `min-height: 0`. This lets the chart drop into a CSS grid cell, a flex column, or any other fixed-height container and honour the available space without bleeding into neighbouring cells. Three behaviours follow from this:

- **No explicit `height` prop**: the ring wrapper grows to a square sized by `width`, and the chart's intrinsic height is `header + legend + dataDisplay + width² + inlineKey + footer`.
- **Explicit `height` shorter than the natural square**: the ring wrapper shrinks to the remaining space after the siblings. `CircularProgressGroup` measures the wrapper via `ResizeObserver` and picks `Math.min(width, height)` as the drawing square, so the rings stay circular at the largest size that fits.
- **Sibling heights change at runtime**: the same `ResizeObserver` path runs. Outside of an animation this rescales the rings in place (snap). Inside a data-change animation it piggybacks onto the in-flight tween so the radii transition smoothly alongside the sweep.

## Hover Interaction

### Dimming Behavior

| State                               | Opacity | Description               |
| ----------------------------------- | ------- | ------------------------- |
| **Default** (nothing hovered)       | `1`     | All rings at full opacity |
| **Highlighted** (this ring hovered) | `1`     | Stays vibrant             |
| **Dimmed** (another ring hovered)   | `0.4`   | Non-active rings fade     |

### Hit Area Overlay

Each interactive ring is hover/click/focusable across the **full 360° annular slot**, not just the filled portion of the arc. A transparent overlay `<path>` sized by `circularProgressGroupConfig.hitAreaArcWidth` owns all mouse + keyboard + ARIA events.

### Hover Callbacks

Pass callbacks via `circularProgressGroupConfig`:

```tsx
<CircularProgressChart
  circularProgressGroupConfig={{
    onRingHover: (ring) => console.log(ring),
    onRingClick: (ring) => setSelected(ring),
  }}
  ...
/>
```

`RingHoverData` contains `{ isHovered, index, category, value, max, percentage, color, mouseX?, mouseY? }`.

### Controlled Hover

Pass `hoveredRingIndex` to sync hover state with external UI (e.g. a data table row).

## Hover Badge

Set `circularProgressGroupConfig.hoverBadge: true` to show a cursor-following badge.

```tsx
<CircularProgressChart
  circularProgressGroupConfig={{
    hoverBadge: true,
    hoverBadgeConfig: {
      formatValue: (value, category, percentage) =>
        `${category}: ${value} (${percentage?.toFixed(0)}%)`,
    },
  }}
  ...
/>
```

## Animation

Set `animated: true` to enable two independent rAF-driven loops — one for mount-time entry and a second for data-change transitions — both sourcing every timing value from CSS motion tokens (no hardcoded values).

**Entry** (first render only):

- **Progress arc**: each ring sweeps from 0 to its target progress, staggered by `--Motion-Offset-M` and eased through `--Motion-Easing-Entrance-Moderate` over `--Motion-Duration-L`.
- **Track fade-in** (when `showTrack=true`): each ring's track fades `opacity: 0 → 1` on the same stagger slot as the arc.

**Data change** (post-entry, `--Motion-Easing-Transition-Moderate`, `--Motion-Duration-M`, **no stagger**):

- **Continuing rings**: `endAngle`, `opacity`, and inner/outer radii all interpolate concurrently.
- **New rings**: fade + sweep concurrently (`opacity: 0 → 1` AND `endAngle: startAngle → target`).
- **Removed rings**: fade `opacity: 1 → 0`, then unmounted on completion.
- **Reappearing rings**: tween resumes mid-flight using current DOM opacity as start state.

When `animated=false`, both loops are skipped — every change resolves to its final state on the next render.

## Accessibility

Wrapped by `ChartAccessibility` and wired up via `useChartAccessibility`. Enabled by default.

- `role="figure"` with `aria-label`, `aria-describedby`
- Auto-generated natural language summary
- Visually-hidden `<table>` for screen reader data navigation (Category, Value, Max, Percent columns)
- `aria-live="polite"` region for hover/focus announcements (debounced via `useAriaLiveRegion`)
- Roving tab index keyboard navigation (Up/Down arrows, Home, End, Enter, Space) when `interactive`
- `aria-controls` wired to DataDisplay only when `dataDisplay: true`

See **[ChartAccessibility.md](./ChartAccessibility.md)** for full configuration.

## Child Components

| Component               | Config Prop                   | Path                                  | Description                 |
| ----------------------- | ----------------------------- | ------------------------------------- | --------------------------- |
| `ChartHeader`           | `chartHeaderConfig`           | `groups/ChartHeader`                  | Title and subtitle          |
| `ChartLegend`           | `chartLegendConfig`           | `groups/ChartLegend`                  | Auto-generated legend       |
| `DataDisplay`           | `dataDisplayConfig`           | `groups/DataDisplay`                   | Summary block (optional)    |
| `CircularProgressGroup` | `circularProgressGroupConfig` | `groups/CircularProgressGroup`        | Concentric progress rings   |
| `InlineChartKeyGroup`   | `inlineChartKeyGroupConfig`   | `groups/InlineChartKeyGroup`          | Detailed legend with values |
| `ChartFooter`           | `chartFooterConfig`           | `groups/ChartFooter`                  | Source and notes            |

## Performance Notes

- `catColor` is a stable `useCallback` returning CSS var strings — no JS token resolution at render time
- `resolvedLegendItems` and `resolvedInlineChartKeyGroupData` are memoized separately, each with a minimal dep array
- `CircularProgressGroup` handles all D3 geometry with its own memoisation
- Entry + data-change animations share a single `requestAnimationFrame` loop
- Container gap resolved entirely in CSS (`var(--CircularProgressChart-gap, var(--Spacing-5))`) — no inline pixel values

## Related Documentation

- [CircularProgressGroup.md](./CircularProgressGroup.md) — Group component details
- [ChartHeader.md](./ChartHeader.md) — Header component
- [ChartFooter.md](./ChartFooter.md) — Footer component
- [ChartLegend.md](./ChartLegend.md) — Legend component
- [DataDisplay.md](./DataDisplay.md) — DataDisplay component
- [InlineChartKeyGroup.md](./InlineChartKeyGroup.md) — Inline key group
- [ChartAccessibility.md](./ChartAccessibility.md) — Accessibility wrapper

## Files

| File                                                                                    | Description              |
| --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------ |
| `components/charts/CircularProgressChart/CircularProgressChart.tsx`                     | Component implementation |
| `components/charts/CircularProgressChart/CircularProgressChart.module.css`              | CSS module (layout only) |
| `components/charts/CircularProgressChart/CircularProgressChart.stories.tsx`             | Storybook stories        |
| `components/charts/CircularProgressChart/CircularProgressChart.test.tsx`                | Unit tests               |
| `components/charts/CircularProgressChart/index.ts`                                      | Named re-export barrel   |
| `components/charts/CircularProgressChart/CircularProgressChart.md`                      | This documentation       |

title: ClusteredBubbleChart
text:
ClusteredBubbleChart
A complete bubble chart visualization that combines ChartHeader, ChartLegend, DataDisplay, ClusteredBubbleGroup, InlineChartKeyGroup, and ChartFooter into a cohesive chart component.
@jds4/oneui-datavis
@jds4/oneui-datavis/components/charts/ClusteredBubbleChart
# ClusteredBubbleChart

## Overview

A complete bubble chart visualization that combines ChartHeader, ChartLegend, DataDisplay, ClusteredBubbleGroup, InlineChartKeyGroup, and ChartFooter into a cohesive chart component.

**This component follows the [Organized Props Pattern](./OrganizedPropsPattern.md).**

## Figma Reference

- **Node ID**: `255:8116`
- **Design URL**: [DataVis Components - ClusteredBubbleChart](https://www.figma.com/design/uA5ExvS0cNXbDEKzT9Rnrt/DataVis-Components?node-id=255-8116)

## Architecture

```
ClusteredBubbleChart (Organized Props Pattern)
├── Layer 1 – Global Modes (modes)
├── Layer 2 – Parent Props
│   ├── chartHeader           → boolean toggle
│   ├── chartFooter           → boolean toggle
│   ├── chartLegend           → boolean toggle
│   ├── dataDisplay           → boolean toggle
│   ├── inlineChartKeyGroup   → boolean toggle
│   ├── interactive, animated
│   └── data, width, height
└── Layer 3 – Child Configs
    ├── chartHeaderConfig          → ChartHeaderConfig
    ├── chartLegendConfig          → ChartLegendConfig
    ├── dataDisplayConfig          → DataDisplayConfig (mirrors DataDisplayProps)
    ├── bubbleGroupConfig          → BubbleGroupConfig
    ├── inlineChartKeyGroupConfig  → InlineChartKeyGroupConfig
    └── chartFooterConfig          → ChartFooterConfig
```

### Component Tree

```
ClusteredBubbleChart
├── ChartAccessibility (wrapper)
│   └── Container
│       ├── ChartHeader (optional, chartHeader=true)
│       ├── ChartLegend (optional, chartLegend=true)
│       ├── DataDisplay (optional, dataDisplay=true)
│       ├── ClusteredBubbleGroup (D3 force bubble layout)
│       │   └── ClusteredBubble[] (circle + inside/outside data labels)
│       ├── InlineChartKeyGroup (optional, inlineChartKeyGroup=true)
│       └── ChartFooter (optional, chartFooter=true)
```

## Import

```tsx
import { ClusteredBubbleChart } from "@jio/datavis-components/charts";
// or
import ClusteredBubbleChart from "@jio/datavis-components/charts/ClusteredBubbleChart";
```

## Data Formats

### Canonical Format (ChartDataPoint)

```tsx
interface ChartDataPoint {
  id?: string; // Unique identifier
  category: CategoryValue; // Bubble label
  value: number; // Size value (determines bubble radius)
  color?: string; // Custom color override
  colorIndex?: number; // Categorical color (1-6)
}

const data: ChartDataPoint[] = [
  { category: "India", value: 4520 },
  { category: "USA", value: 3800 },
  { category: "UK", value: 2100 },
  { category: "Germany", value: 1800 },
  { category: "Japan", value: 900 },
  { category: "Australia", value: 450 },
];
```

## Props Interface (Organized Props Pattern)

```typescript
interface ClusteredBubbleChartProps {
  // Layer 2: Parent Props
  data: ChartDataPoint[];
  width?: number | string;
  height?: number | string;
  chartHeader?: boolean; // Toggle ChartHeader (default: true)
  chartFooter?: boolean; // Toggle ChartFooter (default: true)
  chartLegend?: boolean; // Toggle ChartLegend (default: true)
  dataDisplay?: boolean; // Toggle DataDisplay (default: false)
  inlineChartKeyGroup?: boolean; // Toggle InlineChartKeyGroup (default: false)
  interactive?: boolean; // Enable hover/click (default: true)
  animated?: boolean; // Enable entry animation (default: false)

  // Layer 3: Child Configs
  chartHeaderConfig?: ChartHeaderConfig;
  chartLegendConfig?: ChartLegendConfig;
  dataDisplayConfig?: DataDisplayConfig;
  bubbleGroupConfig?: BubbleGroupConfig;
  inlineChartKeyGroupConfig?: InlineChartKeyGroupConfig;
  chartFooterConfig?: ChartFooterConfig;

  // Layer 1: Global Modes
  modes?: GlobalModes;

  // Accessibility
  accessibility?: AccessibilityConfig;
}
```

## Props

### Layer 2: Parent Props

| Prop                  | Type               | Default | Description                                           |
| --------------------- | ------------------ | ------- | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| `data`                | `ChartDataPoint[]` | `[]`    | Array of data points                                  |
| `width`               | `number \| string` | `420`   | Total width of the chart                              |
| `height`              | `number \| string` | `340`   | Height of the bubble area                             |
| `chartHeader`         | `boolean`          | `true`  | Toggle chart header                                   |
| `chartFooter`         | `boolean`          | `true`  | Toggle chart footer                                   |
| `chartLegend`         | `boolean`          | `true`  | Toggle chart legend                                   |
| `dataDisplay`         | `boolean`          | `false` | Toggle DataDisplay component                          |
| `inlineChartKeyGroup` | `boolean`          | `false` | Toggle InlineChartKeyGroup                            |
| `interactive`         | `boolean`          | `true`  | Enable hover/click interactivity                      |
| `animated`            | `boolean`          | `false` | Enable entry animation (scale + fade-in with stagger) |

### Layer 3: Child Component Configs

#### `chartHeaderConfig`

| Prop                 | Type     | Default     | Description    |
| -------------------- | -------- | ----------- | -------------- |
| `chartTitleValue`    | `string` | `undefined` | Chart title    |
| `chartSubtitleValue` | `string` | `undefined` | Chart subtitle |

#### `chartLegendConfig`

| Prop    | Type                | Default | Description                                     |
| ------- | ------------------- | ------- | ----------------------------------------------- |
| `items` | `ChartLegendItem[]` | -       | Manual legend items (overrides auto-generation) |

#### `bubbleGroupConfig`

| Prop                 | Type                           | Default | Description                         |
| -------------------- | ------------------------------ | ------- | ----------------------------------- |
| `minRadius`          | `number`                       | `10`    | Minimum bubble radius               |
| `maxRadius`          | `number`                       | `90`    | Maximum bubble radius               |
| `forceStrength`      | `number`                       | `0.03`  | D3 force simulation strength        |
| `hoverBadge`         | `boolean`                      | `false` | Toggle cursor-following badge       |
| `hoverBadgeConfig`   | `{ formatValue, formatBadge }` | `{}`    | HoverBadge formatting configuration |
| `onBubbleHover`      | `(data) => void`               | -       | Bubble hover callback               |
| `onBubbleClick`      | `(data) => void`               | -       | Bubble click callback               |
| `hoveredBubbleIndex` | `number`                       | -       | Controlled hover state              |
| `mainData`           | `boolean`                      | `false` | Toggle data labels on bubbles       |
| `categoryLabel`      | `boolean`                      | `true`  | Toggle category labels on bubbles   |
| `valueFormat`        | `ValueFormatConfig`            | -       | Format config for bubble values     |
| `size`          | `string`                       | `"S"`   | Typography size for bubble labels   |

#### `inlineChartKeyGroupConfig`

| Prop             | Type                             | Default    | Description            |
| ---------------- | -------------------------------- | ---------- | ---------------------- |
| `items`          | `InlineChartKeyGroupItem[]`      | -          | Manual items           |
| `defaultType`    | `"circle" \| "dashed" \| "line"` | `"circle"` | Indicator type         |
| `mainData`       | `boolean`                        | `true`     | Show primary value     |
| `supportingData` | `boolean`                        | `false`    | Show secondary value   |
| `formatValue`    | `(value: number) => string`      | -          | Custom value formatter |

#### `chartFooterConfig`

| Prop                   | Type     | Default     | Description        |
| ---------------------- | -------- | ----------- | ------------------ |
| `annotationLeftValue`  | `string` | `undefined` | Source attribution |
| `annotationRightValue` | `string` | `undefined` | Additional notes   |

#### `dataDisplayConfig`

Mirrors the `DataDisplayProps` structure with additional chart-specific hover props.

**Chart-Specific Props:**

| Prop                    | Type                                                  | Default    | Description                            |
| ----------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------- | ---------- | -------------------------------------- |
| `mode`                  | `"static" \| "hover"`                                 | `"static"` | Static or hover-driven display         |
| `formatHoverLeadValue`  | `(value: number, category?: CategoryValue) => string` | -          | Custom formatter for hover lead value  |
| `formatHoverBadgeValue` | `(value: number, category?: CategoryValue) => string` | -          | Custom formatter for hover badge value |

**DataDisplay Layer 2 Props:**

| Prop                       | Type                        | Default  | Description                             |
| -------------------------- | --------------------------- | -------- | --------------------------------------- |
| `mainLabelValue`           | `string`                    | -        | Main label text above data value        |
| `formatLabelText`          | `boolean`                   | `true`   | Auto-format label                       |
| `formatOptions`            | `FormatLabelOptions`        | -        | Label formatting options                |
| `type`                     | `"Left" \| "Center"`        | `"Left"` | Layout type                             |
| `rightBadgeWrapper` | `boolean`                   | `false`  | Toggle rightBadgeWrapper section |
| `badgeTop`                 | `boolean`                   | `false`  | Toggle badgeTop slot                    |
| `badgeBottom`              | `boolean`                   | `true`   | Toggle badgeBottom slot                 |
| `dataBadgeSemantic`        | `boolean`                   | `false`  | Toggle DataBadgeSemantic instances      |
| `supportingBadgeLabel`     | `boolean`                   | `false`  | Toggle supporting label next to badge   |
| `supportingBadgeLabelValue`     | `string`                    | -        | Supporting label text next to badge     |
| `size`                | `"S" \| "M" \| "L" \| "XL"` | `"L"`    | Typography size variant                 |

**DataDisplay Layer 3 Configs:**

| Prop                      | Type                      | Description                         |
| ------------------------- | ------------------------- | ----------------------------------- |
| `dataHead`                | `DataHeadConfig`          | Configuration for DataHead child    |
| `dataBadgeSemanticConfig` | `DataBadgeSemanticConfig` | Configuration for DataBadgeSemantic |

### Accessibility Config (`accessibility`)

| Prop        | Type      | Default  | Description                                 |
| ----------- | --------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------- |
| `enabled`   | `boolean` | `true`   | Enable accessibility wrapper                |
| `summary`   | `string`  | `"auto"` | Custom summary or "auto" for auto-generated |
| `dataTable` | `boolean` | `true`   | Hidden data table for screen readers        |
| `ariaLabel` | `string`  | -        | Custom aria-label override                  |

### Layer 1: Global Modes

| Prop                | Type      | Description                                         |
| ------------------- | --------- | --------------------------------------------------- |
| `modes.Platform`    | `string`  | Device platform sizing                              |
| `modes.Density`     | `string`  | Spacing density                                     |
| `modes.colourTheme` | `string`  | `"MyJio"`, `"JioHome"`, `"JioFinance"`, `"JioMart"` |
| `modes.colourMode`  | `string`  | Light/Dark mode                                     |
| `modes.Brand`       | `string`  | Brand entry point                                   |
| `modes.fullWidth`   | `boolean` | Fill available width                                |

## Usage Examples

### Basic Usage

```tsx
<ClusteredBubbleChart
  data={[
    { category: "Product A", value: 1000 },
    { category: "Product B", value: 750 },
    { category: "Product C", value: 500 },
    { category: "Product D", value: 300 },
    { category: "Product E", value: 150 },
    { category: "Product F", value: 50 },
  ]}
  chartHeaderConfig={{
    chartTitleValue: "Revenue by Product",
    chartSubtitleValue: "Distribution of revenue across product lines.",
  }}
  modes={{
    Platform: "L [Laptop 1440]",
    colourTheme: "MyJio",
    colourMode: "Light",
  }}
/>
```

### Full Configuration

```tsx
<ClusteredBubbleChart
  data={marketData}
  width={500}
  height={400}
  chartHeader
  chartFooter
  chartLegend
  dataDisplay
  inlineChartKeyGroup
  interactive
  chartHeaderConfig={{
    chartTitleValue: "Global Market Share",
    chartSubtitleValue: "Customer distribution by country.",
  }}
  dataDisplayConfig={{
    mode: "static",
    mainLabelValue: "Total Customers",
    dataHead: {
      dataLeadValue: "13,570",
      dataSupportingValue: "/ 15,000",
      supportingLabelValue: "Annual target",
    },
    dataBadgeSemanticConfig: {
      dataBadgeSemanticValue: "+8.5",
    },
  }}
  bubbleGroupConfig={{
    hoverBadge: true,
    minRadius: 15,
    maxRadius: 100,
  }}
  inlineChartKeyGroupConfig={{
    formatValue: (v) => v.toLocaleString(),
  }}
  chartFooterConfig={{
    annotationLeftValue: "Source: CRM Analytics.",
    annotationRightValue: "Q4 2025 data.",
  }}
  modes={{
    Platform: "L [Laptop 1440]",
    colourTheme: "MyJio",
    colourMode: "Light",
  }}
/>
```

### Hover Mode DataDisplay

When `dataDisplayConfig.mode` is set to `"hover"`, the DataDisplay component updates dynamically when bubbles are hovered:

```tsx
<ClusteredBubbleChart
  data={productData}
  dataDisplayConfig={{
    mode: "hover",
    mainLabelValue: "Hover a bubble",
    dataHead: {
      dataLeadValue: "--",
      dataSupportingValue: "/ 2,750",
      supportingLabelValue: "of total revenue",
    },
    dataBadgeSemanticConfig: {
      dataBadgeSemanticValue: "--%",
    },
    formatHoverLeadValue: (value) => `£${value.toLocaleString()}`,
  }}
  bubbleGroupConfig={{
    hoverBadge: true,
  }}
/>
```

### With Formatted Values

```tsx
<ClusteredBubbleChart
  data={revenueData}
  bubbleGroupConfig={{
    hoverBadge: true,
    hoverBadgeConfig: {
      formatValue: (value, label) => {
        const formatted = `£${(value / 1000000).toFixed(1)}M`;
        return label ? `${label}: ${formatted}` : formatted;
      },
    },
  }}
  inlineChartKeyGroupConfig={{
    formatValue: (v) => `£${(v / 1000000).toFixed(1)}M`,
  }}
/>
```

### Dark Mode

```tsx
<ClusteredBubbleChart
  data={productData}
  modes={{
    Platform: "L [Laptop 1440]",
    colourTheme: "MyJio",
    colourMode: "Dark",
  }}
/>
```

### With Entry Animation

```tsx
<ClusteredBubbleChart
  data={productData}
  animated
  chartHeaderConfig={{
    chartTitleValue: "Revenue by Product",
    chartSubtitleValue: "Animated on first load.",
  }}
  modes={{
    Platform: "L [Laptop 1440]",
    colourTheme: "MyJio",
    colourMode: "Light",
  }}
/>
```

### Minimal (Bubbles + Keys Only)

```tsx
<ClusteredBubbleChart
  data={productData}
  chartHeader
  chartFooter={false}
  chartLegend={false}
  dataDisplay={false}
  inlineChartKeyGroup
  chartHeaderConfig={{
    chartTitleValue: "Product Distribution",
    chartSubtitleValue: "Relative size by revenue.",
  }}
/>
```

### Full Width

```tsx
<ClusteredBubbleChart
  data={productData}
  height={400}
  modes={{
    fullWidth: true,
    Platform: "L [Laptop 1440]",
    colourTheme: "MyJio",
    colourMode: "Light",
  }}
/>
```

## Design Tokens Used

| Token Path                      | Purpose                                             |
| ------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------- |
| `Dimensions/Spacings/5`         | Gap between chart sections (20px)                   |
| `categorical/bold/1-6`          | Bubble, legend, and inline key colors (indices 1–6) |
| `monochromatic/category1-6/2`   | Overflow colors for indices 7+ (cycling per series) |
| `Colour/on-Colour/high`         | Text colors                                         |
| `Typography/fontsize/Title/M`   | Title font size                                     |
| `Typography/fontsize/System/XS` | Body text font size                                 |

## Legend Auto-Generation

### Colour Resolution

All auto-generated legend and inline key items resolve colour using the same overflow-safe logic:

| Item index (1-based) | Token used                                |
| -------------------- | ----------------------------------------- |
| 1–6                  | `categorical/bold/{index}`                |
| 7+                   | `monochromatic/category{(index-7)%6+1}/2` |

Custom `colorIndex` on a data point is used in place of the position index. Explicit `color` strings always take precedence.

### Legend Items

If `chartLegendConfig.items` is not provided, legend items are automatically generated from the data:

- Every data point becomes a legend item (no cap on count)
- Colors are resolved using the overflow-safe logic above
- Use `chartLegendConfig.items` to provide manual items if needed

### InlineChartKeyGroup Items

If `inlineChartKeyGroupConfig.items` is not provided, items are automatically generated:

- Each data point becomes an inline chart key
- Labels come from `category`
- Values are formatted using `inlineChartKeyGroupConfig.formatValue`, else `bubbleGroupConfig.valueFormat` (the same format driving the bubbles' own `DataLead` values), else `toLocaleString()`
- Colors match the legend/bubble colors using the same overflow-safe resolution

## Height Behavior

The `height` prop controls the height of the bubble visualization area. The ClusteredBubbleGroup fills this space with the D3 force layout; bubbles are sized proportionally within the container.

## Hover Interaction

Hovering over bubbles highlights the bubble and can drive DataDisplay and HoverBadge updates. Set `interactive={true}` (default) and optionally `bubbleGroupConfig.hoverBadge` to show a cursor-following badge.

## Hover Badge

Enable via `bubbleGroupConfig.hoverBadge`. The DataBadge follows the cursor when hovering over bubbles. Use `hoverBadgeConfig.formatValue` or `hoverBadgeConfig.formatBadge` for custom formatting.

## Data-Change Transition

When `animated={true}`, bubbles smoothly resize and reposition when the `data` prop changes after the initial entry animation completes. The `width`, `height`, `left`, and `top` of each bubble transition simultaneously using tokens from the `transitionAnimation` collection (resolved via `useDataTransition`). The D3 force simulation uses deterministic initial positions to ensure consistent layouts across data changes. See [ClusteredBubbleGroup - Data-Change Transition](./ClusteredBubbleGroup.md#data-change-transition) for full token details.

## DataDisplay Integration

This chart supports an optional DataDisplay component above the bubble visualization. When `dataDisplayConfig.mode` is `"hover"`, values update based on the hovered bubble. See **[DataDisplay Integration](./DataDisplayIntegration.md)** for full configuration.

## Migration from Previous API

| Old Prop                  | New Prop                    | Notes                                   |
| ------------------------- | --------------------------- | --------------------------------------- |
| `showHeader`              | `chartHeader`               | Boolean toggle                          |
| `showFooter`              | `chartFooter`               | Boolean toggle                          |
| `showLegend`              | `chartLegend`               | Boolean toggle                          |
| `showDataDisplay`         | `dataDisplay`               | Boolean toggle                          |
| `showInlineChartKeyGroup` | `inlineChartKeyGroup`       | Boolean toggle                          |
| `chartHeader`             | `chartHeaderConfig`         | Config object + `Config` suffix         |
| `chartLegend`             | `chartLegendConfig`         | Config object + `Config` suffix         |
| `dataDisplay`             | `dataDisplayConfig`         | Restructured to mirror DataDisplayProps |
| `bubbleGroup`             | `bubbleGroupConfig`         | Config object + `Config` suffix         |
| `inlineChartKeyGroup`     | `inlineChartKeyGroupConfig` | Config object + `Config` suffix         |
| `chartFooter`             | `chartFooterConfig`         | Config object + `Config` suffix         |

### DataDisplayConfig Migration

```tsx
// BEFORE
dataDisplay={{
  label: "Total",
  leadValue: "1,234",
  badgeValue: "23.5",
  showSupportingValue: false,
}}

// AFTER
dataDisplayConfig={{
  mainLabelValue: "Total",
  dataHead: {
    dataLeadValue: "1,234",
    supportingData: false,
  },
  dataBadgeSemanticConfig: {
    dataBadgeSemanticValue: "23.5",
  },
}}
```

## Accessibility

The chart is wrapped with `ChartAccessibility` which provides:

- ARIA attributes (`role="figure"`, `aria-label`, `aria-describedby`)
- Auto-generated natural language summary
- Visually-hidden data table for screen readers
- ARIA live region (`aria-live="polite"`) for hover/focus announcements
- Roving tabindex keyboard navigation across bubbles
- `aria-controls` linking from bubbles to DataDisplay

### Accessibility Wiring

```
ClusteredBubbleChart
├── useChartAccessibility({ rawLiveText, width, height, isFullWidth })
│     ├→ liveText (debounced via useAriaLiveRegion)
│     ├→ dataDisplayId (stable "-display" id)
│     └→ accessibilityContainerStyle
├── <ChartAccessibility liveText={liveText} containerStyle={accessibilityContainerStyle}>
│   ├── role="figure", aria-label, aria-describedby
│   ├── Visually hidden summary (auto-generated)
│   ├── Visually hidden data table
│   └── <div aria-live="polite">{liveText}</div>
├── <DataDisplay id={dataDisplayId} />
└── <ClusteredBubbleGroup ariaControlsId={dataDisplayId}>
    ├── useRovingTabIndex({ itemCount, orientation, onIndexChange })
    └── <div role="group" aria-label="Chart data">
        └── Bubble[] (role="button", data-roving-item,
                      aria-roledescription="data point",
                      aria-controls={dataDisplayId})
```

### Live Region Announcements

When a bubble is hovered or focused via keyboard, the live region announces:

```
"{category}, {formatted value}, {percentage}% of total"
```

Example: `"India, 4,520, 38.2% of total"`

If `dataDisplayConfig.formatHoverLeadValue` is provided, it is used to format the value in the announcement.

### Keyboard Navigation

```
Tab into chart  →  First bubble receives focus (tabIndex=0)
                    All other bubbles: tabIndex=-1
ArrowRight/Left →  Focus moves to next/prev bubble (wraps around)
Home / End      →  Focus moves to first/last bubble
Enter / Space   →  Triggers bubble click handler
Tab out         →  Exits the bubble group entirely
```

### Usage

```tsx
<ClusteredBubbleChart
  data={data}
  accessibility={{
    enabled: true,
    dataTable: true,
    summary: "Custom summary override",
  }}
/>
```

No additional props needed — live region, roving tabindex, and all ARIA semantics activate automatically when `enabled: true` (default).

## Type Exports

```typescript
export type { DataDisplayConfig } from "@jio/datavis-components/charts/ClusteredBubbleChart";
export type {
  DataHeadConfig,
  DataBadgeSemanticConfig,
} from "@jio/datavis-components/components/DataDisplay";
export type { ChartDataPoint } from "@jio/datavis-components/types/chart-data";
export type { ChartLegendItem } from "@jio/datavis-components/components/ChartLegend";
export type { BubbleHoverData } from "@jio/datavis-components/components/ClusteredBubbleGroup";
export type { AccessibilityConfig } from "@jio/datavis-components/components/ChartAccessibility";
```

## Child Components

| Component            | Config Prop                 | File                       | Description             |
| -------------------- | --------------------------- | -------------------------- | ----------------------- |
| ChartHeader          | `chartHeaderConfig`         | ./ChartHeader.tsx          | Title and subtitle      |
| ChartLegend          | `chartLegendConfig`         | ./ChartLegend.tsx          | Color legend            |
| DataDisplay          | `dataDisplayConfig`         | ./DataDisplay.tsx          | Summary value display   |
| ClusteredBubbleGroup | `bubbleGroupConfig`         | ./ClusteredBubbleGroup.tsx | Bubble visualization    |
| ClusteredBubble      | (internal to group)         | ./ClusteredBubble.tsx      | Bubble circle + labels  |
| InlineChartKeyGroup  | `inlineChartKeyGroupConfig` | ./InlineChartKeyGroup.tsx  | Inline keys with values |
| ChartFooter          | `chartFooterConfig`         | ./ChartFooter.tsx          | Source and notes        |

## Performance Notes

- Uses `useMemo` for mode mapping and legend generation
- ClusteredBubbleGroup uses D3 force simulation; token resolution benefits from `resolvedCache`

## Related Documentation

- [OrganizedPropsPattern](./OrganizedPropsPattern.md) - Props pattern documentation

- [ClusteredBubble](./ClusteredBubble.md) - Bubble circle with data labels

title: DonutChart
text:
DonutChart
Complete donut chart visualization that orchestrates ChartHeader, ChartLegend, DonutPathGroup, optional InlineChartKeyGroup, and ChartFooter into a cohesive chart layout.
@jds4/oneui-datavis
@jds4/oneui-datavis/components/charts/DonutChart
# DonutChart

## Overview

Complete donut chart visualization that orchestrates ChartHeader, ChartLegend, DonutPathGroup, optional InlineChartKeyGroup, and ChartFooter into a cohesive chart layout.

**Features:**

- Full chart layout with title, subtitle, legend, and source/notes
- D3-powered donut arc generation via DonutPathGroup
- Categorical colours from `--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-{n}` CSS custom properties — no hard-coded values
- Optional centred DataDisplay for summary values (static or hover-driven)
- Optional InlineChartKeyGroup as a detailed legend with values
- Accessibility support with screen reader summaries via ChartAccessibility

All tokens flow through the Convex → `generateDataVisCSS` → `useStyleInjection` → `@layer brand` pipeline — no JS token resolver.

## Figma Reference

- **Node ID**: `214:4887`
- **Design File**: DataVis-Components
- **Figma URL**: https://www.figma.com/design/uA5ExvS0cNXbDEKzT9Rnrt/DataVis-Components?node-id=214-4887

## Architecture

```
DonutChart (div[data-name="donutChart"])
├── ChartHeader (title + subtitle)                       — optional
├── ChartLegend (categorical legend, up to 6 items)      — optional
├── div[data-name="donutWrapper"]
│   └── DonutPathGroup (fillContainer=true)
│       ├── shapes (SVG donut arcs)
│       └── dataDisplay (centred metrics)                — optional
├── InlineChartKeyGroup (detailed legend with values)    — optional
└── ChartFooter (source + notes)                         — optional
```

The `donutWrapper` grows to fill available height (`flex: 1 0 0`) so the ring always fills the space between the header and footer.

## Import

```tsx
import { DonutChart } from './components/charts/DonutChart';
```

## Props

### Layer 2: Parent Props

| Prop                  | Type                  | Default | Description                                                                      |
| --------------------- | --------------------- | ------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `data`                | `ChartDataPoint[]`    | required | Chart data: `{ category, value, color? }`.                                       |
| `width`               | `number \| string`    | `346`   | Container width in px or CSS string (e.g. `"100%"`).                             |
| `height`              | `number \| string`    | `524`   | Container height in px or CSS string.                                            |
| `chartHeader`         | `boolean`             | `true`  | Show ChartHeader.                                                                |
| `chartFooter`         | `boolean`             | `true`  | Show ChartFooter.                                                                |
| `chartLegend`         | `boolean`             | `true`  | Show ChartLegend (up to 12 items; slots 7–12 use extended categorical palette). |
| `inlineChartKeyGroup` | `boolean`             | `false` | Show InlineChartKeyGroup (detailed legend with values).                          |
| `interactive`         | `boolean`             | `true`  | Enable hover/click interactivity on arc segments.                                |
| `animated`            | `boolean`             | `false` | Enable entry animation (staggered fan-out) and data-change transitions.          |
| `fullWidth`           | `boolean`             | `false` | Fill available container width (`100%`).                                         |
| `valueFormat`         | `ValueFormatConfig`   | `undefined` | Format config for segment values in the hover badge, hover-mode DataDisplay, InlineChartKeyGroup legend, and ARIA live text — used whenever the corresponding local formatter isn't explicitly supplied. |

### Layer 3: Child Config Props

| Prop                        | Type                        | Description                                           |
| --------------------------- | --------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| `chartHeaderConfig`         | `ChartHeaderConfig`         | Title and subtitle configuration.                     |
| `chartLegendConfig`         | `ChartLegendConfig`         | Manual legend items (overrides auto-generation).      |
| `donutGroupConfig`          | `DonutGroupConfig`          | DonutPathGroup configuration.                         |
| `inlineChartKeyGroupConfig` | `InlineChartKeyGroupConfig` | InlineChartKeyGroup configuration.                    |
| `chartFooterConfig`         | `ChartFooterConfig`         | Source and notes annotations.                         |

### Accessibility

| Prop            | Type                  | Description                                    |
| --------------- | --------------------- | ---------------------------------------------- |
| `accessibility` | `AccessibilityConfig` | Screen reader summary, data table, aria-label. |

---

## DonutGroupConfig

| Property            | Type                                | Default      | Description                                                                    |
| ------------------- | ----------------------------------- | ------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `arcWidth`          | `"auto" \| ArcWidthSize`            | `"auto"`     | Ring width. Auto scales with chart width; explicit T-shirt size overrides.     |
| `innerRadiusRatio`  | `number` (0–1)                      | derived      | Inner radius ratio. Overrides `arcWidth` calculation.                          |
| `startAngle`        | `number`                            | `0`          | Start angle in degrees (0 = 3 o'clock, −90 = 12 o'clock).                     |
| `padAngle`          | `number`                            | `0`          | Gap between segments in degrees.                                               |
| `dataDisplay`       | `boolean`                           | `true`       | Show centred DataDisplay.                                                      |
| `dataDisplayConfig` | `DonutDataDisplayConfig`            | `{}`         | Configuration for the centred DataDisplay.                                     |
| `hoverBadge`        | `boolean`                           | `false`      | Show cursor-following badge on arc hover.                                      |
| `hoverBadgeConfig`  | `DonutHoverBadgeConfig`             | `{}`         | Custom formatter for hover badge value.                                        |
| `onArcHover`        | `(data: DonutArcHoverData) => void` | —            | Fired on any arc hover state change.                                           |
| `onArcClick`        | `(data: DonutArcHoverData) => void` | —            | Fired on arc click or Enter/Space.                                             |
| `hoveredArcIndex`   | `number`                            | —            | Controlled hover — pins highlighted arc externally.                            |
| `dataSort`          | `DataSortOrder`                     | `"unsorted"` | Sort arc segments: `"asc"`, `"desc"`, or `"unsorted"`.                         |

---

## DonutDataDisplayConfig

| Property                   | Type                                        | Default    | Description                                                          |
| -------------------------- | ------------------------------------------- | ---------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `mode`                     | `"static" \| "hover"`                       | `"static"` | Static uses fixed values; hover updates from arc hover state.        |
| `mainLabelValue`           | `string`                                    | —          | Label above the lead value.                                          |
| `formatHoverLeadValue`     | `(value, category?, percentage?) => string` | —          | Custom formatter for lead value in hover mode.                       |
| `formatHoverBadgeValue`    | `(value, category?, percentage?) => string` | —          | Custom formatter for badge value in hover mode.                      |
| `rightBadgeWrapper` | `boolean`                                   | `false`    | Show the supporting content section (where badge lives).             |
| `supportingBadgeLabelValue`     | `string`                                    | —          | Text next to the badge.                                              |
| `showBadge`                | `boolean`                                   | `true`     | Toggle all badge instances.                                          |
| `badgeConfig`              | `BadgeConfig`                               | `{}`       | Badge value and appearance (`positive`/`negative`/`warning`/`informative`). |
| `size`                | `'XS' \| 'S' \| 'M' \| 'L' \| 'XL'`       | `'L'`      | Typography scale for the DataDisplay.                                |
| `dataHead`                 | `DataHeadConfig`                            | `{}`       | Lead value, supporting value, and label configuration.               |

---

## InlineChartKeyGroupConfig

| Property               | Type                         | Default            | Description                                                          |
| ---------------------- | ---------------------------- | ------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `data`                 | `InlineChartKeyGroupItem[]`  | auto-generated     | Pre-built display items — overrides auto-transform when provided.    |
| `formatValue`          | `(value: number) => string`  | `toLocaleString()` | Format function for the primary value column.                        |
| `showPercentage`       | `boolean`                    | `false`            | Show percentage as the supporting data column.                       |
| `formatPercentage`     | `(pct: number) => string`    | `"X.X%"`           | Format function for the percentage column.                           |
| `defaultType`          | `"circle" \| "dashed" \| "line"` | `"circle"`     | Colour indicator type for all items.                                 |
| `defaultShapeIndicator`| `boolean`                    | `true`             | Show the colour indicator dot/line.                                  |

---

## Design Tokens

### Categorical Colours

Segment colours are CSS custom property references resolved at paint time from `@layer brand`:

| Segments | CSS variable                          | Source                                        |
| -------- | ------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- |
| 1–6      | `--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-1` … `6`  | Brand-uploaded palette via DataVis pipeline   |
| 7–12     | `--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-7` … `12` | Extended fallback (`datavis-categorical-extended.css`) |

Legend colours use the same CSS var references — they update automatically when the brand or theme changes.

### Layout Token

| Property         | CSS variable                                     | Default     |
| ---------------- | ------------------------------------------------ | ----------- |
| Section gap      | `var(--DonutChart-gap, var(--Spacing-5))`        | `--Spacing-5` (~20px) |

---

## Accessibility

Wrapped by `ChartAccessibility` with `chartType="donut"`. Provides:
- `role="figure"` with `aria-label` (from title or `accessibility.ariaLabel`)
- Auto-generated screen reader summary describing data range and extremes
- Visually-hidden data table when `accessibility.dataTable=true` (default)
- ARIA live region for hover/focus announcements (debounced 150ms)
- `aria-controls` linking arc buttons to the centred DataDisplay

---

## Usage Examples

### Basic donut with header, legend, and centred summary

```tsx
<DonutChart
  data={[
    { category: 'Product A', value: 35 },
    { category: 'Product B', value: 25 },
    { category: 'Product C', value: 20 },
    { category: 'Product D', value: 12 },
    { category: 'Product E', value: 8 },
  ]}
  chartHeaderConfig={{
    chartTitleValue: 'Revenue Distribution',
    chartSubtitleValue: 'By product category',
  }}
  donutGroupConfig={{
    dataDisplay: true,
    dataDisplayConfig: {
      mainLabelValue: 'Revenue',
      supportingBadgeLabelValue: 'vs last month',
      rightBadgeWrapper: true,
      dataHead: { dataLeadValue: '£2,390' },
      badgeConfig: { value: '+12.5%', appearance: 'positive' },
    },
    hoverBadge: true,
  }}
  chartFooterConfig={{ annotationLeftValue: 'Source: Analytics' }}
/>
```

### Progress ring (two segments, top start)

```tsx
<DonutChart
  data={[
    { category: 'Completed', value: 75 },
    { category: 'Remaining', value: 25 },
  ]}
  chartLegend={false}
  chartHeaderConfig={{ chartTitleValue: 'Project Progress' }}
  donutGroupConfig={{
    arcWidth: 'XL',
    startAngle: -90,
    dataDisplay: true,
    dataDisplayConfig: {
      mainLabelValue: 'Completion',
      dataHead: { dataLeadValue: '75%' },
    },
  }}
/>
```

### With InlineChartKeyGroup

```tsx
<DonutChart
  data={data}
  chartLegend={false}
  inlineChartKeyGroup
  donutGroupConfig={{ dataDisplay: true, dataDisplayConfig: { mainLabelValue: 'Total' } }}
  inlineChartKeyGroupConfig={{
    formatValue: (v) => `£${v.toLocaleString()}`,
    showPercentage: true,
  }}
/>
```

### Full width

```tsx
<DonutChart data={data} fullWidth chartHeaderConfig={{ chartTitleValue: 'Revenue' }} />
```

### Hover mode — DataDisplay updates on arc hover

```tsx
<DonutChart
  data={data}
  donutGroupConfig={{
    dataDisplay: true,
    dataDisplayConfig: {
      mode: 'hover',
      mainLabelValue: 'Hover a segment',
      rightBadgeWrapper: true,
      dataHead: { dataLeadValue: '—' },
      formatHoverLeadValue: (value) => `£${value.toLocaleString()}`,
      formatHoverBadgeValue: (_, _cat, pct) => `${pct?.toFixed(1)}%`,
      supportingBadgeLabelValue: 'of total',
      badgeConfig: { value: '—' },
    },
  }}
/>
```

---

## Files

| File                          | Description                              |
| ----------------------------- | ---------------------------------------- |
| `DonutChart.tsx`              | Component implementation                 |
| `DonutChart.module.css`       | Structural CSS module                    |
| `DonutChart.stories.tsx`      | Storybook stories (13 stories)           |
| `DonutChart.test.tsx`         | Unit tests                               |
| `index.ts`                    | Public barrel export                     |
| `DonutChart.md`               | This documentation                       |

title: DotGridChart
text:
DotGridChart
`DotGridChart` is a top-level compound chart component that composes `ChartHeader`, `ChartLegend`, `DataDisplay`, `DotGridGroup`, and `ChartFooter` into a complete dot-grid visualisation. It follows the **Organised Props Pattern** with two meaningful layers: Parent Props and Child Configs.
@jds4/oneui-datavis
@jds4/oneui-datavis/components/charts/DotGridChart
# DotGridChart

## Overview

`DotGridChart` is a top-level compound chart component that composes `ChartHeader`, `ChartLegend`, `DataDisplay`, `DotGridGroup`, and `ChartFooter` into a complete dot-grid visualisation. It follows the **Organised Props Pattern** with two meaningful layers: Parent Props and Child Configs.

Data flows from the chart level down to `DotGridGroup` (dot rendering) and `ChartLegend` (auto-generated legend items). All colours resolve at paint time from `--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-{n}` CSS custom properties injected by the DataVis CSS pipeline — no hard-coded values.

## Figma Reference

- **Node ID**: `903:155182`
- **Design File**: DataVis-Components
- **Figma URL**: https://www.figma.com/design/uA5ExvS0cNXbDEKzT9Rnrt/DataVis-Components?node-id=903-155182

## Architecture

```
DotGridChart
├── ChartAccessibility (screen reader wrapper)
│   ├── ChartHeader (ChartTitle + ChartSubtitle)
│   ├── ChartLegend (optional, up to 12 ChartKey items — auto-generated)
│   ├── DataDisplay (optional, KPI block)
│   │   ├── mainLabel
│   │   ├── DataHead (DataLead + SupportingData)
│   │   └── Badge + SupportingLabel
│   ├── dotGridGroupWrapper (flex: 1 — fills remaining space)
│   │   └── DotGridGroup
│   │       └── dot[] (coloured div elements from data)
│   └── ChartFooter (source + notes)
```

## Import

```tsx
import { DotGridChart } from '@oneui/datavis';
```

## Data Formats

### Canonical Format (Recommended)

```tsx
import type { ChartDataPoint } from '@oneui/datavis';

const data: ChartDataPoint[] = [
  { id: 'used', category: 'Used', value: 37 },
  { id: 'remaining', category: 'Remaining', value: 63 },
];
```

In `"percentage"` mode (`dotFillType` default), values are proportions (37:63 → 37 % vs 63 %). In `"counted"` mode, values are literal dot counts.

### Legacy Format (Deprecated)

```tsx
import type { LegacyDotGridData } from '@oneui/datavis';

const data: LegacyDotGridData[] = [
  { label: 'Used', value: 37 },
  { label: 'Remaining', value: 63 },
];
```

Both formats are normalised internally. Legacy format logs a deprecation warning in development. Migrate to `ChartDataPoint[]`.

## Props Interface

```tsx
interface DotGridChartProps {
  // Layer 2 — parent props
  data: ChartDataPoint[] | LegacyDotGridData[];
  width?: number | string;           // default: 432
  height?: number | string;
  fullWidth?: boolean;               // default: false
  chartHeader?: boolean;             // default: true
  chartLegend?: boolean;             // default: true
  dataDisplay?: boolean;             // default: false
  chartFooter?: boolean;             // default: true
  animated?: boolean;                // default: false

  // Layer 3 — child configs
  chartHeaderConfig?: ChartHeaderConfig;
  chartLegendConfig?: ChartLegendConfig;
  dataDisplayConfig?: DataDisplayConfig;
  dotGridGroupConfig?: DotGridGroupConfig;
  chartFooterConfig?: ChartFooterConfig;

  // Accessibility
  accessibility?: AccessibilityConfig;
}
```

## Props

### Parent Component Props (Layer 2)

| Prop          | Type                                      | Default | Description                                         |
| ------------- | ----------------------------------------- | ------- | --------------------------------------------------- |
| `data`        | `ChartDataPoint[] \| LegacyDotGridData[]` | `[]`    | Chart data (canonical or legacy format)             |
| `width`       | `number \| string`                        | `432`   | Total chart width                                   |
| `height`      | `number \| string`                        | —       | Total chart height                                  |
| `fullWidth`   | `boolean`                                 | `false` | Stretch to 100% of parent container — ignores width |
| `chartHeader` | `boolean`                                 | `true`  | Show ChartHeader                                    |
| `chartLegend` | `boolean`                                 | `true`  | Show ChartLegend                                    |
| `dataDisplay` | `boolean`                                 | `false` | Show DataDisplay above dot grid                     |
| `chartFooter` | `boolean`                                 | `true`  | Show ChartFooter                                    |
| `animated`    | `boolean`                                 | `false` | Enable entry animation and data transition          |

### ChartHeader Config (`chartHeaderConfig`)

| Prop                 | Type      | Description            |
| -------------------- | --------- | ---------------------- |
| `chartTitleValue`    | `string`  | Chart title text       |
| `chartSubtitleValue` | `string`  | Chart subtitle text    |
| `subtitle`           | `boolean` | Show/hide subtitle row |

### ChartLegend Config (`chartLegendConfig`)

| Prop                           | Type                             | Default        | Description                                                       |
| ------------------------------ | -------------------------------- | -------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `items`                        | `ChartLegendItem[]`              | auto-generated | Manual legend items (bypass auto-generation)                      |
| `type`                         | `"circle" \| "dashed" \| "line"` | `"circle"`     | Indicator shape for auto-generated items                          |
| `dataHead`                     | `boolean`                        | `false`        | Show DataHead inside each ChartKey                                |
| `dataHeadConfig`               | object                           | —              | DataLead + SupportingData config for auto-generated legend items  |
| `interactiveDataHead`          | `boolean`                        | `false`        | Stable-width measurement — prevents layout shift on value change  |
| `allHoverLeadValues`           | `(number \| string)[][]`         | —              | All possible DataLead values per item for stable-width measurement |
| `allHoverSupportingLabelValues` | `string[][]`                     | —              | All possible supporting-label texts per item for stable-width measurement |

### DataDisplay Config (`dataDisplayConfig`)

| Prop                       | Type                 | Default  | Description                             |
| -------------------------- | -------------------- | -------- | --------------------------------------- |
| `mainLabelValue`           | `string`             | —        | Main label text above the data value    |
| `alignment`                | `"Left" \| "Center"` | `"Left"` | Layout alignment                        |
| `size`                | `"XS" \| "S" \| "M" \| "L" \| "XL"` | `"L"` | Typography size variant |
| `rightBadgeWrapper` | `boolean`            | `true`   | Toggle supporting content section       |
| `badgeTop`                 | `boolean`            | `false`  | Show badge in top position              |
| `badgeBottom`              | `boolean`            | `true`   | Show badge in bottom position           |
| `showBadge`                | `boolean`            | `true`   | Show the OneUI Badge                    |
| `supportingBadgeLabel`     | `boolean`            | `true`   | Show supporting label next to badge     |
| `supportingBadgeLabelValue`     | `string`             | —        | Supporting label text beside badge      |
| `dataHead`                 | `DataHeadConfig`     | —        | DataLead + SupportingData configuration |
| `badgeConfig`              | `BadgeConfig`        | —        | Badge value and variant configuration   |

### DotGridGroup Config (`dotGridGroupConfig`)

| Prop                               | Type                        | Default        | Description                                  |
| ---------------------------------- | --------------------------- | -------------- | -------------------------------------------- |
| `dotSize`                          | `number`                    | token-resolved | Dot diameter in px. Default: `--Spacing-4`   |
| `dotFillType`                      | `"percentage" \| "counted"` | `"percentage"` | How dot counts are determined                |
| `supportingLabelsTop`              | `boolean`                   | `false`        | Show top labels row inside dot grid          |
| `supportingLabelsBottom`           | `boolean`                   | `false`        | Show bottom labels row inside dot grid       |
| `supportingLabelTopLeftConfig`     | `SupportingLabelSlotConfig` | —              | Top-left label config                        |
| `supportingLabelTopRightConfig`    | `SupportingLabelSlotConfig` | —              | Top-right label config                       |
| `supportingLabelBottomLeftConfig`  | `SupportingLabelSlotConfig` | —              | Bottom-left label config                     |
| `supportingLabelBottomRightConfig` | `SupportingLabelSlotConfig` | —              | Bottom-right label config                    |
| `onCategoryHover`                  | `(data: DotGridHoverData) => void` | — | Callback fired when a category is focused/blurred |
| `valueFormat`                      | `ValueFormatConfig`         | —              | Format config for the value in each category's aria-label and the hover ARIA live text |

### ChartFooter Config (`chartFooterConfig`)

| Prop                   | Type     | Description                    |
| ---------------------- | -------- | ------------------------------ |
| `annotationLeftValue`  | `string` | Source attribution (left slot) |
| `annotationRightValue` | `string` | Additional notes (right slot)  |

### Accessibility Config (`accessibility`)

| Prop        | Type      | Default  | Description                                     |
| ----------- | --------- | -------- | ----------------------------------------------- |
| `enabled`   | `boolean` | `true`   | Enable accessibility wrapper                    |
| `summary`   | `string`  | `"auto"` | Custom summary or `"auto"` for auto-generated   |
| `dataTable` | `boolean` | `true`   | Hidden data table for screen-reader navigation  |
| `ariaLabel` | `string`  | —        | Custom `aria-label` override                    |

## Usage Examples

### Basic Chart

```tsx
<DotGridChart
  data={[
    { id: 'used', category: 'Used', value: 37 },
    { id: 'remaining', category: 'Remaining', value: 63 },
  ]}
  height={500}
  chartHeaderConfig={{
    chartTitleValue: 'Resource usage.',
    chartSubtitleValue: 'Proportional breakdown.',
  }}
/>
```

### Full Configuration

```tsx
<DotGridChart
  data={data}
  width={432}
  height={600}
  chartHeader
  chartLegend
  dataDisplay
  chartFooter
  chartHeaderConfig={{
    chartTitleValue: 'Resource allocation.',
    chartSubtitleValue: 'Proportional breakdown of resource usage.',
  }}
  chartLegendConfig={{ type: 'circle' }}
  dataDisplayConfig={{
    mainLabelValue: 'Active users.',
    dataHead: { dataLeadValue: '2,390', dataSupportingValue: '/ 3,000' },
    badgeConfig: { value: '37%' },
  }}
  dotGridGroupConfig={{ dotFillType: 'percentage' }}
  chartFooterConfig={{
    annotationLeftValue: 'Source: Jio Analytics.',
    annotationRightValue: 'FY 2025–26.',
  }}
  accessibility={{ enabled: true, dataTable: true }}
/>
```

### Full Width

