```tsx
<DotGridChart
  data={data}
  height={500}
  fullWidth
  chartHeaderConfig={{ chartTitleValue: 'Fills the container.' }}
/>
```

### Counted Mode

```tsx
<DotGridChart
  data={[
    { id: 'passed', category: 'Passed', value: 18 },
    { id: 'failed', category: 'Failed', value: 4 },
  ]}
  dotGridGroupConfig={{ dotFillType: 'counted' }}
  chartHeaderConfig={{ chartTitleValue: 'Test results — literal dot counts.' }}
/>
```

### Custom colors per data item

```tsx
<DotGridChart
  data={[
    { id: 'a', category: 'Segment A', value: 30, color: '#e63946' },
    { id: 'b', category: 'Segment B', value: 70 },
  ]}
  chartHeaderConfig={{ chartTitleValue: 'Custom color override.' }}
/>
```

## Design Tokens

All visual values read from the CSS cascade — zero hard-coded values.

| Property        | CSS custom property                        | Layer          |
| --------------- | ------------------------------------------ | -------------- |
| Section gap     | `var(--DotGridChart-gap, var(--Spacing-5))` | CSS module     |
| Colour slot 1   | `var(--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-1)`         | DataVis pipeline |
| Colour slot 2   | `var(--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-2)`         | DataVis pipeline |
| …               | `var(--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-{n})`       | DataVis pipeline |
| Colour slot 12  | `var(--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-12)`        | DataVis pipeline |

The DataVis pipeline tokens are injected by `generateDataVisCSS` → `useStyleInjection` → `@layer brand`. Colours 1–6 come from the brand palette; 7–12 from `datavis-categorical-extended.css`.

## Legend Auto-Generation

When `chartLegend={true}` and no `chartLegendConfig.items` is provided:

1. Scans `data` for unique categories (canonical `category` or legacy `label`).
2. Assigns `color: var(--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-{n})` in slot order (clamped 1–12).
3. Uses `data[n].color` override when present — bypasses token chain.
4. Slices to **12 items maximum**.

## Height Behaviour

`height` controls the **total chart height**. The `DotGridGroup` wrapper uses `flex: 1` to fill the remaining vertical space after header, legend, DataDisplay, and footer.

```
┌────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  ChartHeader                           │  ← auto height
├────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  ChartLegend (optional)                │  ← auto height
├────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  DataDisplay (optional)                │  ← auto height
├────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                        │
│          DotGridGroup                  │  ← flex: 1 (fills remaining)
│                                        │
├────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  ChartFooter                           │  ← auto height
└────────────────────────────────────────┘
          Total height: `height` prop
```

## Entry Animation

When `animated={true}`, dots fade in with a diagonal wave from the top-left toward the bottom-right. Each dot's delay is `(row + col) × offsetDelay`. Timing values resolve from motion tokens (`--Motion-Duration-Expressive-*`, `--Motion-Easing-*`) — no hard-coded milliseconds.

### Data Transition

After the entry wave settles (`entrySettled = true`), swapping the `data` prop triggers a simultaneous `background-color` crossfade on all dots. The transition is gated so entry and transition animations never overlap.

## Accessibility

Three-layer ARIA pattern:

1. **`ChartAccessibility` wrapper** — `role="figure"`, auto-generated summary, hidden data table, `aria-live` region.
2. **`useChartAccessibility` hook** — debounces hover/focus data into the live region. Announces: `"{category}, {value}, {percentage}% of total"`.
3. **`useRovingTabIndex` inside `DotGridGroup`** — category-level keyboard navigation. `ArrowLeft` / `ArrowRight` move between categories.

See `ChartAccessibility.md` for full `AccessibilityConfig` options.

## Files

| File                          | Description                  |
| ----------------------------- | ---------------------------- |
| `DotGridChart.tsx`            | Component implementation     |
| `DotGridChart.module.css`     | Shell layout (structural CSS) |
| `index.ts`                    | Named re-exports             |
| `DotGridChart.stories.tsx`    | Storybook stories (13+)      |
| `DotGridChart.test.tsx`       | Unit tests                   |
| `DotGridChart.md`             | This documentation           |

title: HistogramChart
text:
HistogramChart
`HistogramChart` is the top-level orchestration wrapper for histogram visualisations. It composes:
@jds4/oneui-datavis
@jds4/oneui-datavis/components/charts/HistogramChart
# HistogramChart

## Overview

`HistogramChart` is the top-level orchestration wrapper for histogram visualisations. It composes:

- **ChartHeader** — title and subtitle
- **ChartLegend** — categorical colour key
- **DataDisplay** — KPI block (optional, static or hover-driven)
- **HistogramGroup** — flexible-width bars, Y-axis, X-axis, AvgLine, HoverBadge
- **ChartFooter** — source and annotation text

All visual values come from the CSS cascade — no hard-coded pixels, colours, or font sizes. Brand, theme, platform, and density tokens are injected at `@layer brand` by `generateDataVisCSS` (DataVis palette) and `useBrandCSSNew` (surface/typography). There is no `modes` prop.

## Figma Reference

- **Node ID**: `233:31161`
- **Design File**: DataVis-Components
- **URL**: `https://www.figma.com/design/uA5ExvS0cNXbDEKzT9Rnrt/DataVis-Components?node-id=233-31161`

## Architecture

```
HistogramChart
├── ChartAccessibility (wrapper — role="figure", aria-live region, hidden data table)
│   └── histogramChart (container — CSS module, width/height from props)
│       ├── ChartHeader (optional — chartHeader boolean)
│       │   ├── ChartTitle
│       │   └── ChartSubtitle
│       ├── ChartLegend (optional — chartLegend boolean)
│       │   └── ChartKey[]
│       ├── DataDisplay (optional — dataDisplay boolean)
│       │   ├── mainLabel
│       │   ├── DataHead (DataLead + SupportingData + SupportingLabel)
│       │   └── Badge (BadgeConfig)
│       ├── histogramGroupWrapper (flex: 1 — fills remaining height)
│       │   └── HistogramGroup
│       │       ├── YAxis (optional)
│       │       ├── barWrapper
│       │       │   └── verticalBar[] (flex: 1 fill; barPositive + barNegative
│       │       │                       split, auto, when data has negatives)
│       │       ├── xAxis ticks (optional)
│       │       ├── ZeroLine (auto, only when data has negatives)
│       │       ├── AvgLine (optional)
│       │       └── HoverBadge (optional)
│       └── ChartFooter (optional — chartFooter boolean)
│           ├── annotationLeft
│           └── annotationRight
```

## Token Pipeline

```
Convex → generateDataVisCSS → useStyleInjection → @layer brand
                                                    → --DataVis-Categorical-Bold-{1..12}
useBrandCSSNew → @layer brand
                 → --Surface-* --Text-* --Spacing-* --Typography-*
```

Bar colours: `catColor(n)` returns `"var(--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-${n})"` — resolved in the browser at render time. No JS hex resolution.

Section gap: `var(--HistogramChart-gap, var(--Spacing-5))` — consumer-overridable, default from `--Spacing-5`.

## Import

```tsx
import { HistogramChart } from '@oneui/datavis';
```

## Data Format

```typescript
import type { ChartDataPoint } from '@oneui/datavis';

const data: ChartDataPoint[] = [
  { category: '0–10', value: 5 },
  { category: '10–20', value: 12 },
  { category: '20–30', value: 25 },
  { category: '30–40', value: 45 },
];
```

Negative values are supported out of the box — no extra prop. `HistogramGroup` auto-detects negative values from `data` (same as `VerticalBarChart`/`VerticalBarGroup`) and renders bars above/below a zero line accordingly. See **HistogramGroup.md → Negative Values** for the full rendering model.

```typescript
const netChangeData: ChartDataPoint[] = [
  { category: 'Jan', value: -8 },
  { category: 'Feb', value: 12 },
];
```

## Props Interface

Three-layer pattern — no Layer 1 `modes` prop; brand/theme/density come from the CSS cascade.

```
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ LAYER 2: Parent Component Props                      │
│ data, width, height, fullWidth                       │
│ chartHeader, chartFooter, chartLegend, dataDisplay   │
│ interactive, animated, accessibility                 │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
                          ↓
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ LAYER 3: Child Component Configs                     │
│ chartHeaderConfig, chartLegendConfig                 │
│ dataDisplayConfig, histogramGroupConfig              │
│ chartFooterConfig                                    │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

### Layer 2: Parent Props

| Prop            | Type                  | Default | Description                                               |
| --------------- | --------------------- | ------- | --------------------------------------------------------- |
| `data`          | `ChartDataPoint[]`    | `[]`    | Array of `{ category, value }` data points               |
| `width`         | `number \| string`    | `346`   | Total chart width                                         |
| `height`        | `number \| string`    | `400`   | Total chart height — HistogramGroup fills remaining space |
| `fullWidth`     | `boolean`             | `false` | Stretch chart to 100% of parent container width           |
| `chartHeader`   | `boolean`             | `true`  | Toggle ChartHeader (title + subtitle)                     |
| `chartFooter`   | `boolean`             | `true`  | Toggle ChartFooter (annotations)                          |
| `chartLegend`   | `boolean`             | `true`  | Toggle ChartLegend                                        |
| `dataDisplay`   | `boolean`             | `false` | Toggle DataDisplay block above the histogram              |
| `interactive`   | `boolean`             | `true`  | Enable bar hover/click interactivity                      |
| `animated`      | `boolean`             | `false` | Staggered entry animation on first load                   |
| `accessibility` | `AccessibilityConfig` | `{}`    | ARIA wrapper, live region, hidden data table              |

### Layer 3: ChartHeader Config

| Prop                 | Type     | Default | Description         |
| -------------------- | -------- | ------- | ------------------- |
| `chartTitleValue`    | `string` | —       | Chart title text    |
| `chartSubtitleValue` | `string` | —       | Chart subtitle text |

### Layer 3: ChartLegend Config

| Prop                 | Type                           | Default    | Description                                |
| -------------------- | ------------------------------ | ---------- | ------------------------------------------ |
| `items`              | `ChartLegendItem[]`            | —          | Manual legend items (overrides auto-gen)   |
| `categoryLabelValue` | `string`                       | —          | Single-series label (ignored if `items` set) |
| `type`               | `'circle' \| 'dashed' \| 'line'` | `'circle'` | Colour indicator shape                     |
| `dataHead`           | `boolean`                      | `false`    | Show DataHead block inside legend item     |
| `dataHeadConfig`     | `object`                       | `{}`       | DataHead props — `dataLeadValue`, `dataSupportingValue`, `supportingLabelValue` |

### Layer 3: HistogramGroup Config

| Prop                    | Type                                     | Default      | Description                                                       |
| ----------------------- | ---------------------------------------- | ------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `yAxis`                 | `boolean`                                | `true`       | Y-axis with gridlines                                             |
| `xAxis`                 | `boolean`                                | `true`       | X-axis bin tick row                                               |
| `avgLine`               | `boolean`                                | `false`      | Average (or threshold) line                                       |
| `hoverBadge`            | `boolean`                                | `false`      | Cursor-following hover badge                                      |
| `valueFormat`           | `ValueFormatConfig`                      | —            | Format config — cascades to Y-axis, AvgLine, hover badge          |
| `color`                 | `string`                                 | —            | Custom bar colour (overrides `colorIndex`)                        |
| `colorIndex`            | `number` (1–12)                          | `1`          | Categorical palette slot — resolves `--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-{n}` |
| `onBarHover`            | `(data: HistogramBarHoverData) => void`  | —            | Fired on bar hover enter/leave                                    |
| `onBarClick`            | `(data: HistogramBarHoverData) => void`  | —            | Fired on bar click                                                |
| `hoveredBarIndex`       | `number \| number[]`                     | —            | Back-compat alias for `highlightedBarIndices`                     |
| `highlightedBarIndices` | `number[]`                               | —            | Indices at full opacity — all others dim                          |
| `dataSort`              | `'asc' \| 'desc' \| 'unsorted'`          | `'unsorted'` | Sort bars before render                                           |
| `yAxisConfig`           | `HistogramYAxisConfig`                   | `{}`         | `{ tickCount, formatValue, yAxisLabel, yAxisLabelValue, axisTickSkipper, skippedTicks }` |
| `xAxisConfig`           | `HistogramXAxisConfig`                   | `{}`         | `{ labels, tickCount }`                                           |
| `avgLineConfig`         | `HistogramAvgLineConfig`                 | `{}`         | `{ type, thresholdValue, formatValue }`                           |
| `hoverBadgeConfig`      | `HistogramHoverBadgeConfig`              | `{}`         | `{ formatValue, formatHoverBadge }`                               |

### Layer 3: ChartFooter Config

| Prop                   | Type     | Default | Description           |
| ---------------------- | -------- | ------- | --------------------- |
| `annotationLeftValue`  | `string` | —       | Left annotation text  |
| `annotationRightValue` | `string` | —       | Right annotation text |

### Layer 3: DataDisplay Config

DataDisplayConfig mirrors `DataDisplayProps` and adds chart-specific hover-mode props.

#### Chart-specific

| Prop                    | Type                                        | Default    | Description                               |
| ----------------------- | ------------------------------------------- | ---------- | ----------------------------------------- |
| `mode`                  | `'static' \| 'hover'`                       | `'static'` | Static values or hover-driven updates     |
| `formatHoverLeadValue`  | `(value, category?, index?) => string`      | —          | Custom formatter for lead value on hover  |
| `formatHoverBadgeValue` | `(value, category?, index?) => string`      | —          | Custom formatter for badge value on hover |

#### DataDisplay Layer 2 props

| Prop                       | Type                          | Default  | Description                                 |
| -------------------------- | ----------------------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------- |
| `mainLabelValue`           | `string`                      | —        | Label text above the data value             |
| `type`                     | `'Left' \| 'Center'`          | `'Left'` | Layout — horizontal or vertical stacked     |
| `rightBadgeWrapper` | `boolean`                     | `true`   | Toggle right/below supporting section       |
| `badgeTop`                 | `boolean`                     | `false`  | Toggle top badge slot                       |
| `badgeBottom`              | `boolean`                     | `true`   | Toggle bottom badge slot                    |
| `showBadge`                | `boolean`                     | `true`   | Toggle badge visibility                     |
| `supportingBadgeLabel`     | `boolean`                     | `true`   | Toggle label text next to badge             |
| `supportingBadgeLabelValue`     | `string`                      | —        | Label text next to badge                    |
| `size`                | `'XS' \| 'S' \| 'M' \| 'L' \| 'XL'` | `'L'` | Typography size variant              |
| `responsiveCollapse`       | `boolean`                     | `true`   | Collapse supporting section below threshold |
| `responsiveCollapseThreshold` | `number`                   | `440`    | Pixel width threshold for collapse          |
| `formatLabelText`          | `boolean`                     | `true`   | Auto-format label per Figma text rules      |
| `formatOptions`            | `FormatLabelOptions`          | —        | Options for label formatting                |

#### DataDisplay Layer 3 configs

**`dataHead`** (`DataHeadConfig`):

| Prop                  | Type               | Default | Description                        |
| --------------------- | ------------------ | ------- | ---------------------------------- |
| `dataLeadValue`       | `number \| string` | —       | Primary value                      |
| `dataSupportingValue` | `number \| string` | —       | Secondary value beside the lead    |
| `supportingData`      | `boolean`          | `false` | Toggle supporting value            |
| `supportingLabel`     | `boolean`          | `false` | Toggle supporting label            |
| `supportingLabelValue` | `string`           | —       | Supporting label text              |
| `valueFormat`         | `ValueFormatConfig`| —       | Format config for lead value       |

**`badgeConfig`** (`BadgeConfig`):

| Prop           | Type                                       | Default      | Description                          |
| -------------- | ------------------------------------------ | ------------ | ------------------------------------ |
| `value`        | `number \| string`                         | —            | Badge value                          |
| `appearance`   | `ComponentAppearance`                      | `'primary'`  | Role-based colour                    |
| `autoDetect`   | `boolean`                                  | `false`      | Auto-detect positive/negative from value |
| `iconSlot`     | `'Icon' \| 'None'`                         | `'Icon'`     | Toggle badge icon                    |
| `valueFormat`  | `ValueFormatConfig`                        | —            | Format config for badge value        |

### Accessibility Config

| Prop        | Type               | Default  | Description                   |
| ----------- | ------------------ | -------- | ----------------------------- |
| `enabled`   | `boolean`          | `true`   | Enable accessibility features |
| `dataTable` | `boolean`          | `true`   | Include hidden data table     |
| `summary`   | `string \| 'auto'` | `'auto'` | Visually-hidden summary text  |
| `ariaLabel` | `string`           | —        | Custom `aria-label` override  |

## Usage Examples

### Basic

```tsx
<HistogramChart
  data={[
    { category: '0–10', value: 5 },
    { category: '10–20', value: 25 },
    { category: '20–30', value: 45 },
  ]}
  chartHeaderConfig={{
    chartTitleValue: 'Score Distribution',
    chartSubtitleValue: 'Distribution of test scores',
  }}
  histogramGroupConfig={{
    yAxis: true,
    xAxis: true,
    avgLine: true,
    hoverBadge: true,
  }}
  chartFooterConfig={{
    annotationLeftValue: 'Source: Internal data',
    annotationRightValue: 'Q4 2025',
  }}
/>
```

### Full-width

```tsx
<HistogramChart
  data={data}
  fullWidth
  chartHeaderConfig={{ chartTitleValue: 'Score Distribution' }}
  histogramGroupConfig={{ hoverBadge: true }}
/>
```

### Currency format

```tsx
<HistogramChart
  data={revenueData}
  histogramGroupConfig={{
    yAxis: true,
    xAxis: true,
    avgLine: true,
    hoverBadge: true,
    valueFormat: { type: 'currency', currency: 'INR', abbreviate: true },
  }}
/>
```

### Threshold line

```tsx
<HistogramChart
  data={data}
  histogramGroupConfig={{
    avgLine: true,
    avgLineConfig: { type: 'threshold', thresholdValue: 30 },
  }}
/>
```

### Minimal (bars only)

```tsx
<HistogramChart
  data={data}
  chartHeader={false}
  chartFooter={false}
  chartLegend={false}
  histogramGroupConfig={{ yAxis: true, xAxis: true }}
/>
```

### With DataDisplay (static KPI)

```tsx
<HistogramChart
  data={data}
  dataDisplay
  dataDisplayConfig={{
    mode: 'static',
    mainLabelValue: 'Total count',
    dataHead: {
      dataLeadValue: '2,390',
      dataSupportingValue: '/ 3,000',
      supportingData: true,
    },
    badgeConfig: {
      value: '+79.6%',
      appearance: 'positive',
    },
  }}
/>
```

### With DataDisplay (hover-driven)

```tsx
<HistogramChart
  data={data}
  dataDisplay
  dataDisplayConfig={{
    mode: 'hover',
    mainLabelValue: 'Hover a bin',
    dataHead: { dataLeadValue: '—' },
    badgeConfig: { value: '—', autoDetect: true },
  }}
  histogramGroupConfig={{ hoverBadge: false }}
/>
```

### With DataDisplay (hover + custom formatters)

```tsx
<HistogramChart
  data={data}
  dataDisplay
  dataDisplayConfig={{
    mode: 'hover',
    formatHoverLeadValue: (value) => `${value} responses`,
    formatHoverBadgeValue: (value) => {
      const total = data.reduce((s, d) => s + d.value, 0);
      return `${((value / total) * 100).toFixed(1)}%`;
    },
  }}
/>
```

## Height Behaviour

`height` controls the **total** container height. `HistogramGroup` fills all remaining vertical space after the other children.

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────┐
│  ChartHeader (title + subtitle)     │  ← auto height
├─────────────────────────────────────┤
│  ChartLegend (optional)             │  ← auto height
├─────────────────────────────────────┤
│  DataDisplay (optional)             │  ← auto height
├─────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                     │
│         HistogramGroup              │  ← flex: 1
│  (YAxis + bars + XAxis + AvgLine)   │
│                                     │
├─────────────────────────────────────┤
│  ChartFooter (optional)             │  ← auto height
└─────────────────────────────────────┘
         Total: height prop
```

`HistogramGroup` receives `height="100%"` and uses `ResizeObserver` to measure its actual pixel height for D3 scale computation.

## Animation

`animated={true}` enables a staggered grow-from-zero entry animation on first render. Each bar has an individual delay proportional to its index. Subsequent data-change transitions animate bar heights and AvgLine position smoothly. See **HistogramGroup.md** for the full entry settlement gate and token chains.

## Accessibility

`ChartAccessibility` wraps the entire chart and provides:

- `role="figure"` with `aria-label` and `aria-describedby`
- Visually-hidden natural-language summary
- Hidden `<table>` for screen reader navigation
- `aria-live="polite"` region for hover announcements

Announcements are debounced and include the bin label, value, and percentage of total:

> _"20–30, 25, 15.3% of total"_

When `dataDisplay={true}`, each bar gets `aria-controls` pointing to the DataDisplay element — assistive technology is informed that interacting with a bar updates that region.

See **HistogramGroup.md** → Accessibility for bar-level keyboard navigation, roving `tabindex`, and ARIA attributes.

## Migration from Old API

| Old                                  | New                           | Notes                                            |
| ------------------------------------ | ----------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------ |
| `modes={{ fullWidth: true }}`        | `fullWidth={true}`            | Direct prop — no more `modes` object             |
| `modes={{ Platform, Density, ... }}` | Removed                       | CSS cascade — injected globally by Storybook / app |
| `dataBadgeSemantic`                  | `showBadge`                   | Renamed in `DataDisplayConfig`                   |
| `dataBadgeSemanticConfig`            | `badgeConfig`                 | Renamed; `dataBadgeSemanticValue` → `value`      |
| `avgLineConfig.dataBadge`            | Removed                       | AvgLine no longer has a DataBadge prop           |
| `colorIndex` description "(1-6)"     | `(1–12)`                      | Full 12-slot DataVis palette                     |
| `HistogramDataPoint[]`               | `ChartDataPoint[]`            | Use canonical format; `HistogramDataPoint` deprecated |
| `export default HistogramChart`      | `export function HistogramChart` | Named export                                   |

## Files

| File                         | Description              |
| ---------------------------- | ------------------------ |
| `HistogramChart.tsx`         | Component implementation |
| `HistogramChart.module.css`  | Structural CSS (gap token bridge) |
| `HistogramChart.stories.tsx` | Storybook stories (9 sections, 21 stories) |
| `HistogramChart.test.tsx`    | Unit tests               |
| `index.ts`                   | Named re-exports         |

## Related

- **HistogramGroup.md** — bar rendering, D3 scale, AvgLine, keyboard navigation
- **VerticalBarChart.md** — fixed-width bar chart (same orchestration pattern)
- **ChartHeader.md**, **ChartLegend.md**, **ChartFooter.md**, **DataDisplay.md**
- **DATAVIS-SETUP.md** — DataVis CSS pipeline, `generateDataVisCSS`, `useStyleInjection`

title: HorizontalBarChart
HorizontalButterflyBarChart
text:
HorizontalButterflyBarChart
The HorizontalButterflyBarChart displays two series growing outward from a center axis, commonly used for:
@jds4/oneui-datavis
@jds4/oneui-datavis/components/charts/HorizontalButterflyBarChart
# HorizontalButterflyBarChart

## Overview

The HorizontalButterflyBarChart displays two series growing outward from a center axis, commonly used for:

- Population pyramids (age distribution by gender)
- Year-over-year comparisons (2023 vs 2024)
- Before/after analysis
- Any dual-series comparison with a shared dimension

## Figma Reference

- **Node ID**: `262:8111`
- **Design File**: DataVis-Components
- **Figma URL**: https://www.figma.com/design/uA5ExvS0cNXbDEKzT9Rnrt/DataVis-Components?node-id=262-8111

## Architecture

```
HorizontalButterflyBarChart (flex column, gap: var(--Spacing-5))
├── ChartHeader (optional, if chartHeader=true)
│   ├── ChartTitle
│   └── ChartSubtitle
├── ChartLegend (optional, if chartLegend=true)
│   └── ChartKey[] (auto-generated or manual items)
├── DataDisplay (optional, if dataDisplay=true)
│   ├── contentLeft
│   │   ├── mainLabel
│   │   └── DataHead (DataLead + SupportingData + SupportingLabel)
│   └── contentRight (Badge)
├── HorizontalButterflyBarGroup (flex: 1)
│   ├── contentWrapper
│   │   └── HorizontalButterflyBar[] (for each category)
│   └── XAxis (dual mirrored scales)
└── ChartFooter (optional, if chartFooter=true)
    ├── annotationLeft
    └── annotationRight
```

## Import

```tsx
import { HorizontalButterflyBarChart } from './charts/HorizontalButterflyBarChart';
```

## Data Formats

Uses canonical `ChartSeriesDataPoint[]` format with exactly 2 series per category:

```tsx
const data: ChartSeriesDataPoint[] = [
  { category: '0–14',  series: 'Male',   value: 15 },
  { category: '0–14',  series: 'Female', value: 18 },
  { category: '15–24', series: 'Male',   value: 22 },
  { category: '15–24', series: 'Female', value: 24 },
];
```

The first series (by `seriesOrder` or insertion order) becomes the left bar; the second becomes the right bar.

## Props

### Top-level props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data` | `ChartSeriesDataPoint[]` | required | Chart data — 2 series per category |
| `width` | `number \| string` | `420` | Container width (px or CSS string). Ignored when `fullWidth=true` |
| `height` | `number \| string` | `500` | Container height (px or CSS string). Ignored when `barGroupConfig.autoHeight=true` |
| `fullWidth` | `boolean` | — | Stretch to 100% of parent width |
| `chartHeader` | `boolean` | `true` | Show/hide the header (title + subtitle) |
| `chartFooter` | `boolean` | `true` | Show/hide the footer (annotations) |
| `chartLegend` | `boolean` | `true` | Show/hide the colour legend |
| `dataDisplay` | `boolean` | `false` | Show/hide the DataDisplay (lead value) slot |
| `interactive` | `boolean` | `true` | Enable keyboard navigation and hover |
| `animated` | `boolean` | `false` | Animate bars on mount |
| `chartHeaderConfig` | `ChartHeaderConfig` | `{}` | Header slot configuration |
| `chartLegendConfig` | `ChartLegendConfig` | `{}` | Legend slot configuration |
| `dataDisplayConfig` | `DataDisplayConfig` | `{}` | DataDisplay slot configuration |
| `barGroupConfig` | `BarGroupConfig` | `{}` | Bar group slot configuration |
| `chartFooterConfig` | `ChartFooterConfig` | `{}` | Footer slot configuration |
| `accessibility` | `AccessibilityConfig` | — | Accessibility overrides |

### ChartHeaderConfig

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `chartTitleValue` | `string` | `undefined` | Chart title text |
| `chartSubtitleValue` | `string` | `undefined` | Chart subtitle text |
| `title` | `boolean` | `true` | Show/hide the title |
| `subtitle` | `boolean` | `true` | Show/hide the subtitle |
| `titleId` | `string` | `undefined` | DOM id forwarded to the rendered title element; wired to accessibility's `aria-labelledby` |
| `subtitleId` | `string` | `undefined` | DOM id forwarded to the rendered subtitle element; wired to accessibility's `aria-describedby` |

### ChartLegendConfig

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `items` | `ChartLegendItem[]` | `undefined` | Manual legend items (overrides auto-generated) |
| `leftLabel` | `string` | Auto-detected | Override left series legend label |
| `rightLabel` | `string` | Auto-detected | Override right series legend label |
| `type` | `'circle' \| 'dashed' \| 'line'` | `'circle'` | Legend swatch shape |
| `dataHead` | `boolean` | `false` | Show DataHead block in both auto-generated legend items (left + right) |
| `dataHeadConfig` | `object` | `undefined` | DataHead configuration applied to both auto-generated legend items (see sub-table below) |
| `size` | `'XS' \| 'S' \| 'M' \| 'L' \| 'XL'` | `undefined` | Typography size variant controlling legend item scaling |
| `ariaLabel` | `string` | `"Chart legend"` | Forwarded to ChartLegend's `aria-label` |
| `ariaLabelledBy` | `string` | `undefined` | Forwarded to ChartLegend's `aria-labelledby`; takes precedence over `ariaLabel` when set |

> **Note**: `categoryLabelValue` (a single-series legend label, documented on `HorizontalBarChart`) does not apply here — butterfly charts are always 2-series, so use `leftLabel`/`rightLabel` instead.

#### `dataHeadConfig` (nested inside `chartLegendConfig`)

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `dataLeadValue` | `number \| string` | `undefined` | Lead value for DataHead (e.g., `"₹2,390"`) |
| `dataSupportingValue` | `number \| string` | `undefined` | Supporting value (e.g., `"/ 3,000"`) |
| `supportingLabelValue` | `string` | `undefined` | Supporting label text for DataHead |
| `supportingData` | `boolean` | `undefined` | Show/hide the supporting value |
| `supportingLabel` | `boolean` | `undefined` | Show/hide the supporting label |

### BarGroupConfig

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `seriesOrder` | `[string, string]` | auto-detect | Pins which series maps left vs. right |
| `labelOutside` | `boolean` | `false` | Show value labels outside bar bounds |
| `labelInside` | `boolean` | `false` | Show value labels inside bar segments |
| `categoryLabel` | `boolean` | `true` | Show category labels on the centre axis |
| `xAxis` | `boolean` | `true` | Show the dual x-axis scale |
| `valueFormat` | `ValueFormatConfig` | — | Numeric formatting configuration |
| `barHeight` | `string` | `'M'` | Bar row height (`'XS'` / `'S'` / `'M'` / `'L'` / `'XL'`) |
| `categoryLabelWidth` | `number` | — | Fixed width for the centre label column |
| `hoverBadge` | `boolean` | `false` | Show badge tooltip on bar hover |
| `hoverBadgeConfig` | `HoverBadgeConfig` | — | Badge tooltip configuration |
| `onBarHover` | `(data: ButterflyBarGroupHoverData) => void` | — | Hover event callback |
| `onBarClick` | `(data: ButterflyBarGroupHoverData) => void` | — | Click event callback |
| `hoveredRowIndex` | `number` | — | Controlled hovered row (external state) |
| `xAxisConfig` | `XAxisConfig` | — | Axis tick and label configuration |
| `dataSort` | `DataSortOrder` | — | `'asc'` / `'desc'` — sort rows by combined value |
| `autoHeight` | `boolean` | `false` | Auto-collapse the chart container's height to fit its content (header + legend + dataDisplay + bars + X-axis + footer) instead of stretching to `height`. See [Auto height (content-driven)](#auto-height-content-driven) |
| `overflowType` | `'truncated' \| 'all'` | — | How to handle label overflow |

### DataDisplayConfig

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | `'static' \| 'hover'` | `'static'` | Static shows fixed values; hover updates on bar hover |
| `mainLabelValue` | `string` | — | Placeholder label shown above the lead value |
| `formatHoverLeadValue` | `(value, category?) => string` | — | Custom formatter for hover lead value |
| `formatHoverBadgeValue` | `(value, category?) => string` | — | Custom formatter for hover badge value |
| `alignment` | `'Left' \| 'Center'` | — | Layout alignment |
| `rightBadgeWrapper` | `boolean` | — | Show supporting content wrapper |
| `badgeTop` | `boolean` | — | Position badge above the lead value |
| `badgeBottom` | `boolean` | — | Position badge below the lead value |
| `showBadge` | `boolean` | — | Show or hide the badge |
| `supportingBadgeLabel` | `boolean` | — | Show supporting label on the badge |
| `supportingBadgeLabelValue` | `string` | — | Text for the supporting badge label |
| `size` | `'XS' \| 'S' \| 'M' \| 'L' \| 'XL'` | — | DataDisplay size variant |
| `dataHead` | `DataHeadConfig` | — | Lead value and badge config (see DataDisplay docs) |
| `badgeConfig` | `BadgeConfig` | `{}` | Configuration for the badge — `value` updates dynamically on hover |

> **Badge value in hover mode**: in hover mode, the per-bar badge value is set via
> `badgeConfig.value` (a sibling of `dataHead`, not nested inside it). The chart
> populates this automatically when `dataDisplayConfig.mode="hover"`.

### ChartFooterConfig

| Prop | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `annotationLeftValue` | `string` | Left annotation text (typically a data source) |
| `annotationRightValue` | `string` | Right annotation text (typically a unit note) |
| `annotationLeft` | `boolean` | Show/hide left annotation |
| `annotationRight` | `boolean` | Show/hide right annotation |

## Usage Examples

### Minimal

```tsx
import { HorizontalButterflyBarChart } from './charts/HorizontalButterflyBarChart';

<HorizontalButterflyBarChart
  data={populationData}
  width={500}
  height={550}
  barGroupConfig={{ seriesOrder: ['Male', 'Female'] }}
/>
```

### With header and legend

```tsx
<HorizontalButterflyBarChart
  data={populationData}
  width={500}
  height={550}
  chartHeader
  chartLegend
  chartHeaderConfig={{
    chartTitleValue: 'Population Distribution',
    chartSubtitleValue: 'By age group and gender',
  }}
  barGroupConfig={{
    seriesOrder: ['Male', 'Female'],
    labelOutside: true,
  }}
/>
```

### Full width

```tsx
<HorizontalButterflyBarChart
  data={populationData}
  height={550}
  fullWidth
  chartHeader
  chartLegend
  chartHeaderConfig={{ chartTitleValue: 'Population Distribution' }}
  barGroupConfig={{ seriesOrder: ['Male', 'Female'], labelOutside: true }}
/>
```

### Sorted descending

```tsx
<HorizontalButterflyBarChart
  data={populationData}
  width={500}
  height={550}
  chartHeader
  chartLegend
  chartHeaderConfig={{ chartTitleValue: 'Population — Sorted' }}
  barGroupConfig={{
    seriesOrder: ['Male', 'Female'],
    dataSort: 'desc',
    labelOutside: true,
  }}
/>
```

### Hover DataDisplay

```tsx
<HorizontalButterflyBarChart
  data={populationData}
  width={500}
  height={580}
  chartHeader
  chartLegend
  dataDisplay
  interactive
  chartHeaderConfig={{ chartTitleValue: 'Population Distribution' }}
  dataDisplayConfig={{
    mode: 'hover',
    mainLabelValue: 'Hover a bar to see details',
  }}
  barGroupConfig={{
    seriesOrder: ['Male', 'Female'],
    labelOutside: true,
  }}
/>
```

### Static DataDisplay

```tsx
<HorizontalButterflyBarChart
  data={populationData}
  width={500}
  height={580}
  chartHeader
  chartLegend
  dataDisplay
  chartHeaderConfig={{ chartTitleValue: 'Population Distribution' }}
  dataDisplayConfig={{
    mode: 'static',
    mainLabelValue: 'Age Group',
    dataHead: { dataLeadValue: '22M' },
  }}
  barGroupConfig={{
    seriesOrder: ['Male', 'Female'],
    labelOutside: true,
  }}
/>
```

### With hover badge

```tsx
<HorizontalButterflyBarChart
  data={populationData}
  width={500}
  height={550}
  interactive
  barGroupConfig={{
    seriesOrder: ['Male', 'Female'],
    labelOutside: true,
    hoverBadge: true,
  }}
/>
```

### With footer

```tsx
<HorizontalButterflyBarChart
  data={populationData}
  width={500}
  height={580}
  chartHeader
  chartFooter
  chartHeaderConfig={{ chartTitleValue: 'Population Distribution' }}
  chartFooterConfig={{
    annotationLeftValue: 'Source: Census 2024',
    annotationRightValue: 'Values in millions',
  }}
  barGroupConfig={{ seriesOrder: ['Male', 'Female'], labelOutside: true }}
/>
```

### Auto height (content-driven)

```tsx
<HorizontalButterflyBarChart
  data={sparseData}
  width={500}
  chartHeader
  chartLegend
  chartHeaderConfig={{ chartTitleValue: 'Product Comparison' }}
  barGroupConfig={{
    seriesOrder: ['2023', '2024'],
    autoHeight: true,
    labelOutside: true,
  }}
/>
```

When the dataset has only one or a few rows, the default fixed-height layout leaves rows at the top of the butterfly-bar area and the dual X-axis pinned to the bottom of the chart, with a large void in between. Set `barGroupConfig.autoHeight: true` to collapse the chart container to fit its content instead:

- The chart container's `height` prop is **ignored** — the container collapses to `header + legend + dataDisplay + bars + X-axis + footer` at their natural sizes
- The chart's `barGroupWrapper` switches from `flex: 1` to `flex: 0 0 auto` so the group doesn't stretch
- `HorizontalButterflyBarGroup.autoHeight: true` is forwarded so the group switches its `contentWrapper` to `flex: 0 0 auto` with a token-driven gap between rows — the dual X-axis sits immediately below the last row

Unlike `HorizontalBarChart`/`HorizontalDumbbellChart` (where `autoHeight` is a top-level chart prop), this chart nests it under `barGroupConfig.autoHeight` — check the top of this doc's Props table for the current location before wiring it up.

### Minimal — bars only

```tsx
<HorizontalButterflyBarChart
  data={populationData}
  width={480}
  height={500}
  chartHeader={false}
  chartLegend={false}
  dataDisplay={false}
  chartFooter={false}
  barGroupConfig={{
    seriesOrder: ['Male', 'Female'],
    labelOutside: true,
  }}
/>
```

## Legend Auto-detection

When `chartLegendConfig.items` is not supplied, the chart auto-detects two series names from `data` (or uses `seriesOrder` when provided) and creates legend items using the DataVis categorical colour tokens:

```
Series 0 → var(--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-1)
Series 1 → var(--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-2)
```

Use `chartLegendConfig.leftLabel` / `rightLabel` to show a display-friendly label in the legend without changing `seriesOrder`.

Set `chartLegendConfig.dataHead: true` (optionally with `dataHeadConfig`) to show a DataHead value block in both auto-generated legend items, and `chartLegendConfig.size` to control the legend's typography scale — both are applied identically to the left and right legend item, since a butterfly chart's legend always describes exactly two series:

```tsx
<HorizontalButterflyBarChart
  data={populationData}
  chartLegend
  chartLegendConfig={{
    dataHead: true,
    dataHeadConfig: { dataLeadValue: '42%' },
    size: 'L',
  }}
/>
```

## Design Tokens

| CSS Custom Property | Resolves To | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `--HorizontalButterflyBarChart-containerGap` | `var(--Spacing-5)` | Gap between chart slots (overridable) |
| `--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-1` | Brand categorical token | Left series bar and legend colour |
| `--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-2` | Brand categorical token | Right series bar and legend colour |

## Accessibility

The component is wrapped by the shared `ChartAccessibility` component (`src/components/ChartAccessibility.tsx`), enabled by default. It renders `role="figure"` with `aria-label`/`aria-describedby`, a visually hidden data table for screen readers, and an auto-generated accessible summary (worded for `chartType="butterfly-bar"`). The `accessibility` prop passes through to `AccessibilityConfig`:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `boolean` | `true` | Enable/disable all accessibility features. When `false`, the chart renders its content directly with no wrapper, hidden table, or live region |
| `summary` | `string` | Auto-generated | Custom summary text (overrides auto-generation) |
| `dataTable` | `boolean` | `true` | Render the visually-hidden data table for screen readers |
| `ariaLabel` | `string` | Auto-generated | Override the chart's `aria-label` |

An ARIA live region announces the hovered bar value when `interactive=true`.

## Files

| File | Role |
|---|---|
| `HorizontalButterflyBarChart.tsx` | Component implementation |
| `HorizontalButterflyBarChart.module.css` | Structural container styles |
| `index.ts` | Public barrel — named exports + type re-exports |
| `HorizontalButterflyBarChart.stories.tsx` | 13 Storybook stories |
| `HorizontalButterflyBarChart.test.tsx` | 33 unit tests |
| `HorizontalButterflyBarChart.md` | This file |

title: HorizontalDumbbellChart
text:
HorizontalDumbbellChart
Top-level orchestration wrapper for the horizontal dumbbell chart. Composes `ChartHeader`, `ChartLegend`, `DataDisplay`, `HorizontalDumbbellBarGroup`, `ChartFooter`, and `ChartAccessibility` into a complete dumbbell (gap/barbell) visualisation. Each category renders two dots connected by a stem, positioned along a shared D3 linear scale.
@jds4/oneui-datavis
@jds4/oneui-datavis/components/charts/HorizontalDumbbellChart
# HorizontalDumbbellChart

## Overview

Top-level orchestration wrapper for the horizontal dumbbell chart. Composes `ChartHeader`, `ChartLegend`, `DataDisplay`, `HorizontalDumbbellBarGroup`, `ChartFooter`, and `ChartAccessibility` into a complete dumbbell (gap/barbell) visualisation. Each category renders two dots connected by a stem, positioned along a shared D3 linear scale.

All design tokens come from the OneUI brand CSS cascade — no runtime JS token resolver, no `modes` prop. Categorical colors (`var(--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-1)`, `var(--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-2)`) resolve via the DataVis CSS pipeline (`generateDataVisCSS` → `@layer brand`).

## Figma Reference

- **Node ID**: `274:14998`
- **Figma URL**: https://www.figma.com/design/uA5ExvS0cNXbDEKzT9Rnrt/DataVis-Components?node-id=274-14998

## Architecture

```
HorizontalDumbbellChart (node 274:14998)
│   className={styles.container}  — gap via CSS module two-layer token
│   wrapped by ChartAccessibility (chartType="horizontal-bar")
│
├── ChartHeader          (conditional: chartHeader)
├── ChartLegend          (conditional: chartLegend)
├── DataDisplay          (conditional: dataDisplay, id=dataDisplayId)
├── barGroupWrapper      (className={styles.barGroupWrapper}, flex inline)
│   └── HorizontalDumbbellBarGroup
│       ├── HorizontalDumbbellBar[] (role="button", roving tabIndex)
│       ├── ZeroLine     (auto, aria-hidden)
│       ├── XAxis        (conditional: xAxis, aria-hidden)
│       └── HoverBadge   (conditional: hoverBadge, aria-hidden)
└── ChartFooter          (conditional: chartFooter)
```

## Files

| File | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `HorizontalDumbbellChart.tsx` | Component implementation |
| `HorizontalDumbbellChart.module.css` | CSS module — gap token, barGroupWrapper |
| `HorizontalDumbbellChart.stories.tsx` | 15 Storybook stories |
| `HorizontalDumbbellChart.test.tsx` | Unit tests |
| `HorizontalDumbbellChart.md` | This file |
| `index.ts` | Barrel export |

## Import

```tsx
import { HorizontalDumbbellChart } from '@oneui/datavis';
// or from the local path:
import { HorizontalDumbbellChart } from './HorizontalDumbbellChart';
```

## Data Formats

### Direct Format (DumbbellDataPoint[])

```tsx
const data: DumbbellDataPoint[] = [
  { category: 'Germany', value1: 1200, value2: 3500 },
  { category: 'France',  value1: 1800, value2: 4200 },
];

<HorizontalDumbbellChart data={data} />
```

### Canonical Format (ChartSeriesDataPoint[]) — Recommended

```tsx
const data: ChartSeriesDataPoint[] = [
  { category: 'Germany', series: '2024', value: 1200 },
  { category: 'Germany', series: '2025', value: 3500 },
  { category: 'France',  series: '2024', value: 1800 },
  { category: 'France',  series: '2025', value: 4200 },
];

<HorizontalDumbbellChart
  data={data}
  seriesOrder={['2024', '2025']}
/>
```

## Props

### HorizontalDumbbellChartProps

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `data` | `ChartSeriesDataPoint[] \| DumbbellDataPoint[]` | `[]` | Data to visualise (2 series per category) |
| `seriesOrder` | `[string, string]` | (auto) | Maps series to value1 (left dot) and value2 (right dot) |
| `width` | `number \| string` | `420` | Chart width |
| `height` | `number \| string` | `500` | Chart height |
| `fullWidth` | `boolean` | `false` | Fill parent container width |
| `autoHeight` | `boolean` | `false` | Collapse container to fit content; eliminates void gap on sparse data |
| `chartHeader` | `boolean` | `true` | Toggle ChartHeader (title + subtitle) |
| `chartFooter` | `boolean` | `true` | Toggle ChartFooter (annotations) |
| `chartLegend` | `boolean` | `true` | Toggle ChartLegend |
| `dataDisplay` | `boolean` | `false` | Toggle DataDisplay KPI section |
| `interactive` | `boolean` | `true` | Enable hover/click interactivity |
| `animated` | `boolean` | `false` | Entry animation — dumbbells expand from center with staggered fade-in |
| `chartHeaderConfig` | `ChartHeaderConfig` | `{}` | ChartHeader configuration |
| `chartLegendConfig` | `ChartLegendConfig` | `{}` | ChartLegend configuration |
| `dataDisplayConfig` | `DataDisplayConfig` | `{}` | DataDisplay configuration |
| `barGroupConfig` | `BarGroupConfig` | `{}` | HorizontalDumbbellBarGroup configuration |
| `chartFooterConfig` | `ChartFooterConfig` | `{}` | ChartFooter configuration |
| `accessibility` | `AccessibilityConfig` | `undefined` | Accessibility config for screen readers |

### ChartHeaderConfig

| Prop | Type | Description |
|------|------|-------------|
| `chartTitleValue` | `string` | Title text |
| `chartSubtitleValue` | `string` | Subtitle text |
| `subtitle` | `boolean` | Toggle subtitle visibility |

### ChartLegendConfig

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `items` | `ChartLegendItem[]` | — | Manual legend items (highest priority) |
| `seriesLabels` | `[string, string]` | — | Auto-generates 2-item legend with categorical colors 1 and 2 |
| `type` | `"circle" \| "dashed" \| "line"` | `"circle"` | Indicator type |
| `dataHead` | `boolean` | `false` | Toggle DataHead in legend items |
| `dataHeadConfig` | `object` | `{}` | DataHead config for legend items |

### BarGroupConfig

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `leftLabels` | `boolean` | `false` | Left value labels outside |
| `rightLabels` | `boolean` | `false` | Right value labels outside |
| `categoryLabels` | `boolean` | `true` | Category labels on the left |
| `categoryLabelMaxWidth` | `number \| "auto"` | `"auto"` | Fixed px width or `"auto"` to measure widest label |
| `categoryLabelMaxLines` | `number` | `1` | Max lines per label. `1` = ellipsis; `>1` = CSS line-clamp |
| `xAxis` | `boolean` | `true` | X-axis at the bottom |
| `hoverBadge` | `boolean` | `false` | Cursor-following DataBadge on hover |
| `valueFormat` | `ValueFormatConfig` | — | Auto-format axis, bar labels, and hover badge values |
| `barHeight` | `string` | `"M"` | T-shirt sizing: `XS`, `S`, `M`, `L`, `XL`, `2XL` |
| `hoverType` | `DumbbellHoverType` | `"individual"` | `"individual"`, `"group"`, or `"categorical"` |
| `onBarHover` | `(data: HorizontalDumbbellBarHoverData) => void` | — | Hover callback |
| `onBarClick` | `(data: HorizontalDumbbellBarHoverData) => void` | — | Click callback |
| `highlightedBarIndices` | `number[]` | — | Indices at full opacity; others dim |
| `hoveredBarIndex` | `number \| number[]` | — | Back-compat alias for `highlightedBarIndices` |
| `xAxisConfig` | `DumbbellXAxisConfig` | — | `{ tickCount, formatValue, xAxisLabel, xAxisLabelValue }` |
| `hoverBadgeConfig` | `DumbbellHoverBadgeConfig` | — | `{ formatValue, formatBadge }` |
| `overflowType` | `"truncated" \| "all"` | `"truncated"` | `"truncated"` removes bottom rows that don't fit; `"all"` renders all |

### DataDisplayConfig

Chart-specific props (dumbbell receives two values per hovered row):

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `mode` | `"static" \| "hover"` | `"static"` | Static or hover-driven updates |
| `formatHoverLeadValue` | `(v1, v2, category?) => string` | — | Custom hover lead value formatter |
| `formatHoverBadgeValue` | `(v1, v2, category?) => string` | — | Custom hover badge value formatter |
| `mainLabelValue` | `string` | — | Main label text |
| `alignment` | `"Left" \| "Center"` | — | Layout alignment |
| `rightBadgeWrapper` | `boolean` | — | Toggle supporting section |
| `badgeTop` / `badgeBottom` | `boolean` | — | Toggle badge slots |
| `showBadge` | `boolean` | — | Toggle all badge instances |
| `supportingBadgeLabel` | `boolean` | — | Toggle supporting label next to badge |
| `supportingBadgeLabelValue` | `string` | — | Supporting label text |
| `size` | `"XS" \| "S" \| "M" \| "L" \| "XL"` | — | Typography size variant |
| `dataHead` | `DataHeadConfig` | — | Lead/supporting value config |
| `badgeConfig` | `BadgeConfig` | — | Badge value, appearance, variant |

### ChartFooterConfig

| Prop | Type | Description |
|------|------|-------------|
| `annotationLeft` | `boolean` | Toggle left annotation |
| `annotationLeftValue` | `string` | Left annotation text |
| `annotationRight` | `boolean` | Toggle right annotation |
| `annotationRightValue` | `string` | Right annotation text |

## Usage Examples

### Basic

```tsx
<HorizontalDumbbellChart
  data={[
    { category: 'Germany', value1: 1200, value2: 3500 },
    { category: 'France',  value1: 1800, value2: 4200 },
  ]}
  width={440}
  height={400}
/>
```

### Full anatomy

```tsx
<HorizontalDumbbellChart
  data={canonicalData}
  seriesOrder={['2024', '2025']}
  width={480}
  height={500}
  chartHeader
  chartFooter
  chartLegend
  dataDisplay
  chartHeaderConfig={{
    chartTitleValue: 'European Market Range.',
    chartSubtitleValue: '2024 vs 2025 by region.',
  }}
  chartLegendConfig={{ seriesLabels: ['2024', '2025'] }}
  dataDisplayConfig={{
    mode: 'hover',
    mainLabelValue: 'Hover a bar.',
    dataHead: { dataLeadValue: '—', supportingData: false },
    badgeConfig: { value: '—' },
  }}
  barGroupConfig={{
    categoryLabels: true,
    xAxis: true,
    hoverBadge: true,
    xAxisConfig: { tickCount: 6 },
    barHeight: 'M',
  }}
  chartFooterConfig={{
    annotationLeftValue: 'Source: Finance.',
    annotationRightValue: '*Values in thousands GBP.',
  }}
  accessibility={{ enabled: true, dataTable: true }}
/>
```

### With currency formatting

```tsx
<HorizontalDumbbellChart
  data={data}
  barGroupConfig={{
    valueFormat: { type: 'currency', currency: 'INR', abbreviate: true },
    categoryLabels: true,
    xAxis: true,
  }}
/>
```

### Auto height for sparse data

```tsx
<HorizontalDumbbellChart
  data={[
    { category: 'Before', value1: 1200, value2: 3500 },
    { category: 'After',  value1: 2800, value2: 5100 },
  ]}
  autoHeight
  width={440}
  barGroupConfig={{ categoryLabels: true, xAxis: true }}
/>
```

## Token Pipeline

All design tokens are resolved via CSS at render time — no JS resolver:

```
Convex brand data
  → generateDataVisCSS
  → useStyleInjection
  → @layer brand on :root

Chart reads:
  var(--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-1)   ← dot 1 color
  var(--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-2)   ← dot 2 color
  var(--Spacing-5)                    ← container gap (via CSS module)
```

## CSS Module

```css
/* Two-layer hook pattern — consumers can override via CSS custom property */
.container {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: var(--HorizontalDumbbellChart-gap, var(--Spacing-5));
  box-sizing: border-box;
  position: relative;
}

/* flex set inline — exempt (prop-driven: autoHeight toggles 0 0 auto vs 1) */
.barGroupWrapper {
  width: 100%;
  min-height: 0;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}
```

## Type Exports

```ts
export type { HorizontalDumbbellChartProps, BarGroupConfig, DataDisplayConfig }
  from './HorizontalDumbbellChart';

// Re-exported from child packages:
export type { DumbbellDataPoint, HorizontalDumbbellBarHoverData, DumbbellHoverType,
  DumbbellXAxisConfig, DumbbellHoverBadgeConfig }
  from '../../groups/HorizontalDumbbellBarGroup';
export type { ChartSeriesDataPoint, CategoryValue } from '../../../types/chart-data';
export type { ChartLegendItem } from '../../groups/ChartLegend';
export type { ValueFormatConfig } from '../../../utils/formatValue';
export type { AccessibilityConfig } from '../../ChartAccessibility';
export type { DataHeadConfig, BadgeConfig } from '../../groups/DataDisplay';
```

## Legend Auto-Generation

Priority order (highest first):

1. `chartLegendConfig.items` — manual items
2. `chartLegendConfig.seriesLabels` or `seriesOrder` — 2-item legend with `var(--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-1/2)`
3. Auto-detect from canonical `ChartSeriesDataPoint[]` unique series
4. Fallback: `"Series 1"` / `"Series 2"`

## DataDisplay in Hover Mode

When `dataDisplayConfig.mode = "hover"`:

| State | `mainLabelValue` | `dataHead.dataLeadValue` | `badgeConfig.value` |
|-------|-----------------|--------------------------|---------------------|
| Idle | `configMainLabelValue` | `configDataHead.dataLeadValue` | `configBadgeConfig.value` |
| Hovered | hovered category name | `"v1 – v2"` (or `formatHoverLeadValue`) | `"X.X%"` diff (or `formatHoverBadgeValue`) |

## Zero Line

A vertical zero line appears automatically when the data domain spans zero. Positioned at x=0 on the D3 scale, aligned with the bars area. No configuration needed.

## Height Behavior

- Fixed height: `height` prop controls total container height; bar group stretches via `flex: 1` to fill the remainder after header/legend/DataDisplay/footer.
- `autoHeight`: container collapses to content height — bar group uses `flex: 0 0 auto`. Eliminates void gap on sparse (1–2 bar) data.

## Accessibility

Wrapped by `ChartAccessibility` (enabled by default):

| Layer | Feature |
|-------|---------|
| Chart wrapper | `role="figure"`, auto-summary, hidden `<table>` |
| Live region | `useChartAccessibility` → announces hovered data to screen readers |
| aria-controls | Bars link to `DataDisplay` via `dataDisplayId` |
| Bar group | `useRovingTabIndex` with `orientation: "vertical"` |
| Each bar | `role="button"`, `aria-label`, `data-roving-item` |
| Decorative | ZeroLine, XAxis, HoverBadge all `aria-hidden="true"` |

### Keyboard Navigation

| Key | Action |
|-----|--------|
| `Tab` | Focus enters first dumbbell |
| `ArrowDown` / `ArrowUp` | Move to next/prev dumbbell (wraps) |
| `Home` / `End` | First / last dumbbell |
| `Enter` / `Space` | Trigger click handler |
| `Tab` (again) | Exit the bar group |

LayeredAreaChart3D
LayeredAreaChart3D is an isometric 3D area chart that renders layered area series as stacked planes in a perspective view. It reuses the same D3 area generators as `AreaChart` (layered mode), with mathematical coordinate projection applied to every point to create a convincing 3D isometric perspective.
@jds4/oneui-datavis
@jds4/oneui-datavis/components/charts/LayeredAreaChart3D
# LayeredAreaChart3D

## Overview

LayeredAreaChart3D is an isometric 3D area chart that renders layered area series as stacked planes in a perspective view. It reuses the same D3 area generators as `AreaChart` (layered mode), with mathematical coordinate projection applied to every point to create a convincing 3D isometric perspective.

This chart supports hover-only interactivity (series highlighting & dimming), configurable depth order, optional grid lines, and axis labels — all rendered directly inside the SVG via isometric projection.

**This component follows the [Organized Props Pattern](./OrganizedPropsPattern.md).**

## Architecture

```
LayeredAreaChart3D
├── ChartAccessibility
│   └── Chart container (CSS module: LayeredAreaChart3D.module.css)
│       ├── ChartHeader (optional)
│       │   ├── ChartTitle
│       │   └── ChartSubtitle
│       ├── ChartLegend (optional, works with any colorType)
│       │   └── ChartKey[] (one per series, colors auto-match palette)
│       ├── DataDisplay (optional, static or hover-driven)
│       ├── SequentialChartKey (optional, sequential colour type)
│       ├── DivergingChartKey (optional, diverging colour type)
│       ├── LayeredAreaGroup3D
│       │   └── SVG (preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet")
│       │       ├── Grid lines (isometric)
│       │       ├── Area paths (painter's algorithm, back → front)
│       │       ├── Axis labels (category, value, series)
│       │       └── Badge (optional, cursor-following hover badge)
│       └── ChartFooter (optional)
│           └── annotation slots (source, notes — inline typography tokens)
```

**Token Resolution**: All colors come from the CSS cascade via Convex → generateDataVisCSS → useStyleInjection → @layer brand. No runtime JS token resolver; no modes prop.

## Import

```tsx
import LayeredAreaChart3D from "./charts/LayeredAreaChart3D";
import type {
  AreaGroup3DConfig,
  SequentialChartKeyConfig,
  DivergingChartKeyConfig,
  DepthOrder,
  ChartSeriesDataPoint,
  ChartLegendItem,
} from "./charts/LayeredAreaChart3D";
```

## Quick Start

```tsx
const data: ChartSeriesDataPoint[] = [
  { category: "Jan", series: "Revenue", value: 100 },
  { category: "Feb", series: "Revenue", value: 120 },
  { category: "Mar", series: "Revenue", value: 115 },
  { category: "Jan", series: "Expenses", value: 80 },
  { category: "Feb", series: "Expenses", value: 85 },
  { category: "Mar", series: "Expenses", value: 90 },
];

<LayeredAreaChart3D
  data={data}
  width={500}
  height={420}
  chartHeaderConfig={{
    chartTitleValue: "Revenue vs Expenses",
    chartSubtitleValue: "Isometric 3D view",
  }}
/>;
```

## Props Interface

### LayeredAreaChart3DProps (Layer 2 — Parent)

| Prop                 | Type                                      | Default    | Description                                                                                                   |
| -------------------- | ----------------------------------------- | ---------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `data`               | `ChartSeriesDataPoint[] \| AreaGroupData` | _required_ | Chart data (canonical format recommended)                                                                     |
| `seriesOrder`        | `string[]`                                | —          | Explicit series ordering                                                                                      |
| `width`              | `number \| string`                        | `420`      | Chart width (the isometric group auto-derives its height from the viewBox aspect ratio)                       |
| `height`             | `number \| string`                        | `450`      | Chart height (applies to the overall wrapper including header + footer)                                       |
| `fullWidth`          | `boolean`                                 | `false`    | Stretch chart to fill parent container width                                                                  |
| `chartHeader`        | `boolean`                                 | `true`     | Show header (title + subtitle)                                                                                |
| `chartFooter`        | `boolean`                                 | `true`     | Show footer (annotations)                                                                                     |
| `chartLegend`        | `boolean`                                 | `true`     | Show dot legend (works with any `colorType` — colours auto-match the active palette)                          |
| `dataDisplay`        | `boolean`                                 | `false`    | Show DataDisplay component above the area group                                                               |
| `sequentialChartKey` | `boolean`                                 | `false`    | Show gradient key for sequential/diverging colour types (renders `SequentialChartKey` or `DivergingChartKey`) |
| `interactive`        | `boolean`                                 | `true`     | Enable hover highlighting                                                                                     |
| `animated`           | `boolean`                                 | `false`    | Enable entry animation                                                                                        |
| `hoverBadge`         | `boolean`                                 | `false`    | Show a cursor-following Badge on series hover                                                                 |
| `accessibility`      | `AccessibilityConfig`                     | —          | Screen reader configuration                                                                                   |

### Layer 3 — Child Configs

#### chartHeaderConfig

| Prop                 | Type      | Default | Description       |
| -------------------- | --------- | ------- | ----------------- |
| `chartTitleValue`    | `string`  | —       | Chart title       |
| `chartSubtitleValue` | `string`  | —       | Chart subtitle    |
| `subtitle`           | `boolean` | `true`  | Show subtitle row |

#### areaGroup3DConfig

| Prop                     | Type                                           | Default         | Description                                                                                  |
| ------------------------ | ---------------------------------------------- | --------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `curveStyle`             | `"Sharp" \| "Curved"`                          | `"Curved"`      | Area path curve interpolation                                                                |
| `valueFormat`            | `ValueFormatConfig`                            | —               | Value formatting for axis labels and hover badge (see formatValue.ts)                        |
| `onSeriesHover`          | `(data \| null) => void`                       | —               | Hover callback                                                                               |
| `hoveredSeriesIndex`     | `number \| null`                               | —               | Controlled hover state                                                                       |
| `dataSort`               | `DataSortOrder`                                | `"unsorted"`    | Category sort order                                                                          |
| `animated`               | `boolean`                                      | —               | Override parent animated prop                                                                |
| `depthOrder`             | `"dataOrder" \| "reverse"`                     | `"dataOrder"`   | Front-to-back ordering                                                                       |
| `depthSpacing`           | `number`                                       | `1`             | Z-axis distance between series                                                               |
| `gridLines`              | `boolean`                                      | `false`         | Show isometric grid lines                                                                    |
| `categoryLabels`         | `boolean`                                      | `true`          | Show series names at the far edge of each depth plane                                        |
| `categoryLabelTickCount` | `number`                                       | —               | Max number of series labels to show (evenly spaced, always first + last). Undefined = all.   |
| `yAxis`                  | `boolean`                                      | `false`         | Show value tick labels                                                                       |
| `xAxis`                  | `boolean`                                      | `true`          | Show category labels                                                                         |
| `isometricAlign`         | `"left" \| "right"`                            | `"right"`       | Isometric perspective direction — `"right"` recedes upper-right, `"left"` recedes upper-left |
| `colorType`              | `"categorical" \| "sequential" \| "diverging"` | `"categorical"` | Colour palette type                                                                          |
| `sequentialColorSet`     | `1 \| 2 \| 3 \| 4 \| 5 \| 6`                   | `1`             | Sequential palette number (only when `colorType="sequential"`)                               |
| `sequentialSteps`        | `number`                                       | `9`             | Number of sequential gradient steps 1-9 (only when `colorType="sequential"`)                 |
| `divergingSteps`         | `number`                                       | `5`             | Number of diverging steps per side 1-5 (only when `colorType="diverging"`)                   |
| `ariaControlsId`         | `string`                                       | —               | ID of the element controlled by the keyboard-focusable data-point overlays (`aria-controls`) |

#### chartLegendConfig

| Prop    | Type                | Default | Description                          |
| ------- | ------------------- | ------- | ------------------------------------ |
| `items` | `ChartLegendItem[]` | auto    | Override auto-generated legend items |

#### dataDisplayConfig

Configuration for the DataDisplay component (static or hover-driven).

| Prop                     | Type                         | Default    | Description                                                                  |
| ------------------------ | ---------------------------- | ---------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `mode`                   | `"static" \| "hover"`        | `"static"` | "static": values from props always shown. "hover": values update on hover.  |
| `formatHoverLeadValue`   | `(total, name?) => string`   | —          | Custom formatter for the lead value in hover mode                            |
| `formatHoverBadgeValue`  | `(total, name?) => string`   | —          | Custom formatter for the badge value in hover mode                           |
| `mainLabelValue`         | `string`                     | —          | Main category label above the data value                                     |
| `type`                   | `"Left" \| "Center"`         | `"Left"`   | Layout type: horizontal or vertical stacked                                  |
| `rightBadgeWrapper` | `boolean`                  | `true`     | Toggle right/bottom supporting section                                       |
| `badgeTop`               | `boolean`                    | `false`    | Toggle badgeTop slot                                                         |
| `badgeBottom`            | `boolean`                    | `true`     | Toggle badgeBottom slot                                                      |
| `showBadge`              | `boolean`                    | `true`     | Toggle the OneUI Badge in supporting slots                                   |
| `supportingBadgeLabel`   | `boolean`                    | `true`     | Toggle the SupportingLabel next to the badge                                 |
| `supportingBadgeLabelValue`   | `string`                     | —          | Supporting label text next to the badge                                      |
| `size`              | `"XS" \| "S" \| "M" \| "L" \| "XL"` | `"L"` | Typography size variant                                                      |
| `dataHead`               | `DataHeadConfig`             | —          | Configuration for the DataHead child component                               |
| `badgeConfig`            | `BadgeConfig`                | —          | Configuration for the Badge + SupportingLabel in supporting slots            |

#### sequentialChartKeyConfig

Used when `sequentialChartKey={true}` and `colorType="sequential"`.

| Prop                  | Type                  | Default  | Description                                                 |
| --------------------- | --------------------- | -------- | ----------------------------------------------------------- |
| `mainLabel`           | `boolean`             | `true`   | Show label above the gradient bar                           |
| `mainLabelValue`      | `string`              | `""`     | Label text                                                  |
| `lowestDataValue`     | `string \| number`    | auto     | Left axis tick (auto-derived from data min if not set)      |
| `highestDataValue`    | `string \| number`    | auto     | Right axis tick (auto-derived from data max if not set)     |
| `barHeight`           | `number`              | `8`      | Height of the gradient bar in pixels                        |
| `type`                | `"step" \| "blend"`   | `"step"` | Discrete segments or smooth gradient                        |
| `numberFormatOptions` | `NumberFormatOptions` | —        | Formatting options for numeric tick values                  |
| `valueFormat`         | `ValueFormatConfig`   | —        | Structured format config — overrides `numberFormatOptions` when set |
| `indicatorTracker`    | `boolean`             | `false`  | Show indicator circle on hover (requires `interactive` too) |

#### divergingChartKeyConfig

Used when `sequentialChartKey={true}` and `colorType="diverging"`.

| Prop                  | Type                   | Default  | Description                                                        |
| --------------------- | ---------------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `mainLabel`           | `boolean`              | `true`   | Show label above the gradient bar                                  |
| `mainLabelValue`      | `string`               | `""`     | Label text                                                         |
| `tickValues`          | `(string \| number)[]` | auto     | Tick values along the axis (defaults to `[min, 0, max]` from data) |
| `lowestDataValue`     | `string \| number`     | —        | Override for the lowest tick value                                 |
| `highestDataValue`    | `string \| number`     | —        | Override for the highest tick value                                |
| `numberOfSteps`       | `number`               | derived  | Color steps per side 1-5 (defaults to `ceil(sequentialSteps / 2)`) |
| `barHeight`           | `number`               | `8`      | Height of the gradient bar in pixels                               |
| `type`                | `"step" \| "blend"`    | `"step"` | Discrete segments or smooth gradient                               |
| `numberFormatOptions` | `NumberFormatOptions`  | —        | Formatting options for numeric tick values                         |
| `valueFormat`         | `ValueFormatConfig`    | —        | Structured format config — overrides `numberFormatOptions` when set |
| `indicatorTracker`    | `boolean`              | `false`  | Show indicator circle on hover (requires `interactive` too)        |

#### chartFooterConfig

| Prop                   | Type     | Default | Description             |
| ---------------------- | -------- | ------- | ----------------------- |
| `annotationLeftValue`  | `string` | —       | Footer left annotation  |
| `annotationRightValue` | `string` | —       | Footer right annotation |

## Design Tokens

All visual properties are resolved from the CSS cascade via Convex → generateDataVisCSS → useStyleInjection → @layer brand. No runtime JS token resolver; no modes prop.

| CSS Custom Property                      | Usage                                                         | Fallback                    |
| ---------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------- |
| `--Typography-Font-Primary`              | All SVG text labels (axis, series)                            | `'JioType Var', sans-serif` |
| `--Body-FontWeight-Low`                  | All text labels (axis ticks, series names)                    | `400`                       |
| `--Label-S-FontSize`                      | Base font size (converted to viewBox units)                   | `14`                        |
| `--Text-Low`                              | All text label fill (axis ticks, series names)                | Theme-dependent             |
| `--Stroke-M`                              | Grid line stroke width (converted to viewBox units)           | `1`                         |
| `--Stroke-L`                              | Depth/axis line and area path stroke width                    | `1.5`                       |
| `--Spacing-2`                             | Label gap from axis (converted to viewBox units)              | `8`                         |
| `--Shape-1`                               | Container border radius                                       | `4`                         |
| `--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-{1-N}`        | Area fill colors (one per series, matching legend key colors) | Theme-dependent             |
| `--DataVis-Categorical-Hover-{1-N}`       | Dimmed area fill colors on hover                              | Theme-dependent             |
| Motion tokens (easing, duration, offsetDelay) | Entry and data-transition animation                           | Theme-dependent             |

Pixel-based token values (font sizes, stroke widths, spacing) are converted to viewBox coordinate units via a `pxToVB` scaling factor derived from the measured container width and the viewBox width (`vbW / effectiveWidth`). The container is measured dynamically via a `ResizeObserver`, so the chart is fully responsive — font sizes and strokes scale correctly at any container size.

### Sizing modes

The component supports two sizing modes depending on the `height` prop:

| Height prop                            | Behaviour                                                                                                                                                        |
| -------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Not set (default `350`)                | Container uses CSS `aspectRatio` matching the viewBox's natural proportions. Height is auto-derived from width — no letter-boxing.                               |
| Explicit value (`"100%"`, `500`, etc.) | Container uses the given height directly. The SVG scales via `preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet"` to fill the available space both horizontally and vertically. |

When the parent `LayeredAreaChart3D` passes `height="100%"` inside a `flex: 1` wrapper, the isometric group fills the full available height. When used standalone with no height constraint, the aspect-ratio mode ensures the chart derives its height naturally from width.

The viewBox top bound uses a reduced structural height (`Y_RANGE × 0.7`) instead of the full theoretical maximum. This tightens the vertical fit so the isometric content fills the available space without excessive headroom. Any peaks that extend beyond the viewBox edge still render because the SVG uses `overflow: visible`.

The viewBox also accounts for text elements on each side:

- **Category labels** (series names): the viewBox extends on the label side (right for `isometricAlign="right"`, left for `"left"`) based on the longest series name, preventing label clipping.
- **X-axis labels** (category names such as month abbreviations): the viewBox extends on the opposite side to accommodate half the text width of center-anchored labels.
- **Bottom margin**: when `xAxis` is enabled, additional space is reserved below the structural base for labels that hang beneath the front edge.

## Colour Palettes

The `colorType` prop (in `areaGroup3DConfig`) selects which CSS custom property palette is used for area fills, and which key/legend component renders.

| `colorType`               | CSS Custom Properties used                                      | Key component                       | Behaviour                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| ------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `"categorical"` (default) | `--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-{1-N}`, `--DataVis-Categorical-Hover-{1-N}` | `ChartLegend` (dot items)           | One distinct colour per series (up to 12). Hover uses a separate hover colour from the token system.                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `"sequential"`            | `--DataVis-Sequential-Category{set}-{1-steps}`                 | `SequentialChartKey` (gradient bar) | A single-hue ramp distributed evenly across series. Configure with `sequentialColorSet` (1-6) and `sequentialSteps` (1-9).
