When the number of series exceeds `sequentialSteps`, OKLCH colour-space interpolation generates unique per-series shades between the token anchor colours. Hover dims via `dimOpacity`. |
| `"diverging"`             | `--DataVis-Diverging-Negative-{1-5}`, `--DataVis-Diverging-Neutral`, `--DataVis-Diverging-Positive-{1-5}` | `DivergingChartKey` (gradient bar)  | A two-tone ramp from negative through neutral to positive, distributed across series. Configure with `divergingSteps` (1-5). Hover dims via `dimOpacity`.                                                                                                                                                          |

### Key / Legend rendering rules

- **`chartLegend`** (default `true`) renders the `ChartLegend` dot list for **any** `colorType`. The dot colours automatically match the active palette (categorical, sequential, or diverging).
- **`sequentialChartKey`** (default `false`) independently enables a gradient bar key — `SequentialChartKey` when `colorType="sequential"`, `DivergingChartKey` when `colorType="diverging"`. Has no effect when `colorType="categorical"`.
- Both toggles are independent: you can show just the dot legend, just the gradient key, both, or neither.
- When `sequentialChartKey` is enabled, data min/max values are auto-derived for tick labels. Override them via `sequentialChartKeyConfig.lowestDataValue` / `highestDataValue` or `divergingChartKeyConfig.tickValues`.
- Both `SequentialChartKey` and `DivergingChartKey` receive `width="100%"` from `LayeredAreaChart3D` so they stretch to fill the chart container. Their standalone default width is `"328px"`, which would clip inside a wider container without this explicit override.

Legend key colours are always kept in sync with the area fill colours regardless of palette type.

## Isometric Projection

The chart uses standard isometric projection where the X-axis tilts 30° right, the Z-axis tilts 30° left, and the Y-axis is vertical.

For a 3D point `(x, y, z)` where `x` is the category position, `y` is the data value, and `z` is the series depth index:

```
screen_x = x × cos(30°) + z × depthSpacing × cos(30°)
screen_y = −y + x × sin(30°) − z × depthSpacing × sin(30°)
```

The SVG uses `preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet"` to maintain the isometric angle ratio regardless of container size.

## Depth Order

The `depthOrder` prop controls front-to-back ordering of series:

- `"dataOrder"` (default) — First series in the data appears in **front**, last in back.
- `"reverse"` — First series in the data appears in **back**, last in front.

Rendering always follows the painter's algorithm: the backmost series is drawn first so that front series naturally occlude it.

## Depth Spacing

`depthSpacing` (default `1`) controls the Z-axis gap between series planes. Higher values spread series further apart. The viewBox is auto-calculated to fit all projected points.

## Hover & Keyboard Behaviour

When a series is hovered (mouse) or focused (keyboard):

- The active series retains full opacity and its `--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-*` color.
- All other series dim to `dimOpacity` (design token, default 0.2) with `--DataVis-Categorical-Hover-*` color.
- The `onSeriesHover` callback fires with `{ seriesIndex, name, isHovered }`.
- When `hoverBadge` is `true`, a cursor-following `Badge` appears displaying the series name and formatted value. Configure value formatting via `areaGroup3DConfig.valueFormat`.

### Keyboard Navigation

The chart provides keyboard accessibility via `useRovingTabIndex` over series:

- **Tab** into the chart to focus the first series.
- **Arrow Left / Arrow Right** move focus between series (with wrap-around).
- **Focus** triggers the same highlight + live-region announcement as mouse hover.
- **Tab out** clears the active series.

The live region announces `"{series name}, total {sum}"` with 150ms debounce wired through `useChartAccessibility` (which composes `useAriaLiveRegion` internally) to avoid rapid-fire announcements when arrowing quickly.

### Controlled Hover

Use `hoveredSeriesIndex` for controlled hover state (e.g., external list highlighting).

## Animation

With `animated: true` the chart supports two animation phases:

### Entry Animation

On first mount, areas morph from the baseline (flat) to their actual values using SVG `<animate>` elements. Each series staggers by `offsetDelay` ms. Motion tokens (easing, duration, offset delay) are resolved from the `enterAnimation` collection via `useEntryAnimation`.

### Data Transition

When the `data` prop changes after mount, areas smoothly interpolate from their previous paths to the new ones in place — no stagger delay. The transition uses:

- `d3.interpolateString` to build per-path interpolators between old and new SVG `d` attributes
- A `requestAnimationFrame` loop driven by `duration` and `easing` tokens from the `transitionAnimation` collection (via `useDataTransition`)
- A custom cubic-bezier solver that converts the CSS `cubic-bezier(...)` token into a JS easing function

All timing values are resolved from Figma design tokens — no hardcoded animation values.

## Edge Cases

| Case             | Behaviour                                                            |
| ---------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Single series    | Renders as a single isometric area (no depth stacking)               |
| Many series (5+) | Adjust `depthSpacing` to control visual spread; viewBox auto-expands |
| Negative values  | Clamped to 0 — negative areas below the floor are not rendered in 3D |
| Empty data       | Renders an empty container                                           |

## Differences from AreaChart

| Feature             | AreaChart                            | LayeredAreaChart3D                 |
| ------------------- | ------------------------------------ | ---------------------------------- |
| Projection          | Flat 2D                              | Isometric 3D                       |
| Stacking types      | stacked, layered, fullHeight         | Layered only (implicit)            |
| Hover badge         | Yes                                  | Yes (opt-in via `hoverBadge` prop) |
| Keyboard navigation | Yes (roving tab index, per category) | Yes (roving tab index, per series) |
| Y/X Axis components | Standard YAxis / XAxis               | Built-in isometric labels          |
| ViewBox             | `0 0 100 H` (non-uniform)            | Auto-calculated (uniform)          |
| preserveAspectRatio | `"none"`                             | `"xMidYMid meet"`                  |

## Related Components

- [AreaChart](./AreaChart.md) — 2D area chart with full stacking types
- [AreaGroup](./AreaGroup.md) — Core 2D area rendering component

title: LineChart
text:
LineChart
The LineChart component is a complete line chart visualization that combines ChartHeader, ChartLegend, DataDisplay, PathGroup, and ChartFooter components. It supports multiple series with automatic categorical coloring from DataVis CSS tokens, making it ideal for trend visualization, time series data, and multi-series comparisons.
@jds4/oneui-datavis
@jds4/oneui-datavis/components/charts/LineChart
# LineChart

## Overview

The LineChart component is a complete line chart visualization that combines ChartHeader, ChartLegend, DataDisplay, PathGroup, and ChartFooter components. It supports multiple series with automatic categorical coloring from DataVis CSS tokens, making it ideal for trend visualization, time series data, and multi-series comparisons.

All tokens come from the CSS cascade — DataVis palette tokens (`--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-{n}`) via `generateDataVisCSS → useStyleInjection`, and surface/typography tokens via `useBrandCSSNew` — both injected at `@layer brand`. No runtime JS token resolver; no `modes` prop.

**This component follows the [Organized Props Pattern](./OrganizedPropsPattern.md).**

## Figma Reference

- **Node ID**: `133:3117`
- **Design File**: DataVis-Components
- **Figma URL**: https://www.figma.com/design/uA5ExvS0cNXbDEKzT9Rnrt/DataVis-Components?node-id=133-3117

## Architecture

```
ChartAccessibility [role="figure", aria-label, aria-describedby, aria-live region]
└── LineChart
    ├── ChartHeader (optional — chartHeader toggle)
    │   ├── ChartTitle
    │   └── ChartSubtitle
    ├── ChartLegend (optional — chartLegend toggle)
    │   └── ChartKey[] (one per series)
    ├── DataDisplay (optional — dataDisplay toggle, id for aria-controls target)
    │   ├── contentWrapperMain
    │   │   ├── mainLabel
    │   │   └── DataHead (DataLead + SupportingData + SupportingLabel)
    │   └── rightBadgeWrapper (Badge + SupportingLabel)
    ├── PathGroup (always rendered)
    │   ├── YAxis (optional) [aria-hidden]
    │   ├── SVG [aria-hidden]
    │   │   └── Paths
    │   │       └── path[] (one per series)
    │   ├── AvgLine (optional — avgLine toggle) [aria-hidden]
    │   │   ├── line (horizontal reference line)
    │   │   └── DataBadge (value label)
    │   ├── hitAreaPaths (individual mode only, transparent overlays)
    │   ├── HoverLine (tracking mode; individual mode on keyboard focus only) [aria-hidden]
    │   │   ├── topHoverDataLabel
    │   │   ├── lineIndicator
    │   │   └── dots[]
    │   ├── dataPointsGroup [role="group", aria-label="Chart data"]
    │   │   └── dataPoint[] (invisible, one per category)
    │   │       └── role="button", aria-roledescription="data point"
    │   └── XAxis (optional)
    └── ChartFooter (optional — chartFooter toggle)
        ├── annotationLeft (source text)
        └── annotationRight (notes text)
```

## Import

```tsx
import { LineChart } from '@oneui/datavis';
// or from the component directly:
import { LineChart } from './components/charts/LineChart';
```

## Data Formats

### Canonical Format (Recommended)

```typescript
import type { ChartSeriesDataPoint } from '@oneui/datavis';

const data: ChartSeriesDataPoint[] = [
  { category: 'Jan', series: 'Revenue', value: 100 },
  { category: 'Jan', series: 'Expenses', value: 80 },
  { category: 'Feb', series: 'Revenue', value: 120 },
  { category: 'Feb', series: 'Expenses', value: 85 },
];
```

### Legacy Format (Still Supported)

```typescript
import type { PathGroupData } from '@oneui/datavis';

const data: PathGroupData = {
  categories: ['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar'],
  series: [
    { name: 'Revenue', values: [100, 120, 115] },
    { name: 'Expenses', values: [80, 85, 90] },
  ],
};
```

> **Migration Note**: The component internally normalizes both formats. Prefer canonical `ChartSeriesDataPoint[]` for new usage.

## Props Interface (Organized Props Pattern)

```
LineChart Props
│
├── Layer 2: Parent Props ──────────────── data, seriesOrder, width, height, fullWidth, interactive, animated
│
├── Layer 2: Figma Boolean Toggles ─────── chartHeader, chartLegend, dataDisplay, chartFooter
│
└── Layer 3: Child Component Configs
    ├── chartHeaderConfig ──────────────── { chartTitleValue, chartSubtitleValue }
    ├── chartLegendConfig ──────────────── { items, interactiveDataHead, size, ... }
    ├── dataDisplayConfig ──────────────── { mode, mainLabelValue, type, size, dataHead, badgeConfig, showBadge, ... }
    ├── pathGroupConfig ────────────────── { yAxis, xAxis, hoverType, dataSort, avgLine, yAxisConfig, xAxisConfig, hoverLineConfig, avgLineConfig, ... }
    └── chartFooterConfig ──────────────── { annotationLeft, annotationLeftValue, annotationRight, annotationRightValue }
```

## Props

### Parent Component Props (Layer 2)

| Prop            | Type                                      | Default     | Description                                                              |
| --------------- | ----------------------------------------- | ----------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `data`          | `ChartSeriesDataPoint[] \| PathGroupData` | (required)  | Chart data (canonical or legacy format)                                  |
| `seriesOrder`   | `string[]`                                | `undefined` | Order of series names (for canonical format)                             |
| `width`         | `number \| string`                        | `328`       | Width of the chart                                                       |
| `height`        | `number \| string`                        | `400`       | **Total height of the chart.** PathGroup fills remaining space.          |
| `fullWidth`     | `boolean`                                 | `false`     | Stretch chart to 100% of its parent container width                      |
| `interactive`   | `boolean`                                 | `true`      | Enable hover interactivity on lines                                      |
| `animated`      | `boolean`                                 | `false`     | Enable entry animation where paths grow from left to right on first load |
| `accessibility` | `AccessibilityConfig`                     | `undefined` | Accessibility configuration for screen readers                           |

### Figma Boolean Toggles (Layer 2)

| Prop          | Type      | Default | Description                      |
| ------------- | --------- | ------- | -------------------------------- |
| `chartHeader` | `boolean` | `true`  | Toggle visibility of ChartHeader |
| `chartLegend` | `boolean` | `true`  | Toggle visibility of ChartLegend |
| `dataDisplay` | `boolean` | `false` | Toggle visibility of DataDisplay |
| `chartFooter` | `boolean` | `true`  | Toggle visibility of ChartFooter |

### ChartHeader Config (`chartHeaderConfig`)

| Prop                 | Type     | Default     | Description         |
| -------------------- | -------- | ----------- | ------------------- |
| `chartTitleValue`    | `string` | `undefined` | Chart title text    |
| `chartSubtitleValue` | `string` | `undefined` | Chart subtitle text |

### ChartLegend Config (`chartLegendConfig`)

| Prop                         | Type                                                       | Default     | Description                                                                        |
| ---------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- | ----------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `items`                      | `ChartLegendItem[]`                                        | `undefined` | Manual legend items — overrides auto-generation from data                          |
| `interactiveDataHead`        | `boolean`                                                  | `false`     | When true, legend DataHead values update dynamically with hover data               |
| `formatHoverSupportingLabel` | `(category: CategoryValue, seriesIndex: number) => string` | `undefined` | Custom formatter for supporting label text on hover                                |
| `size`                  | `'XS' \| 'S' \| 'M' \| 'L' \| 'XL'`                      | `undefined` | Local size variant controlling font size |

> **Stable legend width**: When `interactiveDataHead` is enabled, the chart pre-computes all possible hover lead values and supporting label texts and passes them to ChartLegend for width stabilization, preventing layout shift when hover values change.

### PathGroup Config (`pathGroupConfig`)

| Prop              | Type                                                                                                  | Default      | Description                                                                                                                             |
| ----------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `yAxis`           | `boolean`                                                                                             | `true`       | Toggle visibility of Y-axis                                                                                                             |
| `xAxis`           | `boolean`                                                                                             | `true`       | Toggle visibility of X-axis                                                                                                             |
| `rounded`         | `boolean`                                                                                             | `true`       | Rounded line caps/joins                                                                                                                 |
| `curveStyle`      | `'Sharp' \| 'Curved' \| 'Stepped'`                                                                    | `'Curved'`   | Line curve style (default from PathGroup)                                                                                                                        |
| `snapToData`      | `boolean`                                                                                             | `false`      | Hover snaps to nearest data point                                                                                                       |
| `dataSort`        | `'unsorted' \| 'asc' \| 'desc'`                                                                       | `'unsorted'` | Sort categories by total absolute value. `'asc'`: lowest first. `'desc'`: highest first.                                                |
| `hoverType`       | `'individual' \| 'tracking' \| 'categorical'`                                                         | `'tracking'` | Hover mode: `'tracking'` (HoverLine), `'individual'` (per-path, badge shows value), `'categorical'` (per-path, badge shows series name) |
| `hoverBadge`      | `boolean`                                                                                             | `false`      | Show cursor-following DataBadge on hover in individual or categorical mode                                                              |
| `avgLine`         | `boolean`                                                                                             | `false`      | Show horizontal average/reference line                                                                                                  |
| `yAxisConfig`     | `{ tickCount, formatValue, valueFormat, yAxisLabel, yAxisLabelValue, axisTickSkipper, skippedTicks }` | `{}`         | Nested YAxis config (includes broken axis support via `skippedTicks`)                                                                   |
| `xAxisConfig`     | `{ tickCount, formatValue, xAxisLabel, xAxisLabelValue }`                                             | `{}`         | Nested XAxis config                                                                                                                     |
| `hoverLineConfig` | `{ lineIndicator, dataBadgeFloatingGroup, topHoverDataLabel, ... }`                                   | `{}`         | Nested HoverLine config                                                                                                                 |
| `hoverBadgeConfig`| `HoverBadgeConfig`                                                                                    | `undefined`  | Nested hover badge config                                                                                                               |
| `avgLineConfig`   | `AvgLineConfig`                                                                                       | `{}`         | Nested AvgLine config (type, threshold, formatValue)                                                                                    |

#### AvgLine Config (`pathGroupConfig.avgLineConfig`)

| Prop             | Type                        | Default     | Description                                                          |
| ---------------- | --------------------------- | ----------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `type`           | `'avg' \| 'threshold'`      | `'avg'`     | `'avg'` computes mean from data; `'threshold'` uses `thresholdValue` |
| `thresholdValue` | `number`                    | `undefined` | Numeric value for threshold positioning on the D3 scale              |
| `formatValue`    | `(value: number) => string` | `undefined` | Custom formatter for the average/threshold badge value               |

### ChartFooter Config (`chartFooterConfig`)

| Prop                   | Type      | Default     | Description                                               |
| ---------------------- | --------- | ----------- | --------------------------------------------------------- |
| `annotationLeft`       | `boolean` | `false`     | Toggle visibility of the left annotation                  |
| `annotationLeftValue`  | `string`  | `undefined` | Left annotation text (e.g. source)                        |
| `annotationRight`      | `boolean` | `false`     | Toggle visibility of the right annotation                 |
| `annotationRightValue` | `string`  | `undefined` | Right annotation text (e.g. notes)                        |

### DataDisplay Config (`dataDisplayConfig`)

Mirrors DataDisplay's Organized Props interface. When `mode` is `'hover'`, `mainLabelValue`, `dataHead.dataLeadValue`, and `badgeConfig.value` update dynamically from hover state.

#### Layer 2 Props

| Prop                       | Type                          | Default    | Description                                     |
| -------------------------- | ----------------------------- | ---------- | ----------------------------------------------- |
| `mode`                     | `'static' \| 'hover'`         | `'static'` | Static uses provided values; hover updates live |
| `mainLabelValue`           | `string`                      | `''`       | Main label text above the data value            |
| `type`                     | `'Left' \| 'Center'`          | `'Left'`   | Layout type: horizontal or vertical             |
| `size`                | `'XS' \| 'S' \| 'M' \| 'L' \| 'XL'` | `'L'` | Typography size variant                    |
| `rightBadgeWrapper` | `boolean`                     | `true`     | Toggle rightBadgeWrapper section         |
| `badgeTop`                 | `boolean`                     | `false`    | Toggle badgeTop slot                            |
| `badgeBottom`              | `boolean`                     | `true`     | Toggle badgeBottom slot                         |
| `showBadge`                | `boolean`                     | `true`     | Toggle the OneUI Badge in supporting slots      |
| `supportingBadgeLabel`     | `boolean`                     | `true`     | Toggle supporting label next to badge           |
| `supportingBadgeLabelValue`     | `string`                      | `''`       | Supporting label text next to badge             |

#### DataHead Config (`dataDisplayConfig.dataHead`)

| Prop                    | Type                | Default | Description                                      |
| ----------------------- | ------------------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------ |
| `dataLeadValue`         | `number \| string`  | `''`    | Lead value (overridden in hover mode)            |
| `dataSupportingValue`   | `number \| string`  | `''`    | Supporting value next to lead value              |
| `valueFormat`           | `ValueFormatConfig` | —       | Format config for numeric lead/supporting values |
| `supportingValueFormat` | `ValueFormatConfig` | —       | Override format for supporting value only        |
| `supportingPrefix`      | `string`            | `'/ '`  | Prefix prepended to supporting value             |
| `supportingData`        | `boolean`           | `true`  | Toggle visibility of SupportingData              |
| `supportingLabel`       | `boolean`           | `false` | Toggle visibility of SupportingLabel             |
| `supportingLabelValue`   | `string`            | `''`    | Supporting label text below values               |

#### Badge Config (`dataDisplayConfig.badgeConfig`)

| Prop          | Type                                          | Default      | Description                                      |
| ------------- | --------------------------------------------- | ------------ | ------------------------------------------------ |
| `value`       | `number \| string`                            | `''`         | Badge value (overridden in hover mode)           |
| `valueFormat` | `ValueFormatConfig`                           | —            | Format config for numeric badge values           |
| `autoDetect`  | `boolean`                                     | `true`       | Auto-detect semantic appearance from value sign  |
| `appearance`  | `'positive' \| 'negative' \| 'warning'`       | `'positive'` | Manual semantic appearance when autoDetect=false |
| `variant`     | `string`                                      | —            | Badge variant override                           |
| `start`       | `React.ReactNode`                             | —            | Leading icon slot                                |

#### Hover Formatters

| Prop                    | Type                                                                                     | Default     | Description                                    |
| ----------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------- | ---------------------------------------------- |
| `formatHoverLeadValue`  | `(values: { seriesIndex: number; value: number }[], category?: CategoryValue) => string` | `undefined` | Custom formatter for lead value in hover mode  |
| `formatHoverBadgeValue` | `(values: { seriesIndex: number; value: number }[], category?: CategoryValue) => string` | `undefined` | Custom formatter for badge value in hover mode |

### Accessibility Config (`accessibility`)

| Prop        | Type      | Default  | Description                                              |
| ----------- | --------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------- |
| `enabled`   | `boolean` | `true`   | Enable accessibility wrapper (ARIA, data table, summary) |
| `summary`   | `string`  | `'auto'` | Custom summary or `'auto'` for auto-generated            |
| `dataTable` | `boolean` | `true`   | Hidden data table for screen reader navigation           |
| `ariaLabel` | `string`  | —        | Custom `aria-label` override for the chart               |

## Usage Examples

### Basic Usage

```tsx
<LineChart data={data} />
```

### Full Configuration

```tsx
<LineChart
  data={data}
  width={400}
  height={280}
  chartHeader
  chartFooter
  chartLegend
  chartHeaderConfig={{
    chartTitleValue: 'Monthly Performance',
    chartSubtitleValue: 'Revenue trends for 2024',
  }}
  pathGroupConfig={{
    yAxis: true,
    xAxis: true,
    curveStyle: 'Sharp',
  }}
  chartFooterConfig={{
    annotationLeft: true,
    annotationLeftValue: 'Source: Finance Department.',
    annotationRight: true,
    annotationRightValue: 'Values in millions.',
  }}
/>
```

### Curved Lines

```tsx
<LineChart
  data={data}
  chartHeaderConfig={{ chartTitleValue: 'Smooth Trend Lines' }}
  pathGroupConfig={{ curveStyle: 'Curved' }}
/>
```

### Single Series (No Legend)

```tsx
<LineChart
  data={singleSeriesData}
  chartLegend={false}
  chartHeaderConfig={{
    chartTitleValue: 'Daily Active Users',
    chartSubtitleValue: 'Weekly trend',
  }}
/>
```

### With DataDisplay (Static Mode)

```tsx
<LineChart
  data={data}
  dataDisplay
  chartHeaderConfig={{
    chartTitleValue: 'Revenue Trend',
    chartSubtitleValue: 'Monthly performance',
  }}
  dataDisplayConfig={{
    mode: 'static',
    mainLabelValue: 'Total revenue',
    showBadge: true,
    dataHead: {
      dataLeadValue: '£2,390',
      dataSupportingValue: '/ 3,000',
      supportingLabel: true,
      supportingLabelValue: 'Monthly target',
    },
    badgeConfig: {
      value: '+23.5%',
      autoDetect: true,
    },
  }}
/>
```

### With DataDisplay (Hover Mode)

DataDisplay updates dynamically when hovering over the chart:

```tsx
<LineChart
  data={data}
  dataDisplay
  chartHeaderConfig={{ chartTitleValue: 'Revenue Trend' }}
  dataDisplayConfig={{
    mode: 'hover',
    mainLabelValue: 'Hover to see values',
    showBadge: true,
    dataHead: {
      dataLeadValue: '—',
      supportingData: false,
    },
    badgeConfig: {
      value: '—',
      autoDetect: false,
    },
  }}
/>
```

### With DataDisplay (Hover Mode + Custom Formatters)

```tsx
<LineChart
  data={data}
  dataDisplay
  dataDisplayConfig={{
    mode: 'hover',
    mainLabelValue: 'Select a point',
    formatHoverLeadValue: (values) => {
      const total = values.reduce((sum, v) => sum + v.value, 0);
      return `£${total.toLocaleString()}`;
    },
    formatHoverBadgeValue: (values) => {
      const firstValue = values[0]?.value ?? 0;
      return `${firstValue > 0 ? '+' : ''}${firstValue.toFixed(1)}%`;
    },
  }}
/>
```

### Controlled X-Axis Ticks (Time Series)

```tsx
<LineChart
  data={yearlyData}
  chartHeaderConfig={{
    chartTitleValue: 'Change in Infant Mortality in India',
    chartSubtitleValue: 'Per 1,000 live births, 1981–2023',
  }}
  pathGroupConfig={{
    curveStyle: 'Curved',
    yAxis: true,
    yAxisConfig: { tickCount: 4 },
    xAxisConfig: { tickCount: 8 },
    snapToData: true,
  }}
/>
```

### With Average Line

```tsx
<LineChart
  data={data}
  pathGroupConfig={{
    avgLine: true,
    avgLineConfig: {
      formatValue: (value) => `${value.toFixed(1)}%`,
    },
  }}
/>
```

### With Threshold Line

```tsx
<LineChart
  data={yearlyData}
  chartHeaderConfig={{
    chartTitleValue: 'Infant Mortality in India',
    chartSubtitleValue: 'Per 1,000 live births, 1981–2023',
  }}
  pathGroupConfig={{
    curveStyle: 'Curved',
    avgLine: true,
    avgLineConfig: {
      type: 'threshold',
      thresholdValue: 25,
      formatValue: (value) => `${value}%`,
    },
  }}
/>
```

### Interactive Legend DataHead

```tsx
<LineChart
  data={yearlyData}
  interactive
  chartLegend
  chartLegendConfig={{
    interactiveDataHead: true,
    formatHoverSupportingLabel: (category) => `Year: ${category}`,
    items: [
      {
        type: 'line',
        categoryLabelValue: 'Neonatal mortality rate',
        dataHead: true,
        dataHeadConfig: {
          dataLeadValue: 19,
          supportingData: false,
          supportingLabel: true,
          supportingLabelValue: 'Year: 2023',
          valueFormat: { type: 'number' },
        },
      },
    ],
  }}
  pathGroupConfig={{ curveStyle: 'Curved' }}
/>
```

### With Value Formatting

```tsx
<LineChart
  data={revenueData}
  pathGroupConfig={{
    yAxisConfig: {
      valueFormat: { type: 'currency', currency: 'INR', abbreviate: true },
    },
  }}
/>
```

### Broken Axis (Tick Skipper)

```tsx
<LineChart
  data={outlierData}
  pathGroupConfig={{
    yAxisConfig: {
      skippedTicks: [200, 800],
    },
  }}
/>
```

Ticks in the skipped range are hidden, a break indicator appears on the Y-axis, and the D3 scale splits so data outside the gap gets proportionally more visual space.

### Full Width

```tsx
<LineChart
  data={data}
  fullWidth
  chartHeaderConfig={{ chartTitleValue: 'Full Width Chart' }}
/>
```

### Individual Hover with DataBadge

```tsx
<LineChart
  data={data}
  pathGroupConfig={{
    hoverType: 'individual',
    hoverBadge: true,
  }}
/>
```

### Categorical Hover with DataBadge

```tsx
<LineChart
  data={data}
  pathGroupConfig={{
    hoverType: 'categorical',
    hoverBadge: true,
  }}
/>
```

### Animated Entry

```tsx
<LineChart data={data} animated />
```

### Animated Data Transition

When `animated` is enabled, switching datasets smoothly morphs the line paths and transitions the YAxis tick labels (slide + fade enter/exit). Requires the same number of categories in both datasets for smooth path morphing:

```tsx
const [data, setData] = useState(datasetA);

<LineChart data={data} animated />
<button onClick={() => setData(datasetB)}>Switch to B</button>
```

### Chart Only (No Header/Footer/Legend)

```tsx
<LineChart
  data={data}
  chartHeader={false}
  chartFooter={false}
  chartLegend={false}
/>
```

## Design Tokens Used

All tokens resolve through the CSS cascade — no JS token resolver. DataVis categorical colors are emitted by `generateDataVisCSS → useStyleInjection` (`@layer brand`); surface/typography/spacing tokens come from `useBrandCSSNew`.

| Property     | CSS Variable                            | Source                      | Description                      |
| ------------ | --------------------------------------- | --------------------------- | -------------------------------- |
| Section gap  | `var(--LineChart-gap, var(--Spacing-5))`| `.container` CSS module     | Gap between chart sections       |
| Series color 1–12 | `var(--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-{n})` | `generateDataVisCSS`    | Categorical line colors (1–12)   |
| Text         | `var(--Text-High)` / `var(--Text-Medium)` | `useBrandCSSNew`          | Axis labels, legend text         |
| Typography   | `var(--Label-XS-FontSize)` etc.         | `useBrandCSSNew`            | Axis tick and label sizing       |

## Legend Auto-Generation

When `chartLegendConfig.items` is not provided, the chart automatically generates legend items from the data. Each series gets a name and a CSS custom property color reference (`var(--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-{n})`), clamped to the range 1–12.

## Height Behavior

The `height` prop controls the **total chart height**. PathGroup stretches to fill remaining space after header, legend, DataDisplay, and footer.

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ ChartHeader (natural height)            │
├─────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ ChartLegend (natural height)            │
├─────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ DataDisplay (natural height, optional)  │
├─────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                         │
│ PathGroup (flex: 1, fills remaining)    │
│   └── AvgLine (optional, overlaid)      │
│                                         │
├─────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ ChartFooter (natural height)            │
└─────────────────────────────────────────┘
       ↑                                ↑
       └────── Total height prop ───────┘
```

## Dynamic XAxis Label Padding

When the XAxis is visible, PathGroup automatically measures the first and last displayed tick label widths and applies padding to the content wrapper. This prevents labels centered on the first/last data points from overflowing the chart container. The padding insets both the SVG paths area and XAxis equally, keeping data points aligned with their labels. No configuration is needed — the padding is computed from resolved font tokens and accounts for `formatValue` if provided via `xAxisConfig`.

## DataDisplay Integration

This chart supports an optional DataDisplay component positioned between ChartLegend and PathGroup. See **[DataDisplay Integration](./DataDisplayIntegration.md)** for full configuration.

**Note**: In hover mode, formatters receive `(values: { seriesIndex: number; value: number }[], category?: CategoryValue)` — an array of all series values at the hovered X position.

## Accessibility

LineChart implements the full three-layer ARIA accessibility pattern used across all chart types.

### Layer A: ChartAccessibility Wrapper

Wrapped by `ChartAccessibility` (enabled by default). Provides:

- `role="figure"` on the outermost container
- `aria-label` from chart title (or custom `accessibility.ariaLabel`)
- `aria-describedby` linking to an auto-generated natural language summary and a visually-hidden data table
- `aria-live="polite"` region for hover/focus announcements

See **[ChartAccessibility.md](./ChartAccessibility.md)** for configuration.

### Layer B: ARIA Live Region (`useChartAccessibility`)

On hover or keyboard focus, LineChart builds an announcement string and passes it through `useChartAccessibility` (which debounces via `useAriaLiveRegion` at 150 ms) to `ChartAccessibility` via `liveText`:

```
"{category}, {Series1Name}: {value1}, {Series2Name}: {value2}"
```

Both mouse hover and keyboard navigation trigger the same announcement pipeline.

### Layer C: Keyboard Navigation (PathGroup)

PathGroup renders invisible focusable data points — one per category — with `useRovingTabIndex`:

- **Tab** into the chart focuses the first data point; **Tab** out leaves (single tab stop)
- **ArrowLeft / ArrowRight** moves between data points (wraps at edges)
- **Home / End** jumps to first / last
- The HoverLine serves as the visible focus indicator (in both tracking and individual modes)

Each data point carries `role="button"`, `aria-roledescription="data point"`, and `aria-label="{category}: {series values}, point N of M"`. When `dataDisplay` is enabled, data points include `aria-controls` linking to the DataDisplay element.

### Decorative Elements

All visual-only elements are marked `aria-hidden="true"`: SVG paths, HoverLine, YAxis, XAxis, AvgLine, ZeroLine.

See **[PathGroup.md](./PathGroup.md) → Accessibility** for full details.

## Child Components

| Component     | Toggle Prop               | Config Prop                     | File                              | Description                       |
| ------------- | ------------------------- | ------------------------------- | --------------------------------- | --------------------------------- |
| `ChartHeader` | `chartHeader`             | `chartHeaderConfig`             | `../../groups/ChartHeader`        | Title and subtitle                |
| `ChartLegend` | `chartLegend`             | `chartLegendConfig`             | `../../groups/ChartLegend`        | Legend with ChartKey items        |
| `DataDisplay` | `dataDisplay`             | `dataDisplayConfig`             | `../../groups/DataDisplay`         | Data summary with badge           |
| `PathGroup`   | (always on)               | `pathGroupConfig`               | `../../groups/PathGroup`          | SVG line paths with axes          |
| `AvgLine`     | `pathGroupConfig.avgLine` | `pathGroupConfig.avgLineConfig` | (internal to PathGroup)           | Horizontal average/threshold line |
| `ChartFooter` | `chartFooter`             | `chartFooterConfig`             | `../../groups/ChartFooter`        | Source and notes                  |

## Related Documentation

- [OrganizedPropsPattern.md](./OrganizedPropsPattern.md) — Pattern documentation
- [PathGroup.md](./PathGroup.md) — Path group component
- [AvgLine.md](./AvgLine.md) — Average/threshold line component
- [DataDisplay.md](./DataDisplay.md) — DataDisplay component
- [ChartHeader.md](./ChartHeader.md) — Header component
- [ChartFooter.md](./ChartFooter.md) — Footer component
- [ChartLegend.md](./ChartLegend.md) — Legend component

## Files

| File                                                                        | Description                   |
| --------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------- |
| `packages/datavis/src/components/charts/LineChart/LineChart.tsx`            | Main component implementation |
| `packages/datavis/src/components/charts/LineChart/LineChart.module.css`     | Structural CSS layout         |
| `packages/datavis/src/components/charts/LineChart/index.ts`                 | Package barrel exports        |
| `packages/datavis/src/components/charts/LineChart/LineChart.stories.tsx`    | Storybook stories             |

title: LollipopBarChart
text:
LollipopBarChart
`LollipopBarChart` is a top-level compound chart component that composes `ChartHeader`, `ChartLegend`, `DataDisplay`, `LollipopBarGroup`, and `ChartFooter` into a complete lollipop bar visualization. It follows the **Organized Props Pattern** with two layers: Parent Props and Child Configs.
@jds4/oneui-datavis
@jds4/oneui-datavis/components/charts/LollipopBarChart
# LollipopBarChart

## Overview

`LollipopBarChart` is a top-level compound chart component that composes `ChartHeader`, `ChartLegend`, `DataDisplay`, `LollipopBarGroup`, and `ChartFooter` into a complete lollipop bar visualization. It follows the **Organized Props Pattern** with two layers: Parent Props and Child Configs.

A lollipop chart is a less ink-heavy alternative to a standard bar chart — each category is represented by a vertical stem with a circular dot. All tokens resolve from the `@layer brand` CSS cascade; no JS resolver.

## Figma Reference

- **Node ID**: `274:11306`
- **Design File**: DataVis-Components
- **Figma URL**: https://www.figma.com/design/uA5ExvS0cNXbDEKzT9Rnrt/DataVis-Components?node-id=274-11306

## Architecture

```
LollipopBarChart (Layer 2 booleans + Layer 3 *Config objects)
│
├── Layer 2 — Parent Props
│   ├── chartHeader       → toggles ChartHeader
│   ├── chartFooter       → toggles ChartFooter
│   ├── chartLegend       → toggles ChartLegend
│   ├── dataDisplay       → toggles DataDisplay
│   ├── interactive       → enables hover/click
│   ├── animated          → enables entry animation
│   └── fullWidth         → fill container width
│
├── Layer 3 — Child Component Configs
│   ├── chartHeaderConfig  → { chartTitleValue, chartSubtitleValue }
│   ├── chartLegendConfig  → { items, categoryLabelValue, type, dataHead, dataHeadConfig }
│   ├── dataDisplayConfig  → { mode, mainLabelValue, dataHead, badgeConfig, ... }
│   ├── barGroupConfig     → { topLabels, yAxis, avgLine, hoverBadge, dataSort, yAxisConfig, ... }
│   └── chartFooterConfig  → { annotationLeftValue, annotationRightValue }
│
└── Render Tree
    ├── ChartAccessibility (role="figure", auto-summary, hidden data table, aria-live region)
    │   │   └── liveText ← useChartAccessibility({ rawLiveText, ... })
    │   ├── ChartHeader (conditional: chartHeader)
    │   ├── ChartLegend (conditional: chartLegend)
    │   ├── DataDisplay (conditional: dataDisplay, id={dataDisplayId})
    │   │   ├── mainLabel (inline typography tokens)
    │   │   ├── DataHead (DataLead + SupportingData + SupportingLabel)
    │   │   └── Badge (change indicator via badgeConfig)
    │   ├── LollipopBarGroup (D3 calculations, layout, ariaControlsId)
    │   │   ├── YAxis (tick positioning from D3 scale, aria-hidden baked in)
    │   │   ├── AvgLine (optional, aria-hidden="true")
    │   │   ├── contentWrapper (role="group", aria-label="Chart data")
    │   │   │   └── LollipopBar[] (data-roving-item, useRovingTabIndex)
    │   │   │       ├── ShapeRect (dot shape)
    │   │   │       ├── Line (stem)
    │   │   │       └── category + value labels
    │   │   └── HoverBadge (optional, follows cursor, aria-hidden baked in)
    │   └── ChartFooter (conditional: chartFooter)
```

**Token resolution**: All colours resolve from `--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-{n}` CSS custom properties injected by the Convex → `generateDataVisCSS` → `useStyleInjection` → `@layer brand` pipeline. Brand, theme, platform, and density are applied globally — the chart component has no knowledge of Figma variable collections.

## Import

```tsx
import { LollipopBarChart } from './LollipopBarChart';
// Or from the package root:
import { LollipopBarChart } from '@oneui/datavis';
```

## Data Formats

Supports both canonical and legacy formats:

```tsx
// Canonical (recommended)
const data: ChartDataPoint[] = [
  { category: 'Jan', value: 120 },
  { category: 'Feb', value: 180, colorIndex: 2 },
];

// Legacy (deprecated, still supported)
const legacyData = [
  { label: 'Jan', value: 120 },
  { label: 'Feb', value: 180 },
];
```

## Props Interface

```typescript
export interface LollipopBarChartProps {
  // Layer 2: Parent props
  data: ChartDataPoint[] | DataPoint[];
  width?: number | string;
  height?: number | string;
  chartHeader?: boolean;
  chartFooter?: boolean;
  chartLegend?: boolean;
  dataDisplay?: boolean;
  interactive?: boolean;
  animated?: boolean;
  fullWidth?: boolean;

  // Layer 3: Child configs
  chartHeaderConfig?: ChartHeaderConfig;
  chartLegendConfig?: ChartLegendConfig;
  dataDisplayConfig?: DataDisplayConfig;
  barGroupConfig?: BarGroupConfig;
  chartFooterConfig?: ChartFooterConfig;

  accessibility?: AccessibilityConfig;
}
```

## Props

### Layer 2: Parent Props

| Prop          | Type                              | Default | Description                                       |
| ------------- | --------------------------------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------- |
| `data`        | `ChartDataPoint[] \| DataPoint[]` | `[]`    | Chart data (canonical or legacy format)           |
| `width`       | `number \| string`                | `420`   | Total chart width in px or CSS string             |
| `height`      | `number \| string`                | `500`   | Total chart height in px or CSS string            |
| `chartHeader` | `boolean`                         | `true`  | Toggle ChartHeader                                |
| `chartFooter` | `boolean`                         | `true`  | Toggle ChartFooter                                |
| `chartLegend` | `boolean`                         | `false` | Toggle ChartLegend                                |
| `dataDisplay` | `boolean`                         | `false` | Toggle DataDisplay above chart                    |
| `interactive` | `boolean`                         | `true`  | Enable hover/click interactivity                  |
| `animated`    | `boolean`                         | `false` | Enable entry animation (staggered grow + fade-in) |
| `fullWidth`   | `boolean`                         | `false` | Fill available container width (`width: 100%`)    |

### Layer 3: Child Configs

#### `chartHeaderConfig`

| Prop                 | Type     | Default     | Description         |
| -------------------- | -------- | ----------- | ------------------- |
| `chartTitleValue`    | `string` | `undefined` | Chart title text    |
| `chartSubtitleValue` | `string` | `undefined` | Chart subtitle text |

#### `chartLegendConfig`

| Prop                 | Type                             | Default        | Description                     |
| -------------------- | -------------------------------- | -------------- | ------------------------------- |
| `items`              | `ChartLegendItem[]`              | auto-generated | Manual legend items             |
| `categoryLabelValue` | `string`                         | —              | Simple single-item legend label |
| `type`               | `"circle" \| "dashed" \| "line"` | `"circle"`     | Indicator type                  |
| `dataHead`           | `boolean`                        | `false`        | Toggle DataHead in legend items |
| `dataHeadConfig`     | `object`                         | `{}`           | DataHead config for legend      |

**Auto-generation**: When neither `items` nor `categoryLabelValue` is provided, legend items are auto-generated from data. Each data point maps to a CSS variable (`var(--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-1)` through `var(--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-12)`).

#### `barGroupConfig`

| Prop                    | Type                       | Default      | Description                                                                                           |
| ----------------------- | -------------------------- | ------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `topLabels`             | `boolean`                  | `false`      | Toggle value labels above dots                                                                        |
| `categoryLabels`        | `boolean`                  | `true`       | Toggle category labels below                                                                          |
| `yAxis`                 | `boolean`                  | `false`      | Toggle Y-axis                                                                                         |
| `avgLine`               | `boolean`                  | `false`      | Toggle average line                                                                                   |
| `hoverBadge`            | `boolean`                  | `false`      | Toggle cursor-following hover badge                                                                   |
| `valueFormat`           | `ValueFormatConfig`        | —            | Auto-format all values                                                                                |
| `barWidth`              | `string`                   | `"M"`        | Dot size (XS–2XL)                                                                                     |
| `onBarHover`            | `(data) => void`           | —            | Hover callback                                                                                        |
| `onBarClick`            | `(data) => void`           | —            | Click callback                                                                                        |
| `highlightedBarIndices` | `number[]`                 | —            | Indices of lollipops rendered at full opacity; every other dims (multi-bar highlight)                 |
| `hoveredBarIndex`       | `number \| number[]`       | —            | Back-compat alias for `highlightedBarIndices`. Accepts single index or array                          |
| `yAxisConfig`           | `LollipopYAxisConfig`      | —            | `{ tickCount, formatValue, valueFormat, yAxisLabel, yAxisLabelValue, axisTickSkipper, skippedTicks }` |
| `avgLineConfig`         | `LollipopAvgLineConfig`    | —            | `{ formatValue, type, thresholdValue, dataBadge }`                                                    |
| `hoverBadgeConfig`      | `LollipopHoverBadgeConfig` | —            | `{ formatValue, formatBadge }`                                                                        |
| `categoryLabelConfig`   | `LollipopCategoryLabelConfig` | —         | Dynamic label truncation, wrapping, overflow                                                          |
| `dataSort`              | `DataSortOrder`            | `"unsorted"` | Sort bars by value: `"asc"`, `"desc"`, or `"unsorted"`                                                |

##### `categoryLabelConfig`

Controls dynamic category label behavior including word truncation, multi-line wrapping, and overflow grouping into an "Others" lollipop.

| Prop                     | Type                                | Default       | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| ------------------------ | ----------------------------------- | ------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `maxWords`               | `number`                            | `3`           | Maximum words per label before truncation with "…"                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `maxLines`               | `number`                            | `2`           | Maximum display lines per label (enables word-wrap)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `othersLabel`            | `string`                            | `"Others"`    | Label text for the overflow group                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `overflowType`           | `"grouped" \| "truncated" \| "all"` | `"truncated"` | `"truncated"` (default): bars that don't fit are removed from the right. `"grouped"`: overflow items aggregated into an "Others" lollipop. `"all"`: every bar is rendered but in-between category labels are skipped to prevent overlap (hovering any bar — including those with hidden labels — reveals the full category name in the HoverBadge and the `onBarHover` callback) |
| `skippedLabels`          | `"auto" \| number`                  | `"auto"`      | Only used when `overflowType` is `"all"`. `"auto"` dynamically calculates which labels to show based on available width. A `number` sets an explicit skip interval (e.g., `1` = every other label)                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `enableOverflowGrouping` | `boolean`                           | `false`       | **Deprecated** — use `overflowType` instead. `true` maps to `"grouped"`, `false` maps to `"truncated"`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `labelWidth`             | `"fluid" \| number`                 | `"fluid"`     | Label sizing: fluid (fill space with gaps) or fixed px                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `othersPosition`         | `"sorted" \| "end"`                 | `"sorted"`    | Position of Others: by value or pinned to far right                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `othersHeight`           | `"relative" \| "full" \| number`    | `"relative"`  | Height mode for the Others lollipop                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |

#### `chartFooterConfig`

| Prop                   | Type     | Default     | Description        |
| ---------------------- | -------- | ----------- | ------------------ |
| `annotationLeftValue`  | `string` | `undefined` | Source attribution |
| `annotationRightValue` | `string` | `undefined` | Additional notes   |

#### `dataDisplayConfig`

Chart-specific props:

| Prop                    | Type                                                  | Default    | Description                                     |
| ----------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------- | ---------- | ----------------------------------------------- |
| `mode`                  | `"static" \| "hover"`                                 | `"static"` | Display mode (hover updates on bar interaction) |
| `formatHoverLeadValue`  | `(value: number, category?: CategoryValue) => string` | —          | Custom formatter for lead value in hover mode   |
| `formatHoverBadgeValue` | `(value: number, category?: CategoryValue) => string` | —          | Custom formatter for badge value in hover mode  |

DataDisplay Layer 2 props:

| Prop                       | Type                           | Default  | Description                              |
| -------------------------- | ------------------------------ | -------- | ---------------------------------------- |
| `mainLabelValue`           | `string`                       | —        | The main label text above the data value |
| `type`                     | `"Left" \| "Center"`           | `"Left"` | Layout type: horizontal or vertical      |
| `rightBadgeWrapper` | `boolean`                      | `true`   | Toggle rightBadgeWrapper section  |
| `badgeTop`                 | `boolean`                      | `false`  | Toggle badgeTop slot                     |
| `badgeBottom`              | `boolean`                      | `true`   | Toggle badgeBottom slot                  |
| `showBadge`                | `boolean`                      | `true`   | Toggle the Badge visibility              |
| `supportingBadgeLabel`     | `boolean`                      | `true`   | Toggle supporting label next to badge    |
| `supportingBadgeLabelValue`     | `string`                       | —        | Supporting label text next to badge      |
| `size`                | `"XS" \| "S" \| "M" \| "L" \| "XL"` | `"L"` | Typography size variant              |

DataDisplay Layer 3 props:

| Prop          | Type             | Description                                                        |
| ------------- | ---------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `dataHead`    | `DataHeadConfig` | Config for DataHead: `{ dataLeadValue, dataSupportingValue, ... }` |
| `badgeConfig` | `BadgeConfig`    | Config for the badge: `{ value, appearance, variant, autoDetect }` |

### Accessibility

```tsx
accessibility?: {
  enabled?: boolean;   // default: true
  summary?: string;    // custom summary or "auto"
  dataTable?: boolean; // default: true (hidden table for SR)
  ariaLabel?: string;  // custom aria-label
}
```

## Usage Examples

### Basic Chart

```tsx
import { LollipopBarChart } from './LollipopBarChart';

<LollipopBarChart
  data={[
    { category: 'Jan', value: 120 },
    { category: 'Feb', value: 180 },
    { category: 'Mar', value: 90 },
  ]}
  chartHeaderConfig={{
    chartTitleValue: 'Monthly Revenue',
    chartSubtitleValue: 'Q1 2024 Performance',
  }}
  chartFooterConfig={{
    annotationLeftValue: 'Source: Analytics',
    annotationRightValue: '*In thousands USD',
  }}
/>
```

### Full Featured Chart

```tsx
<LollipopBarChart
  data={canonicalData}
  width={500}
  height={550}
  chartHeader
  chartFooter
  chartLegend
  dataDisplay
  chartHeaderConfig={{
    chartTitleValue: 'Regional Performance',
    chartSubtitleValue: 'Revenue by region with KPI overview',
  }}
  dataDisplayConfig={{
    mode: 'hover',
    mainLabelValue: 'Hover a lollipop',
    dataHead: {
      dataLeadValue: '—',
    },
    badgeConfig: {
      value: '—',
      autoDetect: true,
    },
  }}
  barGroupConfig={{
    topLabels: true,
    categoryLabels: true,
    yAxis: true,
    avgLine: true,
    hoverBadge: true,
    barWidth: 'M',
    valueFormat: { type: 'currency', currency: 'GBP' },
  }}
  chartFooterConfig={{
    annotationLeftValue: 'Source: Regional Reports',
    annotationRightValue: '*Preliminary figures',
  }}
  accessibility={{
    enabled: true,
    dataTable: true,
  }}
/>
```

### Full Width

```tsx
<LollipopBarChart data={data} fullWidth barGroupConfig={{ yAxis: true }} />
```

### With Entry Animation

```tsx
<LollipopBarChart data={data} animated barGroupConfig={{ yAxis: true }} />
```

### Sorted Bars (Descending)

```tsx
<LollipopBarChart
  data={data}
  barGroupConfig={{
    yAxis: true,
    dataSort: 'desc',
  }}
/>
```

### Hover-Driven DataDisplay

```tsx
<LollipopBarChart
  data={data}
  dataDisplay
  dataDisplayConfig={{
    mode: 'hover',
    mainLabelValue: 'Select a data point',
    dataHead: {
      dataLeadValue: '—',
    },
    badgeConfig: {
      value: '—',
      autoDetect: true,
    },
    formatHoverLeadValue: (value) => `£${value.toLocaleString()}`,
    formatHoverBadgeValue: (value, _category) => {
      const pct = ((value / total) * 100).toFixed(1);
      return `${pct}%`;
    },
  }}
  barGroupConfig={{
    yAxis: true,
    barWidth: 'M',
  }}
/>
```

## Design Tokens Used

| Token                              | Purpose                    | Notes                                            |
| ---------------------------------- | -------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------ |
| `--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-1…12`  | Lollipop dot and stem fill | Injected by `generateDataVisCSS` via `@layer brand` |
| `--Spacing-5`                      | Gap between chart sections | Via `--LollipopBarChart-sectionGap` CSS override hook |

All child components resolve their own tokens from the global `@layer brand` cascade. No token values are passed as props.

## Legend Auto-Generation

When `chartLegend` is `true` and no `chartLegendConfig.items` or `chartLegendConfig.categoryLabelValue` is provided:

1. **Custom colors in data**: Groups by unique color, creates one legend item per color.
2. **Default**: Creates one legend item per data point (up to 12) using `var(--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-1)` through `var(--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-12)`.

## Animation

When `animated={true}`, lollipops grow from zero on first load (entry animation with stagger). After entry settles, subsequent data changes transition smoothly. See **[LollipopBarGroup.md](./LollipopBarGroup.md)** for token details.

## Negative Data

The chart supports mixed positive/negative datasets. `LollipopBarGroup` auto-detects negative values and renders a ZeroLine with positive lollipops growing upward and negative lollipops hanging downward. Transitions between positive-only, mixed, and negative-only data are animated when `animated={true}`. See **[LollipopBarGroup.md](./LollipopBarGroup.md)** for details.

## Sparse Data

When the dataset has 1–3 entries, `LollipopBarGroup` automatically adds grey placeholder lollipops to fill 5 total slots, preventing awkward stretching. See **[LollipopBarGroup.md](./LollipopBarGroup.md)** for details.

## Height Behavior

The `height` prop sets the total chart container height. LollipopBarGroup fills the remaining vertical space after header, legend, DataDisplay, and footer.

## Hover Interaction

Hovering over lollipop bars highlights the bar and can drive DataDisplay and HoverBadge updates. Set `interactive={true}` (default) and optionally `barGroupConfig.hoverBadge` to show a cursor-following badge.

## DataDisplay Integration

This chart supports an optional DataDisplay component above the chart body. When `dataDisplayConfig.mode` is `"hover"`, values update based on the hovered lollipop:

- `mainLabelValue` → set to the hovered category name
- `dataHead.dataLeadValue` → set to the formatted value
- `badgeConfig.value` → set to the percentage of total (or custom formatted)

## Accessibility

Wrapped by `ChartAccessibility` (enabled by default). Configure via the `accessibility` prop.

### Accessibility Architecture

| Level | Feature                              | Description                                                                         |
| ----- | ------------------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Chart | `ChartAccessibility`                 | `role="figure"`, auto-summary, hidden data table, `aria-live` region                |
| Chart | `useChartAccessibility`              | Debounced screen-reader announcements on hover/focus (composes `useAriaLiveRegion`) |
| Chart | `dataDisplayId` + `ariaControlsId`   | Links bars to DataDisplay via `aria-controls` (id from `useChartAccessibility`)     |
| Group | `useRovingTabIndex`                  | ArrowLeft/ArrowRight keyboard navigation between lollipops                          |
| Group | `role="group"`                       | Content wrapper announced as a logical group                                        |
| Group | `aria-hidden="true"`                 | AvgLine wrapper hidden from assistive technology                                    |
| Bar   | `role="button"` + `data-roving-item` | Interactive lollipops are focusable with keyboard and screen reader support         |
| Bar   | `aria-roledescription="data point"`  | Semantic role for screen readers                                                    |
| Bar   | `aria-label`                         | `"{category}: {value}, bar N of M"` — full context per lollipop                     |

### ARIA Live Region

When a lollipop is hovered or focused, a debounced announcement is sent to the `aria-live="polite"` region inside `ChartAccessibility`:

```
"{category}, {formattedValue}, {percentOfTotal}% of total"
```

The `useChartAccessibility` hook debounces updates by 150ms to prevent rapid-fire announcements when arrowing through bars.

### aria-controls Linking

A stable `dataDisplayId` returned by `useChartAccessibility` is set as `id` on the `DataDisplay` component and passed as `ariaControlsId` to `LollipopBarGroup`. Each bar receives this as `ariaControls`, so screen readers announce the relationship between bars and the data summary panel.

## Migration from Previous API

| Old Prop / Config                             | New Prop / Config                                 |
| --------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------- |
| `modes={{ fullWidth: true }}`                 | `fullWidth={true}`                                |
| `modes={{ colourMode, colourTheme, ... }}`    | **Removed** — globally injected via `@layer brand` |
| `dataDisplayConfig.dataBadgeSemanticConfig`   | `dataDisplayConfig.badgeConfig`                   |
| `badgeConfig.dataBadgeSemanticValue`          | `badgeConfig.value`                               |
| `dataDisplayConfig.dataBadgeSemantic`         | `dataDisplayConfig.showBadge`                     |
| `dataDisplayConfig.size: "S" \| "M"`     | `dataDisplayConfig.size: "XS" \| "S" \| "M" \| "L" \| "XL"` |
| `import LollipopBarChart from '...'` (default) | `import { LollipopBarChart } from '...'` (named)  |
| `showHeader`                                  | `chartHeader`                                     |
| `showFooter`                                  | `chartFooter`                                     |
| `showLegend`                                  | `chartLegend`                                     |
| `showDataDisplay`                             | `dataDisplay`                                     |
| `chartHeader: { ... }` (object prop)          | `chartHeaderConfig: { ... }`                      |
| `chartLegend: { ... }` (object prop)          | `chartLegendConfig: { ... }`                      |
| `barGroup: { ... }`                           | `barGroupConfig: { ... }`                         |
| `chartFooter: { ... }` (object prop)          | `chartFooterConfig: { ... }`                      |

## Type Exports

```typescript
// From LollipopBarChart.tsx / index.ts
export type { LollipopBarChartProps, BarGroupConfig, DataDisplayConfig };

// Re-exported from child modules
export type { DataPoint, ValueFormatConfig, LollipopBarHoverData } from '../../groups/LollipopBarGroup';
export type { LollipopYAxisConfig, LollipopAvgLineConfig, LollipopHoverBadgeConfig } from '../../groups/LollipopBarGroup';
export type { LollipopCategoryLabelConfig, DataSortOrder } from '../../groups/LollipopBarGroup';
export type { ChartDataPoint, CategoryValue } from '../../../types/chart-data';
export type { ChartLegendItem } from '../../groups/ChartLegend';
export type { DataHeadConfig, BadgeConfig } from '../../groups/DataDisplay';
export type { AccessibilityConfig } from '../../ChartAccessibility';
```

## Child Components

| Component        | Boolean Toggle | Config Prop         | Description                   |
| ---------------- | -------------- | ------------------- | ----------------------------- |
| ChartHeader      | `chartHeader`  | `chartHeaderConfig` | Title and subtitle            |
| ChartLegend      | `chartLegend`  | `chartLegendConfig` | Legend with ChartKey items    |
| DataDisplay      | `dataDisplay`  | `dataDisplayConfig` | KPI display (static or hover) |
| LollipopBarGroup | —              | `barGroupConfig`    | D3 layout with bars and axes  |
| ChartFooter      | `chartFooter`  | `chartFooterConfig` | Source and notes              |

## Files

| File                                 | Description                 |
| ------------------------------------ | --------------------------- |
| `LollipopBarChart/LollipopBarChart.tsx`         | Component implementation    |
| `LollipopBarChart/LollipopBarChart.module.css`  | Structural CSS module       |
| `LollipopBarChart/LollipopBarChart.stories.tsx` | Storybook stories (9 sections) |
| `LollipopBarChart/LollipopBarChart.test.tsx`    | Unit tests                  |
| `LollipopBarChart/index.ts`                     | Named exports barrel        |

## Related Documentation

- [LollipopBarGroup.md](./LollipopBarGroup.md)
- [DATAVIS-SETUP.md](../../DATAVIS-SETUP.md)
- [ChartAccessibility.tsx](../../ChartAccessibility.tsx)

title: ProjectionLineChart
text:
ProjectionLineChart
The ProjectionLineChart is a complete chart visualization component that supports two projection modes. In **confidence** mode (default), it displays a line chart with an optional confidence/projection band. In **forecast** mode, it renders actual data as a solid line and projected data as a dashed line. It combines ChartHeader, ChartLegend, DataDisplay, ProjectionPathGroup, and ChartFooter components. This component is ideal for forecasting visualizations, prediction intervals, and trend charts with uncertainty ranges.
@jds4/oneui-datavis
@jds4/oneui-datavis/components/charts/ProjectionLineChart
# ProjectionLineChart

## Overview

The ProjectionLineChart is a complete chart visualization component that supports two projection modes. In **confidence** mode (default), it displays a line chart with an optional confidence/projection band. In **forecast** mode, it renders actual data as a solid line and projected data as a dashed line. It combines ChartHeader, ChartLegend, DataDisplay, ProjectionPathGroup, and ChartFooter components. This component is ideal for forecasting visualizations, prediction intervals, and trend charts with uncertainty ranges.

**This component follows the [Organized Props Pattern](./OrganizedPropsPattern.md).**

All color and stroke tokens are sourced from the CSS cascade: DataVis palette tokens (`--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-{n}`, `--DataVis-Categorical-Subtle-{n}`) via `generateDataVisCSS → useStyleInjection`, and surface/typography tokens via `useBrandCSSNew`. No runtime JS token resolver; no `modes` prop.

## Figma Reference

- **Node ID**: `221:3814`
- **Design File**: DataVis-Components
- **Figma URL**: https://www.figma.com/design/uA5ExvS0cNXbDEKzT9Rnrt/DataVis-Components?node-id=221-3814

## Architecture

```
ProjectionLineChart
├── ChartAccessibility (wrapper)
│   ├── ChartHeader (optional)
│   │   ├── ChartTitle
│   │   └── ChartSubtitle
│   ├── ChartLegend (optional)
│   │   └── ChartKey[] (auto-generated or manual)
│   ├── DataDisplay (optional, when dataDisplay=true)
│   │   ├── contentLeft
│   │   │   ├── mainLabel (inline typography)
│   │   │   └── DataHead (DataLead + SupportingData + SupportingLabel)
│   │   └── contentRight (Badge)
│   ├── ProjectionPathGroup (animated → clip-path entry + rAF morph)
│   │   ├── YAxis (optional)
│   │   ├── SVG (clip-path left-to-right reveal when animated)
│   │   │   ├── [confidence] path (projection area) + path (solid line)
│   │   │   └── [forecast] path (solid actual) + path (dashed forecast)
│   │   ├── HoverLine (conditional — toggled by hoverLine)
│   │   │   ├── topHoverDataLabel (optional)
│   │   │   ├── lineIndicator (toggled by hoverLineConfig.lineIndicator)
│   │   │   └── dot (positioned at line intersection)
│   │   │       └── DataBadgeFloatingGroup (toggled by hoverLineConfig.dataBadgeFloatingGroup)
│   │   └── XAxis (optional)
│   └── ChartFooter (optional)
│       └── annotation slots (source + notes)
```

## Import

```tsx
import { ProjectionLineChart } from './charts/ProjectionLineChart';
```

## Data Formats

### ProjectionDataPoint

```typescript
interface ProjectionDataPoint {
  /** Category label (x-axis) — string, number, or Date */
  category: CategoryValue;
  /** Main value (the solid line) */
  value: number;
  /** Upper bound of the confidence interval (confidence mode) */
  upperBound?: number;
  /** Lower bound of the confidence interval (confidence mode) */
  lowerBound?: number;
  /** Whether this point is a projected/forecast point (forecast mode) */
  projected?: boolean;
}
```

### Example Data

Categories accept `string`, `number`, or `Date` values. Date categories are auto-formatted by `formatCategoryLabel()` — `new Date(2024, 0)` → `"2024"`, `new Date(2024, 5)` → `"Jun 2024"`.

```typescript
const projectionData: ProjectionDataPoint[] = [
  { category: new Date(2020, 0), value: 12, lowerBound: 10, upperBound: 14 },
  { category: new Date(2022, 0), value: 14, lowerBound: 11, upperBound: 17 },
  { category: new Date(2024, 0), value: 24, lowerBound: 20, upperBound: 28 },
  { category: new Date(2026, 0), value: 33, lowerBound: 26, upperBound: 40, projected: true },
  { category: new Date(2028, 0), value: 44, lowerBound: 33, upperBound: 55, projected: true },
];
```

## Props Interface (Organized Props Pattern)

```typescript
interface DataDisplayConfig {
  // Chart-specific behaviour
  mode?: 'static' | 'hover';
  formatHoverMainLabel?: (category: CategoryValue) => string;
  formatHoverLeadValue?: (
    value: number,
    category?: CategoryValue,
    bounds?: { upper?: number; lower?: number }
  ) => string;
  formatHoverBadgeValue?: (
    value: number,
    category?: CategoryValue,
    bounds?: { upper?: number; lower?: number }
  ) => string;

  // DataDisplay Layer 2 props
  mainLabelValue?: string;
  alignment?: 'Left' | 'Center';
  rightBadgeWrapper?: boolean;
  badgeTop?: boolean;
  badgeBottom?: boolean;
  showBadge?: boolean;
  supportingBadgeLabel?: boolean;
  supportingBadgeLabelValue?: string;
  size?: 'XS' | 'S' | 'M' | 'L' | 'XL';

  // DataDisplay Layer 3 configs
  dataHead?: DataHeadConfig;
  badgeConfig?: BadgeConfig;
}

interface ProjectionLineChartProps {
  // Layer 2: Parent component props
  data: ProjectionDataPoint[];
  width?: number | string;
  height?: number | string;
  fullWidth?: boolean;
  chartHeader?: boolean;
  chartFooter?: boolean;
  chartLegend?: boolean;
  dataDisplay?: boolean;
  interactive?: boolean;
  animated?: boolean;
  onHover?: (hoverData: ProjectionHoverData | null) => void;

  // Layer 3: Child component configurations
  chartHeaderConfig?: ChartHeaderConfig;
  chartLegendConfig?: ChartLegendConfig;
  dataDisplayConfig?: DataDisplayConfig;
  projectionPathGroupConfig?: ProjectionPathGroupConfig;
  chartFooterConfig?: ChartFooterConfig;

  // Accessibility
  accessibility?: AccessibilityConfig;
}
```

## Props

### Parent Props (Layer 2)

| Prop            | Type                                          | Default     | Description                                                                 |
| --------------- | --------------------------------------------- | ----------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `data`          | `ProjectionDataPoint[]`                       | (required)  | Chart data with value and optional confidence bounds                        |
| `width`         | `number \| string`                            | `346`       | Width of the chart                                                          |
| `height`        | `number \| string`                            | `400`       | **Total height of the chart.** PathGroup fills remaining space.             |
| `fullWidth`     | `boolean`                                     | `false`     | Stretch chart to fill its parent container width                            |
| `chartHeader`   | `boolean`                                     | `true`      | Toggle visibility of ChartHeader                                            |
| `chartFooter`   | `boolean`                                     | `true`      | Toggle visibility of ChartFooter                                            |
| `chartLegend`   | `boolean`                                     | `true`      | Toggle visibility of ChartLegend                                            |
| `dataDisplay`   | `boolean`                                     | `false`     | Toggle visibility of DataDisplay above projection group                     |
| `interactive`   | `boolean`                                     | `true`      | Enable hover interactivity on the projection line                           |
| `animated`      | `boolean`                                     | `false`     | Enable entry animation (left-to-right reveal) and data-change path morphing |
| `onHover`       | `(data: ProjectionHoverData \| null) => void` | -           | Callback when hover state changes                                           |
| `accessibility` | `AccessibilityConfig`                         | `undefined` | Accessibility configuration for screen readers                              |

### ChartHeaderConfig (chartHeaderConfig)

| Prop                 | Type     | Default     | Description         |
| -------------------- | -------- | ----------- | ------------------- |
| `chartTitleValue`    | `string` | `undefined` | Chart title text    |
| `chartSubtitleValue` | `string` | `undefined` | Chart subtitle text |

### ChartLegendConfig (chartLegendConfig)

| Prop                  | Type                | Default                 | Description                                          |
| --------------------- | ------------------- | ----------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------- |
| `items`               | `ChartLegendItem[]` | auto-generated          | Manual legend items (overrides auto-generation)      |
| `projectionLabel`     | `string`            | `"Projection"`          | Label for the main projection line (confidence mode) |
| `projectionBandLabel` | `string`            | `"Confidence interval"` | Label for the confidence band (confidence mode)      |
| `actualLabel`         | `string`            | `"Actual"`              | Label for the actual data line (forecast mode)       |
| `forecastLabel`       | `string`            | `"Forecast"`            | Label for the forecast dashed line (forecast mode)   |

### ProjectionPathGroupConfig (projectionPathGroupConfig)

| Prop             | Type                            | Default        | Description                                                   |
| ---------------- | ------------------------------- | -------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- |
