| `yAxis`          | `boolean`                       | `true`         | Whether to show Y-axis                                        |
| `xAxis`          | `boolean`                       | `true`         | Whether to show X-axis                                        |
| `hoverLine`      | `boolean`                       | `true`         | Master toggle for the entire HoverLine component              |
| `snapToData`     | `boolean`                       | `false`        | Snap hover to nearest data point                              |
| `rounded`        | `boolean`                       | `true`         | Rounded line caps and joins                                   |
| `curveStyle`     | `"Sharp" \| "Curved"`           | `"Curved"`     | Line interpolation style                                      |
| `dataSort`       | `"asc" \| "desc" \| "unsorted"` | `"unsorted"`   | Sort data points by value before rendering                    |
| `projectionMode` | `"confidence" \| "forecast"`    | `"confidence"` | Projection display mode (shaded band vs dashed forecast line) |

#### yAxisConfig

| Prop              | Type                        | Default         | Description                                                                  |
| ----------------- | --------------------------- | --------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `tickCount`       | `number`                    | `6`             | Number of Y-axis ticks                                                       |
| `valueFormat`     | `ValueFormatConfig`         | -               | Format config for Y-axis labels                                              |
| `formatValue`     | `(value: number) => string` | -               | Custom Y-axis formatter                                                      |
| `yAxisLabel`      | `boolean`                   | `false`         | Show rotated label to the left of tick marks                                 |
| `yAxisLabelValue` | `string`                    | `"yAxis label"` | Text content for the Y-axis label                                            |
| `axisTickSkipper` | `boolean`                   | `false`         | Show the axis break indicator (auto-enabled when `skippedTicks` is provided) |
| `skippedTicks`    | `number[]`                  | `undefined`     | Tick values to skip — the range [min, max] defines the break zone            |

#### xAxisConfig

| Prop              | Type                                              | Default         | Description                                                                                         |
| ----------------- | ------------------------------------------------- | --------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `tickCount`       | `number`                                          | `undefined`     | Maximum number of X-axis ticks (evenly-spaced, always includes first/last)                          |
| `formatValue`     | `(label: CategoryValue, index: number) => string` | `undefined`     | Custom formatter for X-axis labels. Date labels auto-format via `formatCategoryLabel` when omitted. |
| `xAxisLabel`      | `boolean`                                         | `false`         | Show label below tick marks                                                                         |
| `xAxisLabelValue` | `string`                                          | `"xAxis label"` | Text content for the X-axis label                                                                   |

#### hoverLineConfig

| Prop                      | Type                        | Default          | Description                                                            |
| ------------------------- | --------------------------- | ---------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `lineIndicator`           | `boolean`                   | `true`           | Show the vertical line indicator inside HoverLine                      |
| `dataBadgeFloatingGroup`  | `boolean`                   | `false`          | Show DataBadgeFloatingGroup on each hover dot                          |
| `formatHoverBadgeValue`   | `(value: number) => string` | -                | Custom formatter for hover badge values                                |
| `topHoverDataLabel`       | `boolean`                   | `false`          | Show top hover data label above HoverLine                              |
| `topHoverDataLabelValue`  | `CategoryValue`             | hovered category | Raw value for the top label; auto-defaults to hovered x-axis category. |
| `formatTopHoverDataLabel` | `(value: CategoryValue) => string` | `String(v)` | Formatter for the top label.                                      |

### ChartFooterConfig (chartFooterConfig)

| Prop                   | Type     | Default     | Description             |
| ---------------------- | -------- | ----------- | ----------------------- |
| `annotationLeftValue`  | `string` | `undefined` | Source attribution text |
| `annotationRightValue` | `string` | `undefined` | Additional notes text   |

### DataDisplayConfig (dataDisplayConfig)

#### Chart-specific props

| Prop                    | Type                                       | Default     | Description                                                                                                    |
| ----------------------- | ------------------------------------------ | ----------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `mode`                  | `"static" \| "hover"`                      | `"static"`  | Static: values from props always shown. Hover: values update dynamically as the line is hovered.               |
| `formatHoverMainLabel`  | `(category: CategoryValue) => string`      | `undefined` | Custom formatter for the main label in hover mode. Defaults to `formatCategoryLabel` (year for Jan-1 Dates).   |
| `formatHoverLeadValue`  | `(value, category?, bounds?) => string`    | `undefined` | Custom formatter for the lead value in hover mode.                                                             |
| `formatHoverBadgeValue` | `(value, category?, bounds?) => string`    | `undefined` | Custom formatter for the badge value in hover mode.                                                            |

#### DataDisplay Layer 2 props

| Prop                       | Type                          | Default     | Description                                        |
| -------------------------- | ----------------------------- | ----------- | -------------------------------------------------- |
| `mainLabelValue`           | `string`                      | `undefined` | Static main label text above the data value        |
| `alignment`                | `"Left" \| "Center"`          | `"Left"`    | Layout alignment                                   |
| `rightBadgeWrapper` | `boolean`                     | `false`     | Show content wrapper supporting section            |
| `badgeTop`                 | `boolean`                     | `false`     | Show top badge section                             |
| `badgeBottom`              | `boolean`                     | `false`     | Show bottom badge section                          |
| `showBadge`                | `boolean`                     | `false`     | Show the OneUI Badge in supporting slots           |
| `supportingBadgeLabel`     | `boolean`                     | `false`     | Show supporting label next to the badge            |
| `supportingBadgeLabelValue`     | `string`                      | `undefined` | Label text next to the badge                       |
| `size`                | `"XS" \| "S" \| "M" \| "L" \| "XL"` | `"L"` | Typography size variant                        |

#### DataDisplay Layer 3: DataHeadConfig (dataHead)

| Prop                  | Type               | Default     | Description                                        |
| --------------------- | ------------------ | ----------- | -------------------------------------------------- |
| `dataLeadValue`       | `number \| string` | `undefined` | Primary lead value                                 |
| `dataSupportingValue` | `number \| string` | `undefined` | Supporting value displayed alongside the lead      |
| `supportingData`      | `boolean`          | `false`     | Toggle visibility of the supporting value          |
| `supportingLabel`     | `boolean`          | `false`     | Toggle visibility of the supporting label          |
| `supportingLabelValue`| `string`           | `undefined` | Text for the supporting label                      |

#### DataDisplay Layer 3: BadgeConfig (badgeConfig)

| Prop    | Type               | Default     | Description  |
| ------- | ------------------ | ----------- | ------------ |
| `value` | `number \| string` | `undefined` | Badge value  |

### Accessibility Config (`accessibility`)

| Prop        | Type      | Default  | Description                                 |
| ----------- | --------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------- |
| `enabled`   | `boolean` | `true`   | Enable accessibility wrapper                |
| `summary`   | `string`  | `"auto"` | Custom summary or "auto" for auto-generated |
| `dataTable` | `boolean` | `true`   | Hidden data table for screen readers        |
| `ariaLabel` | `string`  | -        | Custom aria-label override                  |

## Usage Examples

### Basic Usage

```tsx
<ProjectionLineChart
  data={[
    { category: 'Q1', value: 10, lowerBound: 8, upperBound: 12 },
    { category: 'Q2', value: 15, lowerBound: 11, upperBound: 20 },
    { category: 'Q3', value: 22, lowerBound: 15, upperBound: 30 },
    { category: 'Q4', value: 32, lowerBound: 20, upperBound: 45 },
  ]}
  chartHeaderConfig={{
    chartTitleValue: 'Revenue Projection',
    chartSubtitleValue: 'Quarterly forecast with confidence interval',
  }}
/>
```

### Full Configuration

```tsx
<ProjectionLineChart
  data={projectionData}
  width={400}
  height={300}
  chartHeaderConfig={{
    chartTitleValue: 'Growth Projection',
    chartSubtitleValue: '5-year forecast with confidence bands',
  }}
  chartLegendConfig={{
    projectionLabel: 'Base case',
    projectionBandLabel: 'Range (low to high)',
  }}
  projectionPathGroupConfig={{
    yAxis: true,
    xAxis: true,
    hoverLine: true,
    hoverLineConfig: {
      lineIndicator: true,
      dataBadgeFloatingGroup: true,
      formatHoverBadgeValue: (value) => `£${value.toFixed(1)}M`,
    },
    snapToData: true,
    curveStyle: 'Curved',
    yAxisConfig: { tickCount: 5 },
  }}
  chartFooterConfig={{
    annotationLeftValue: 'Source: Finance Team',
    annotationRightValue: 'Updated quarterly',
  }}
  onHover={(data) => console.log(data)}
/>
```

### Full Width

```tsx
<ProjectionLineChart
  data={data}
  fullWidth
  height={300}
  chartHeaderConfig={{ chartTitleValue: 'Full Width Chart' }}
/>
```

### Forecast Mode

In forecast mode, actual data points are rendered as a solid line and projected points as a dashed line. The HoverLine auto-positions at the actual→projected boundary on mount.

```tsx
const forecastData: ProjectionDataPoint[] = [
  { category: 'Jan', value: 100 },
  { category: 'Feb', value: 120 },
  { category: 'Mar', value: 115 },
  { category: 'Apr', value: 130 },
  { category: 'May', value: 145, projected: true },
  { category: 'Jun', value: 160, projected: true },
];

<ProjectionLineChart
  data={forecastData}
  chartHeaderConfig={{
    chartTitleValue: 'Revenue Forecast',
    chartSubtitleValue: 'Actual vs projected revenue',
  }}
  chartLegendConfig={{
    actualLabel: 'Revenue',
    forecastLabel: 'Projected',
  }}
  projectionPathGroupConfig={{
    projectionMode: 'forecast',
    snapToData: true,
  }}
/>
```

### With Entry Animation

When `animated` is `true`, paths and the confidence band reveal with a left-to-right clip-path animation on first load. Data changes morph the paths smoothly via `requestAnimationFrame`.

```tsx
<ProjectionLineChart
  data={data}
  animated
  chartHeaderConfig={{ chartTitleValue: 'Animated Projection' }}
/>
```

### With Date Categories

When `category` values are `Date` objects, XAxis and DataDisplay auto-format them via `formatCategoryLabel()`.

```tsx
<ProjectionLineChart
  data={[
    { category: new Date(2020, 0), value: 12, lowerBound: 10, upperBound: 14 },
    { category: new Date(2025, 0), value: 28, lowerBound: 23, upperBound: 33 },
    { category: new Date(2030, 0), value: 57, lowerBound: 40, upperBound: 74, projected: true },
  ]}
  chartHeaderConfig={{ chartTitleValue: 'Growth Projection 2020–2030' }}
  projectionPathGroupConfig={{
    projectionMode: 'confidence',
    xAxisConfig: { tickCount: 5 },
  }}
/>
```

### With Custom Legend Items

Legend item colors must be CSS custom property strings — never hex literals — so they respond to brand switches.

```tsx
<ProjectionLineChart
  data={data}
  chartLegendConfig={{
    items: [
      { categoryLabelValue: 'Base case', color: 'var(--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-1)', type: 'line' },
      { categoryLabelValue: 'Uncertainty range', color: 'var(--DataVis-Categorical-Subtle-1)', type: 'circle' },
      { categoryLabelValue: 'Historical', color: 'var(--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-2)', type: 'dashed' },
    ],
  }}
/>
```

### With DataDisplay (Static Mode)

```tsx
<ProjectionLineChart
  data={data}
  dataDisplay
  chartHeaderConfig={{ chartTitleValue: 'Revenue Projection' }}
  dataDisplayConfig={{
    mode: 'static',
    mainLabelValue: 'Projected total',
    dataHead: {
      dataLeadValue: '£2,390M',
      dataSupportingValue: '/ 3,000',
      supportingData: true,
    },
    badgeConfig: { value: '+23.5%' },
  }}
/>
```

### With DataDisplay (Hover Mode)

DataDisplay updates dynamically when hovering over the projection line. `mainLabelValue` shows the hovered category formatted via `formatCategoryLabel` by default (or your custom `formatHoverMainLabel`).

```tsx
<ProjectionLineChart
  data={confidenceData}
  dataDisplay
  dataDisplayConfig={{
    mode: 'hover',
    mainLabelValue: 'Hover to see values',
    dataHead: { dataLeadValue: '—' },
    badgeConfig: { value: '—' },
    formatHoverLeadValue: (value) => value.toFixed(1),
    formatHoverBadgeValue: (value, _category, bounds) => {
      if (bounds?.upper !== undefined && bounds.lower !== undefined) {
        return `±${((bounds.upper - bounds.lower) / 2).toFixed(1)}`;
      }
      return `${Math.round(value)}`;
    },
  }}
  projectionPathGroupConfig={{
    projectionMode: 'confidence',
    hoverLine: true,
    hoverLineConfig: { lineIndicator: true, dataBadgeFloatingGroup: false },
  }}
/>
```

### With Custom Main Label Format on Hover

Override the default `formatCategoryLabel` with your own format string:

```tsx
<ProjectionLineChart
  data={monthlyData}
  dataDisplay
  dataDisplayConfig={{
    mode: 'hover',
    mainLabelValue: 'Select a point',
    dataHead: { dataLeadValue: '—' },
    // Show "Jun 2024" instead of the year-only default for monthly dates
    formatHoverMainLabel: (category) =>
      category instanceof Date
        ? category.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'short', year: 'numeric' })
        : String(category),
    formatHoverLeadValue: (value) => `£${value.toLocaleString()}`,
  }}
/>
```

### With Y-Axis Value Formatting

```tsx
// Percentage format
<ProjectionLineChart
  data={percentageData}
  projectionPathGroupConfig={{
    yAxisConfig: { valueFormat: { type: 'percentage' } },
  }}
/>

// Currency format
<ProjectionLineChart
  data={currencyData}
  projectionPathGroupConfig={{
    yAxisConfig: {
      valueFormat: { type: 'currency', currency: 'INR', abbreviate: true },
    },
  }}
/>
```

### With Hover Callback

```tsx
const [hoverData, setHoverData] = useState<ProjectionHoverData | null>(null);

<ProjectionLineChart data={data} onHover={setHoverData} />;

{hoverData && (
  <div>
    Category: {String(hoverData.category)}
    Value: {hoverData.value.toFixed(2)}
    {hoverData.upperBound && `Upper: ${hoverData.upperBound}`}
    {hoverData.lowerBound && `Lower: ${hoverData.lowerBound}`}
  </div>
)}
```

### With Data Sorting

```tsx
<ProjectionLineChart
  data={data}
  projectionPathGroupConfig={{ dataSort: 'asc' }}
/>
```

### With Top Hover Data Label

```tsx
<ProjectionLineChart
  data={data}
  projectionPathGroupConfig={{
    hoverLine: true,
    hoverLineConfig: {
      topHoverDataLabel: true,
      formatTopHoverDataLabel: (category) => `Quarter: ${String(category)}`,
    },
    snapToData: true,
  }}
/>
```

## Design Tokens

All values come from the CSS cascade. No hard-coded pixels or hex colors in the component.

| Property      | Token                                                       | Source              |
| ------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------- |
| Container gap | `--ProjectionLineChart-gap` → `--Spacing-5`                 | OneUI system tokens |
| Line color    | `var(--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-1)`                         | generateDataVisCSS  |
| Band color    | `var(--DataVis-Categorical-Subtle-1)`                       | generateDataVisCSS  |

## Legend Auto-Generation

When `chartLegend={true}` and no manual `items` are provided, legend items are auto-generated from the active `projectionMode`:

- **Confidence mode** (default): Solid line key (`projectionLabel`, default `"Projection"`) + circle key (`projectionBandLabel`, default `"Confidence interval"`) when data has `upperBound`/`lowerBound` values.
- **Forecast mode**: Solid line key (`actualLabel`, default `"Actual"`) + dashed line key (`forecastLabel`, default `"Forecast"`).

## Height Behavior

The `height` prop controls the **total height** of the ProjectionLineChart container. ProjectionPathGroup stretches to fill the remaining vertical space after header, legend, DataDisplay, and footer are rendered.

```
┌───────────────────────────────────────┐
│  ChartHeader (title + subtitle)       │  ← Auto height
├───────────────────────────────────────┤
│  ChartLegend (optional)               │  ← Auto height
├───────────────────────────────────────┤
│  DataDisplay (optional)               │  ← Auto height
├───────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                       │
│       ProjectionPathGroup             │  ← flex: 1 (fills remaining)
│   (YAxis + Line + Area + XAxis)       │
│                                       │
├───────────────────────────────────────┤
│  ChartFooter (source + notes)         │  ← Auto height
└───────────────────────────────────────┘
        Total height: `height` prop
```

## DataDisplay Hover Mode

When `dataDisplayConfig.mode = 'hover'`, three values update dynamically as the line is hovered:

| Field            | Default behaviour                                   | Override via                      |
| ---------------- | --------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------- |
| `mainLabelValue` | `formatCategoryLabel(category)` — year for Jan-1 dates | `formatHoverMainLabel`        |
| `dataLeadValue`  | `value.toLocaleString()`                            | `formatHoverLeadValue`            |
| `badgeConfig.value` | `±half-range` (confidence) or `% of total` (forecast) | `formatHoverBadgeValue`    |

The static `mainLabelValue` from props is used as a fallback when no data point is hovered yet.

## Accessibility

Wrapped by `ChartAccessibility` (enabled by default). Provides `role="figure"`, ARIA attributes, auto-generated summaries, a hidden data table, and an `aria-live` region for hover announcements.

### ARIA Live Region

Announces hovered data points to screen readers:

- **Without bounds**: `"Q3, 22"`
- **With bounds**: `"Q3, 22, range 15 to 30"`
- **Projected point**: `"May, 145, projected"`

### DataDisplay aria-controls Wiring

When `dataDisplay={true}`, a stable `dataDisplayId` from `useChartAccessibility` links each focusable data point to the DataDisplay region via `aria-controls`.

### Keyboard Navigation

Handled by `ProjectionPathGroup` via `useRovingTabIndex`. See [ProjectionPathGroup.md](./ProjectionPathGroup.md).

### Decorative Elements

All decorative elements (axes, SVG paths, HoverLine) are `aria-hidden="true"`. Their data is conveyed through the hidden table and ARIA live announcements.

## Child Components

| Component             | Description                                         |
| --------------------- | --------------------------------------------------- |
| `ChartHeader`         | Title and subtitle                                  |
| `ChartLegend`         | Legend with auto-generated or manual keys           |
| `DataDisplay`         | Optional KPI block above the chart                  |
| `ProjectionPathGroup` | YAxis, projection area, main line, HoverLine, XAxis |
| `ChartFooter`         | Source and notes                                    |

## Related Documentation

- [ProjectionPathGroup.md](./ProjectionPathGroup.md) — Path group component
- [ChartHeader.md](./ChartHeader.md) — Header component
- [ChartFooter.md](./ChartFooter.md) — Footer component
- [ChartLegend.md](./ChartLegend.md) — Legend component
- [DataDisplay.md](./DataDisplay.md) — DataDisplay component

## Files

| File                                                                            | Description                   |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------- |
| `packages/datavis/src/components/charts/ProjectionLineChart/ProjectionLineChart.tsx` | Main component implementation |
| `packages/datavis/src/components/charts/ProjectionLineChart/ProjectionLineChart.module.css` | Structural layout tokens |
| `packages/datavis/src/components/charts/ProjectionLineChart/index.ts` | Public exports |
| `packages/datavis/src/components/charts/ProjectionLineChart/ProjectionLineChart.stories.tsx` | Storybook stories |
| `packages/datavis/src/components/charts/ProjectionLineChart/ProjectionLineChart.test.tsx` | Unit tests |

title: RadarChart
text:
RadarChart
Full-layout radar/spider chart composing **ChartHeader**, **ChartLegend**, standalone **DataDisplay**, **RadarGroup** D3 visualisation, and **ChartFooter** into a single accessible component.
@jds4/oneui-datavis
@jds4/oneui-datavis/components/charts/RadarChart
# RadarChart

Full-layout radar/spider chart composing **ChartHeader**, **ChartLegend**, standalone **DataDisplay**, **RadarGroup** D3 visualisation, and **ChartFooter** into a single accessible component.

Accepts single-series `ChartDataPoint[]` or multi-series `ChartSeriesDataPoint[]` (up to 4 series). Series colors resolve from `var(--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-{n})` tokens emitted by `generateDataVisCSS → useStyleInjection`. No hard-coded visual values; no `modes` prop.

---

## Import

```tsx
import { RadarChart } from '@oneui/datavis';
// Types (tree-shaken, zero bundle cost)
import type {
  RadarChartProps,
  RadarGroupConfig,
  RadarChartDataDisplayConfig,
  RadarSeries,
  RadarPointHoverData,
  RadarHoverType,
  RadarYAxisConfig,
  ChartLegendItem,
  ChartDataPoint,
  ChartSeriesDataPoint,
} from '@oneui/datavis';
```

---

## Props

### Layer 2 — Chart-level

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `data` | `ChartDataPoint[] \| ChartSeriesDataPoint[]` | `[]` | Chart data — flat (single-series) or canonical (multi-series) format. |
| `seriesOrder` | `string[]` | auto | Explicit ordering of series names for legend and render order. |
| `width` | `number \| string` | `420` | Container width. Overridden by `fullWidth`. |
| `height` | `number \| string` | `'auto'` | Container height. When set, `RadarGroup` fills remaining space. |
| `fullWidth` | `boolean` | `false` | Stretch container to `100%` of the parent. Overrides `width`. |
| `chartHeader` | `boolean` | `true` | Show the ChartHeader (title + subtitle). |
| `chartFooter` | `boolean` | `true` | Show the ChartFooter (source / note annotations). |
| `chartLegend` | `boolean` | `false` | Show the categorical legend. |
| `dataDisplay` | `boolean` | `false` | Show a standalone DataDisplay above the radar. |
| `animated` | `boolean` | `false` | Animate radar paths on mount via `useEntryAnimation`. |

### Layer 3 — Child component configurations

| Prop | Type | Description |
|------|------|-------------|
| `chartHeaderConfig` | `ChartHeaderConfig` | `{ chartTitleValue, chartSubtitleValue, subtitle }` forwarded to ChartHeader. |
| `chartLegendConfig` | `ChartLegendConfig` | `{ items?, categoryLabelValue?, type? }` — manual items override auto-generation. |
| `dataDisplayConfig` | `Omit<DataDisplayProps, 'id'>` | Full DataDisplay API minus `id` (managed by `useChartAccessibility`). |
| `radarGroupConfig` | `RadarGroupConfig` | `{ gridLineNumber, maxValue, showAxisLabels, interactive, hoverType, hoverBadge, yAxis, yAxisConfig, valueFormat, onPointHover, curveStyle }` forwarded to RadarGroup. `valueFormat` also drives the hover ARIA live-text announcement. |
| `chartFooterConfig` | `ChartFooterConfig` | `{ annotationLeft, annotationLeftValue, annotationRight, annotationRightValue }` forwarded to ChartFooter. |

### Accessibility

| Prop | Type | Description |
|------|------|-------------|
| `accessibility` | `AccessibilityConfig` | `{ ariaLabel, summary, dataTable, enabled }` — wraps the chart in a `role="figure"` container with `aria-label`, a visually-hidden summary paragraph, and an optional hidden data table for screen readers. All fields are optional. |

Full `AccessibilityConfig` shape:

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|-------|------|---------|-------------|
| `ariaLabel` | `string` | auto (chart title) | Custom `aria-label` for the chart container. |
| `summary` | `string` | auto-generated | Overrides the auto-generated summary text read by screen readers. |
| `dataTable` | `boolean` | `true` | Render a visually-hidden data table for screen readers. |
| `enabled` | `boolean` | `true` | Master switch — set to `false` to disable all accessibility wrappers. |

---

## Design Tokens

All visual values are CSS custom properties resolved from the live cascade. No hard-coded values.

| Token | Sourced From | Description |
|-------|-------------|-------------|
| `--RadarChart-containerGap` | Component override hook | Per-instance gap between sub-components. Fallback: `--Spacing-5`. |
| `--Spacing-5` | `@layer base` system token | Default container gap (dimension scale derived, ≈ 20 px). |
| `--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-{1..n}` | `generateDataVisCSS → useStyleInjection → @layer brand :root` | Series path and legend colors. Resolved at paint time. |
| `--Label-S-FontSize`, `--Label-S-LineHeight` | `@layer brand` typography tokens | Axis and legend labels. |
| `--Stroke-XS`, `--Stroke-M` | `@layer base` system tokens | Grid line and axis line widths. |
| `--Neutral-Stroke-Low`, `--Neutral-Stroke-Medium` | `@layer brand` | Grid circle and spoke strokes. |
| `--Motion-Duration-L`, `--Motion-Easing-Entrance-Moderate` | `@layer base` motion tokens | Entry animation timing. |

---

## Data Formats

### Single-series (flat)

```tsx
const data: ChartDataPoint[] = [
  { category: 'Efficiency',  value: 85 },
  { category: 'Stability',   value: 60 },
  { category: 'Readiness',   value: 35 },
  { category: 'Reliability', value: 70 },
  { category: 'Agility',     value: 55 },
];
```

Internally wrapped as `[{ name: 'Series 1', data }]` before being passed to `RadarGroup`.

### Multi-series (canonical)

```tsx
const data: ChartSeriesDataPoint[] = [
  { category: 'Efficiency',  series: 'Team A', value: 85 },
  { category: 'Stability',   series: 'Team A', value: 60 },
  // … more Team A points …
  { category: 'Efficiency',  series: 'Team B', value: 70 },
  // … more Team B points …
];
```

Series are extracted in discovery order unless `seriesOrder` is supplied.

---

## Usage Examples

### Minimal

```tsx
import { RadarChart } from '@oneui/datavis';

<RadarChart
  data={[
    { category: 'Efficiency',  value: 85 },
    { category: 'Stability',   value: 60 },
    { category: 'Readiness',   value: 35 },
    { category: 'Reliability', value: 70 },
    { category: 'Agility',     value: 55 },
  ]}
  chartHeaderConfig={{ chartTitleValue: 'Performance Overview' }}
/>
```

### Multi-series with legend

```tsx
<RadarChart
  data={multiSeriesData}
  chartHeader
  chartLegend
  chartHeaderConfig={{ chartTitleValue: 'Team Comparison' }}
  radarGroupConfig={{ gridLineNumber: 4, hoverType: 'categorical' }}
/>
```

### With standalone DataDisplay

```tsx
<RadarChart
  data={singleSeriesData}
  dataDisplay
  chartHeaderConfig={{ chartTitleValue: 'Performance' }}
  dataDisplayConfig={{
    mainLabelValue: 'Overall Score',
    dataHead: { dataLeadValue: '85' },
  }}
/>
```

### Full composition

```tsx
<RadarChart
  data={multiSeriesData}
  chartHeader
  chartLegend
  dataDisplay
  chartFooter
  chartHeaderConfig={{ chartTitleValue: 'Team Performance', subtitle: true }}
  chartLegendConfig={{ type: 'line' }}
  dataDisplayConfig={{ mainLabelValue: 'Avg', dataHead: { dataLeadValue: '72' } }}
  radarGroupConfig={{ gridLineNumber: 4, hoverType: 'individual', hoverBadge: true }}
  chartFooterConfig={{ annotationLeft: true, annotationLeftValue: 'Source: Jio.' }}
/>
```

### Full width

```tsx
<RadarChart
  data={multiSeriesData}
  fullWidth
  chartHeader
  chartHeaderConfig={{ chartTitleValue: 'Full Width Radar' }}
/>
```

### Animated

```tsx
<RadarChart
  data={singleSeriesData}
  animated
  chartHeader
  chartHeaderConfig={{ chartTitleValue: 'Animated Entry' }}
/>
```

Swap data between datasets to observe `useDataTransition` interpolation:

```tsx
const [dataset, setDataset] = useState<'a' | 'b'>('a');
const [key, setKey] = useState(0);

<RadarChart
  key={key}            // remount to replay entry animation
  data={dataset === 'a' ? dataA : dataB}
  animated
/>
```

### With accessibility config

```tsx
<RadarChart
  data={multiSeriesData}
  accessibility={{
    ariaLabel: 'Radar chart comparing Team A and Team B across five dimensions.',
    summary: 'Team A leads in Efficiency (85) and Reliability (70). Team B leads in Agility (90).',
    dataTable: true,   // default — renders a visually-hidden table for screen readers
  }}
/>
```

---

## Architecture

```
RadarChart
├── ChartAccessibility     — role="figure" + aria-label + live region
├── ChartHeader            — title + subtitle
├── ChartLegend            — categorical legend (auto-generated or manual)
├── DataDisplay            — standalone KPI display (optional)
├── div[data-name="radarWrapper"]
│   └── RadarGroup         — D3 radar / spider chart (paths, grid, labels, hover)
└── ChartFooter            — source / note annotations
```

### Token flow

```
generateDataVisCSS → useStyleInjection
  ↓ injected into :root at @layer brand
  --DataVis-Categorical-Bold-1 … N

useBrandCSSNew
  ↓ injected into :root / [data-surface] at @layer brand
  --Spacing-* / --Label-*-FontSize / --Stroke-* / --Motion-*
```

`RadarChart.module.css` handles only structural layout (`.container` gap). All visual values remain in the CSS cascade.

---

## Series Colors

`RadarChart` does not accept a `color` prop directly. Colors resolve from CSS variables at paint time:

```
Series 1 → var(--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-1)
Series 2 → var(--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-2)
…
Series N → var(--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-N)
```

Override per-instance:

```css
.myChart {
  --DataVis-Categorical-Bold-1: oklch(60% 0.18 250);
  --DataVis-Categorical-Bold-2: oklch(55% 0.22 30);
}
```

Per-point color override is possible via `ChartDataPoint.color` / `ChartSeriesDataPoint.color`. These are passed through to `RadarGroup` and used directly as the SVG `stroke` value.

---

## Hover Badge

When `radarGroupConfig.hoverBadge={true}`, the RadarGroup renders a floating `Badge` component on hover. The badge text shows either:

- **individual mode** — the numeric value at the hovered point
- **categorical mode** — the hovered series name

The badge uses **quadrant-aware positioning**: based on the cursor's position relative to the chart center, the badge translates to the opposite quadrant so it never overflows the chart boundary.

---

## Animations

### Entry animation (`animated={true}`)

Uses `useEntryAnimation` to phase-in each radar path via `pathLength` / `strokeDasharray` / `strokeDashoffset`. Timing tokens:

| Token | Usage |
|-------|-------|
| `--Motion-Duration-L` | Total animation duration per series |
| `--Motion-Easing-Entrance-Moderate` | Easing function for entry |

### Data transition

When the `series` array changes (dataset switch), `useDataTransition` interpolates between old and new values using a custom `requestAnimationFrame` loop before re-rendering.

---

## Extending the Container Gap

Override the gap between header, legend, DataDisplay, radar, and footer per-instance:

```css
/* Component-level override */
.mySpecialChart {
  --RadarChart-containerGap: var(--Spacing-7);
}
```

No class extension or prop drilling required — the CSS variable is consumed directly in `RadarChart.module.css`.

SankeyChart
`SankeyChart` is the top-level compound chart component that composes `ChartHeader`, `ChartLegend`, `DataDisplay`, `SankeyGroup`, and `ChartFooter` into a complete Sankey-flow visualization. All design tokens come from the CSS cascade — DataVis palette tokens (`--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-{n}`) via `generateDataVisCSS` → `useStyleInjection`, and surface/typography tokens via `useBrandCSSNew` — both injected at `@layer brand`. No runtime JS token resolver; no hardcoded dimensions, colours, typography, or spacing.
@jds4/oneui-datavis
@jds4/oneui-datavis/components/charts/SankeyChart
# SankeyChart

## Overview

`SankeyChart` is the top-level compound chart component that composes `ChartHeader`, `ChartLegend`, `DataDisplay`, `SankeyGroup`, and `ChartFooter` into a complete Sankey-flow visualization. All design tokens come from the CSS cascade — DataVis palette tokens (`--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-{n}`) via `generateDataVisCSS` → `useStyleInjection`, and surface/typography tokens via `useBrandCSSNew` — both injected at `@layer brand`. No runtime JS token resolver; no hardcoded dimensions, colours, typography, or spacing.

The chart accepts canonical `FlowDataPoint[]` where each row is `{source, target, value}` (legacy `ChartSeriesDataPoint[]` — `category`=source, `series`=target — is still accepted). Unique node names are derived automatically from the union of sources and targets — the default legend auto-generates one chip per node.

## Figma Reference

- **Node ID**: `967:125109`
- **Design File**: DataVis-Components
- **Figma URL**: https://www.figma.com/design/uA5ExvS0cNXbDEKzT9Rnrt/DataVis-Components?node-id=967-125109

## Architecture

```
SankeyChart
└── ChartAccessibility (role="figure", summary, hidden data table, aria-live region)
    └── div (flex column, gap = var(--SankeyChart-gap, var(--Spacing-5)))
        ├── ChartHeader (optional, default true) — ChartTitle + ChartSubtitle
        ├── ChartLegend (optional, default false) — one ChartKey per unique node
        ├── DataDisplay (optional, default false) — label + value + semantic badge
        │   • Static mode: values from dataDisplayConfig
        │   • Hover mode:  values update live on node/link hover
        ├── div (flex: 1, minHeight: 0) — SankeyGroup wrapper
        │   └── SankeyGroup
        │       • d3-sankey layout
        │       • top category labels (optional)
        │       • left/right DataHead columns (optional)
        │       • hover badge (optional)
        │       • own ChartAccessibility wrapper for the atomic group
        └── ChartFooter (optional, default true) — annotationLeft + annotationRight
```

## Import

```tsx
import SankeyChart from "./charts/SankeyChart";
import type {
  SankeyChartProps,
  SankeyGroupConfig,
  SankeyChartLegendConfig,
  SankeyDataDisplayConfig,
  SankeyNodeHoverData,
  SankeyLinkHoverData,
} from "./charts/SankeyChart";
```

## Data Format

```typescript
import type { FlowDataPoint } from "./types/chart-data";

const data: FlowDataPoint[] = [
  { id: "1", source: "Search", target: "Organic", value: 420 },
  { id: "2", source: "Search", target: "Paid", value: 180 },
  { id: "3", source: "Social", target: "Organic", value: 210 },
  { id: "4", source: "Social", target: "Paid", value: 140 },
  { id: "5", source: "Organic", target: "Signup", value: 380 },
  { id: "6", source: "Organic", target: "Bounce", value: 250 },
  { id: "7", source: "Paid", target: "Signup", value: 220 },
  { id: "8", source: "Paid", target: "Bounce", value: 100 },
];
```

Conventions:

- **`source`** — the source node name.
- **`target`** — the target node name.
- **`value`** — the flow magnitude (positive number).
- **`color`** _(optional)_ — per-edge link colour override; also inherited by the first encountered endpoint for legend fallback.
- Nodes appearing as both `source` and `target` are automatically placed into an intermediate stage by `d3-sankey`.

**Legacy format**: `ChartSeriesDataPoint[]` is still accepted — `category`=source, `series`=target, `value`=flow magnitude — for backward compatibility. New code should prefer `FlowDataPoint[]` above.

See `docs/DATA-FORMAT.md` for the full canonical data specification.

## Props Interface (Organized Props Pattern)

```typescript
interface SankeyChartProps {
  // Parent component props
  data: FlowDataPoint[] | ChartSeriesDataPoint[];
  width?: number | string; // default 432
  height?: number | string; // default 400
  fullWidth?: boolean; // default false — stretch to 100% width
  chartHeader?: boolean; // default true
  chartLegend?: boolean; // default false
  dataDisplay?: boolean; // default false
  chartFooter?: boolean; // default true
  interactive?: boolean; // default true
  animated?: boolean; // default false
  hoverBadge?: boolean; // default false

  // Child component configurations
  chartHeaderConfig?: ChartHeaderConfig;
  chartLegendConfig?: ChartLegendConfig;
  dataDisplayConfig?: DataDisplayConfig;
  sankeyGroupConfig?: SankeyGroupConfig; // bundles every SankeyGroup option
  chartFooterConfig?: ChartFooterConfig;

  // Accessibility
  accessibility?: AccessibilityConfig;
}
```

## Props

### Parent Component Props

| Prop          | Type                     | Default | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| ------------- | ------------------------ | ------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `data`        | `FlowDataPoint[] \| ChartSeriesDataPoint[]` | `[]`    | Canonical flow data (source/target/value); legacy `ChartSeriesDataPoint[]` (category/series/value) also accepted                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `width`       | `number \| string`       | `432`   | Total chart width                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `height`      | `number \| string`       | `400`   | Total chart height (Sankey fills the remaining space)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `fullWidth`   | `boolean`                | `false` | Fill 100% of container width                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `chartHeader` | `boolean`                | `true`  | Show `ChartHeader` (title + subtitle)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `chartLegend` | `boolean`                | `false` | Show `ChartLegend` (auto-generated from unique nodes)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `dataDisplay` | `boolean`                | `false` | Show `DataDisplay` above the sankey                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `chartFooter` | `boolean`                | `true`  | Show `ChartFooter` (source + notes)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `interactive` | `boolean`                | `true`  | Enable hover/click interactivity on nodes and links                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `animated`    | `boolean`                | `false` | Enable the token-driven motion layer. On mount: nodes fade in staggered by column/stage, connectors grow left-to-right via `stroke-dashoffset` staggered by source-node stage. Once the entry cascade settles, any subsequent change to `data` smoothly morphs existing nodes (`y`, `height`, `opacity`, `fill`) and connectors (`d`, `stroke-width`, `stroke`) via `transitionAnimation` tokens — **no stagger** on data changes. New nodes fade in + grow from zero height simultaneously. Left/right outside labels slide vertically (`top`) in lock-step with their node and fade in for new nodes, so they never snap to position. All timing resolves from the `11 Motion` token chain — no hardcoded values. See [SankeyGroup.md § Motion / Animation](./SankeyGroup.md#motion--animation). |
| `hoverBadge`  | `boolean`                | `false` | Enable cursor-following hover badge (requires `interactive`)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `valueFormat` | `ValueFormatConfig`      | `undefined` | Format config for flow values in the hover badge, DataDisplay hover values, keyboard aria-labels, and ARIA live text — used whenever the corresponding local formatter isn't explicitly supplied.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |

### ChartHeader Config (`chartHeaderConfig`)

| Prop                 | Type      | Default | Description                |
| -------------------- | --------- | ------- | -------------------------- |
| `chartTitleValue`    | `string`  | -       | Chart title text           |
| `chartSubtitleValue` | `string`  | -       | Chart subtitle text        |
| `subtitle`           | `boolean` | `true`  | Show/hide the subtitle row |

### ChartLegend Config (`chartLegendConfig`)

| Prop    | Type                | Default        | Description                                                      |
| ------- | ------------------- | -------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `items` | `ChartLegendItem[]` | auto-generated | Manual legend items; override auto-generation from unique nodes. |

Legend auto-generation:

1. If `items` are provided, they are used verbatim.
2. Otherwise one chip is generated per unique node name (union of `source` and `target`, or the legacy `category`/`series`) in first-appearance order.
3. Colour fallback: per-edge `color` (when present on the first occurrence of the node) → `var(--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-{i+1})` → undefined.

### DataDisplay Config (`dataDisplayConfig`)

See **[DataDisplay Integration](./DataDisplayIntegration.md)** for the full reference.

| Prop                    | Type                                                                       | Default    | Description                                                     |
| ----------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `mode`                  | `"static" \| "hover"`                                                      | `"static"` | Static uses provided values; hover updates on node/link hover   |
| `formatHoverLeadValue`  | `(hover: SankeyNodeHoverData \| SankeyLinkHoverData) => string`            | -          | Custom formatter for the main value in hover mode               |
| `formatHoverBadgeValue` | `(hover: SankeyNodeHoverData \| SankeyLinkHoverData, totalFlow) => string` | -          | Custom formatter for the badge value in hover mode              |
| `mainLabelValue`        | `string`                                                                   | -          | Main label above the data value                                 |
| `type`                  | `"Left" \| "Center"`                                                       | `"Left"`   | Layout variant                                                  |
| `dataHead`              | `DataHeadConfig`                                                           | -          | Full DataHead configuration (lead value, supporting data, etc.) |
| `badgeConfig`           | `BadgeConfig`                                                              | -          | Full badge configuration (value, etc.)                          |

Hover mode:

- When a **node** is hovered, `mainLabelValue` becomes the node name, `dataHead.dataLeadValue` the node flow value, and `badgeConfig.value` the node's percentage of total flow.
- When a **link** is hovered, `mainLabelValue` becomes `"source → target"`, `dataHead.dataLeadValue` the link value, and `badgeConfig.value` the link's percentage of total flow.
- Custom formatters receive the raw hover payload so consumers can render custom strings (e.g., currency with locale, % of sub-total, etc.).

### SankeyGroup Config (`sankeyGroupConfig`)

Bundles every SankeyGroup Layer-2 feature toggle and Layer-3 config. See **[SankeyGroup.md](./SankeyGroup.md)** for the full atomic reference.

| Prop                      | Type                        | Default   | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| ------------------------- | --------------------------- | --------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `topCategoryLabels`       | `boolean`                   | `false`   | Show one label per column/stage above the sankey                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `leftOutsideLabels`       | `boolean`                   | `false`   | Render a DataHead column to the left of the source stage                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `rightOutsideLabels`      | `boolean`                   | `false`   | Render a DataHead column to the right of the sink stage                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `interactive`             | `boolean`                   | inherited | Overrides the chart-level `interactive` flag                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `animated`                | `boolean`                   | inherited | Overrides the chart-level `animated` flag. Governs both the mount-time fade + grow entry cascade **and** the post-entry data-change morph (nodes `y/height/opacity/fill`, connectors `d/stroke-width/stroke`, outside-label wrappers `top/opacity`). New nodes on a data swap fade in + grow from zero height; their labels fade in alongside. Labels for existing nodes slide vertically to stay pinned to `n.y0` / centerY. |
| `hoverBadge`              | `boolean`                   | inherited | Overrides the chart-level `hoverBadge` flag                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `node`                    | `SankeyNodeConfig`          | -         | Node styling: `width`, `cornerRadius`, `nodeGap`, `colors`, `formatLabel`, `hitAreaWidth`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `link`                    | `SankeyLinkConfig`          | -         | Link styling: `opacity` (default `0.2`), `colorBy`, `curvature`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `leftOutsideLabelConfig`  | `SankeyOutsideLabelConfig`  | -         | Left DataHead column config (width, formatters, `labelAlignment`)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `rightOutsideLabelConfig` | `SankeyOutsideLabelConfig`  | -         | Right DataHead column config                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `topCategoryLabelConfig`  | `SankeyCategoryLabelConfig` | -         | Stage label array or resolver callback                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `hoverBadgeConfig`        | `SankeyHoverBadgeConfig`    | -         | Node and link hover-badge formatters                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `onNodeHover`             | `(data \| null) => void`    | -         | Fires on node hover; `null` on leave                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `onNodeClick`             | `(data) => void`            | -         | Fires on node click                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `onLinkHover`             | `(data \| null) => void`    | -         | Fires on link hover; `null` on leave                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `onLinkClick`             | `(data) => void`            | -         | Fires on link click                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `hoveredNodeId`           | `string \| null`            | -         | Controlled external hover target (node name)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |

### ChartFooter Config (`chartFooterConfig`)

| Prop                   | Type     | Default | Description                   |
| ---------------------- | -------- | ------- | ----------------------------- |
| `annotationLeftValue`  | `string` | -       | Left annotation text (source) |
| `annotationRightValue` | `string` | -       | Right annotation text (notes) |

### Accessibility Config (`accessibility`)

| Prop        | Type      | Default | Description                                                   |
| ----------- | --------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `enabled`   | `boolean` | `true`  | Enable the ChartAccessibility wrapper                         |
| `summary`   | `string`  | auto    | Custom summary override (otherwise auto-generated for sankey) |
| `dataTable` | `boolean` | `true`  | Hidden data table for screen readers                          |
| `ariaLabel` | `string`  | title   | Custom aria-label override                                    |


## Usage Examples

### Basic Chart

```tsx
<SankeyChart
  data={[
    { source: "A", target: "X", value: 120 },
    { source: "A", target: "Y", value: 30 },
    { source: "B", target: "X", value: 90 },
    { source: "B", target: "Y", value: 80 },
    { source: "C", target: "Y", value: 60 },
  ]}
  chartHeaderConfig={{
    chartTitleValue: "Flow Analysis",
    chartSubtitleValue: "Traffic distribution across channels.",
  }}
/>
```

### Full Configuration

```tsx
<SankeyChart
  data={data}
  width={720}
  height={480}
  chartHeader={true}
  chartLegend={true}
  dataDisplay={true}
  chartFooter={true}
  interactive={true}
  animated={true}
  hoverBadge={true}
  chartHeaderConfig={{
    chartTitleValue: "User Journey",
    chartSubtitleValue: "Source → destination flow.",
  }}
  dataDisplayConfig={{
    mode: "hover",
    mainLabelValue: "Hover a node or link",
    dataHead: { dataLeadValue: "-", supportingData: false },
    badgeConfig: { value: "-" },
  }}
  sankeyGroupConfig={{
    topCategoryLabels: true,
    leftOutsideLabels: true,
    rightOutsideLabels: true,
    topCategoryLabelConfig: { labels: ["Source", "Midpoint", "Destination"] },
    link: { opacity: 0.3, colorBy: "source" },
    node: { nodeGap: 16, cornerRadius: 4 },
    hoverBadgeConfig: {
      formatNodeValue: (v, n) => `${n}: ${v.toLocaleString()}`,
      formatLinkValue: (v, s, t) => `${s} → ${t}: ${v.toLocaleString()}`,
    },
    onNodeClick: (d) => console.log("Node clicked:", d.name),
    onLinkClick: (d) => console.log("Link clicked:", d.source, "→", d.target),
  }}
  chartFooterConfig={{
    annotationLeftValue: "Source: Analytics.",
    annotationRightValue: "FY 2025-26.",
  }}
  accessibility={{
    enabled: true,
    dataTable: true,
    ariaLabel: "User journey sankey chart",
  }}
/>
// `animated={true}` kicks off a fully token-driven entry animation:
//   • Nodes fade in, staggered by column (`delay = node.depth * offsetDelay`).
//   • Connectors grow left-to-right via `stroke-dashoffset`, staggered by
//     source-node stage so each link grows alongside its source column.
// Once the entry cascade settles, any subsequent change to the `data` prop
// smoothly morphs the chart — existing nodes tween `y`, `height`, `opacity`,
// `fill`; connectors tween their `d`, `stroke-width`, and `stroke`; and
// outside labels (left + right DataHead columns) slide their `top` value
// in sync with their node's `y0` / `centerY` and fade in when their node
// is new. New nodes fade in + grow from zero height at the same time.
// Data-change timing uses the `transitionAnimation` token chain with NO
// stagger (all elements morph in parallel) so the re-layout feels cohesive
// and nothing snaps into place. Hover dimming continues to run at hover-
// token speed throughout. All timing values resolve from CSS custom properties.
// See SankeyGroup.md § Motion / Animation.
```

### Full Width

```tsx
<SankeyChart data={data} fullWidth />
```

## Design Tokens Used

| Property       | CSS Custom Property                   | Fallback           | Purpose                                                           |
| -------------- | ------------------------------------- | ------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Chart gap      | `--SankeyChart-gap`                   | `var(--Spacing-5)` | Outer column gap (header → legend → DataDisplay → group → footer) |
| Legend colours | `--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-{1..5}` | —                  | Default node palette (fallback when `data[i].color` is absent)    |

> All design tokens come from the CSS cascade. DataVis palette tokens are injected via `generateDataVisCSS` → `useStyleInjection`, and surface/typography tokens via `useBrandCSSNew`, both at `@layer brand`.

## Flow Layout

Stages are inferred automatically by `d3-sankey` from the source/target topology:

- A node that only appears as a `source` (or legacy `category`) is a **source** (leftmost stage).
- A node that only appears as a `target` (or legacy `series`) is a **sink** (rightmost stage).
- A node appearing as both is an **intermediate** stage between its incoming and outgoing edges.

Stage count, node positions, and link curves are computed every render from `data`; no manual stage indices are required.

## Outside Labels

When `leftOutsideLabels` / `rightOutsideLabels` are enabled on `sankeyGroupConfig`, one `DataHead` is rendered per border-column node:

- **Left column** — one DataHead per source node, labels right-aligned so they abut the sankey node edge.
- **Right column** — one DataHead per sink node, labels left-aligned so they abut the sankey node edge.
- Column widths **auto-size** to the longest label in the column (measured via the Canvas API).
- Vertical anchor is controlled by `labelAlignment`: `"top"` (default, matches Figma spec — top edge aligns with the node's top edge) or `"center"` (vertically centered on the node band).

Customisation is available via `leftOutsideLabelConfig` and `rightOutsideLabelConfig`:

```tsx
sankeyGroupConfig={{
  leftOutsideLabels: true,
  leftOutsideLabelConfig: {
    size: "S",
    labelAlignment: "top",
    valueFormat: { type: "number", abbreviate: true },
    showSupportingLabel: true,
    supportingLabel: (name) => `Source: ${name}`,
  },
}}
```

## Top Category Labels

Enabling `topCategoryLabels` on `sankeyGroupConfig` renders one label per stage above the chart:

- **First stage** label is **left-aligned** to its column's leading edge (`x0`).
- **Last stage** label is **right-aligned** to its column's trailing edge (`x1`, via `translateX(-100%)`).
- **Middle stages** are **centered** on their column midpoint.

Override labels via `topCategoryLabelConfig`:

```tsx
sankeyGroupConfig={{
  topCategoryLabels: true,
  topCategoryLabelConfig: {
    labels: ["Source", "Midpoint", "Destination"],
    // or a resolver:
    // labels: (stageIndex, nodesInStage) => `Stage ${stageIndex + 1}`,
  },
}}
```

## Hover Interaction

With `interactive={true}` (the default), hovering a node or link:

1. Fires the relevant `onNodeHover` / `onLinkHover` callback with a typed payload.
2. Dims non-hovered links and keeps the hovered one at full opacity.
3. Emits an ARIA live-region announcement via `useChartAccessibility` (which composes `useAriaLiveRegion` internally) so screen-reader users hear the active node/link.
4. Optionally updates DataDisplay values (when `dataDisplayConfig.mode === "hover"`) so the KPI reflects the hovered element.
5. Optionally renders a cursor-following `HoverBadge` (when `hoverBadge={true}`).

### Hover Badge

```tsx
<SankeyChart
  data={data}
  interactive
  hoverBadge
  sankeyGroupConfig={{
    hoverBadgeConfig: {
      formatNodeValue: (value, name) => `${name}: ${value.toLocaleString()}`,
      formatLinkValue: (value, source, target) =>
        `${source} → ${target}: ${value.toLocaleString()}`,
    },
  }}
/>
```

The hover badge uses motion tokens for its enter/exit animation and inverts `colourMode` for visibility contrast.

## DataDisplay Hover Mode

With `dataDisplayConfig.mode: "hover"`, the DataDisplay block becomes live-updating:

- On **node hover** the DataDisplay shows the node name + its total flow through the sankey.
- On **link hover** it shows `source → target` + the link's flow value.
- The semantic badge reflects the percentage of total flow by default, or a custom value from `formatHoverBadgeValue(hover, totalFlow)`.

The DataDisplay is cross-linked to the SankeyGroup via `ariaControlsId` (DataDisplay's `id` is passed as SankeyGroup's `ariaControlsId`) so assistive tech treats the KPI and the chart as a unit.

## Responsiveness

- Numeric `width`/`height` are emitted as `px` values on the outer container.
- String values (`"100%"`, `"50vh"`, etc.) propagate through the `ChartAccessibility` wrapper via `containerStyle`, so percentage values can resolve through the DOM tree.
- When `fullWidth={true}`, the chart container is set to `width: 100%` and `SankeyGroup` is handed `fullWidth={true}` so its internal `ResizeObserver` drives the d3-sankey layout.
- The SankeyGroup is wrapped in a `flex: 1, minHeight: 0` div so it fills the chart's remaining vertical space regardless of how much room the header, legend, DataDisplay, and footer take.

## Accessibility

`SankeyChart` ships the full reusable ARIA accessibility stack out of the box. The chart-level wrapper is produced by `ChartAccessibility` with `chartType="sankey"`, driven by the `useChartAccessibility` hook, and the inner `SankeyGroup` is automatically opted out of its own wrapper (`accessibility={{ enabled: false }}`) to avoid a nested `role="figure"`.

### Reusable layers

| Layer                                       | Component / Hook                              | Enabled by                | Turn off by                                         |
| ------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- | ------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------- |
| `role="figure"` + `aria-label`              | `ChartAccessibility`                          | default                   | `accessibility.enabled: false`                      |
| Auto-generated natural-language summary     | `ChartAccessibility` (`chartType="sankey"`)   | default                   | `accessibility.summary: "custom string"` (override) |
| Hidden data table (rows = flow edges)       | `ChartAccessibility`                          | default                   | `accessibility.dataTable: false`                    |
| Debounced `aria-live` region on hover/focus | `useChartAccessibility` + `useAriaLiveRegion` | default                   | n/a — always on while the chart is interactive      |
| Custom `aria-label` override                | `ChartAccessibility`                          | `accessibility.ariaLabel` | omit the field                                      |
| Roving tab index across nodes               | `useRovingTabIndex` (inside `SankeyGroup`)    | `interactive: true`       | `interactive: false`                                |
| `aria-controls` linking Group → DataDisplay | `SankeyChart` wiring (`dataDisplayId`)        | `dataDisplay: true`       | `dataDisplay: false`                                |
| Decorative `aria-hidden` on SVG elements    | `SankeyGroup`                                 | always                    | n/a                                                 |

### Example screen-reader output

> _"sankey diagram titled 'Flow Analysis'. Shows flows between 5 nodes from 3 sources to 2 targets, totaling 380. Highest value: 120 at A (X)."_

And when the user arrow-keys onto a node:

> _"Oil, 60, stage 1"_

### Custom summary and hidden-table control

```tsx
<SankeyChart
  data={flowData}
  chartHeaderConfig={{ chartTitleValue: "Energy Flow" }}
  accessibility={{
    summary: "Q4 energy flow. Solar doubled year-over-year while coal fell 30%.",
    dataTable: false, // suppress the hidden <table> if you don't want SR row navigation
    ariaLabel: "Q4 energy flow sankey diagram",
  }}
/>
```

### Fully disable the wrapper

```tsx
<SankeyChart data={data} accessibility={{ enabled: false }} />
// The SankeyGroup's own wrapper is still opt'd out because the Chart always
// passes { enabled: false } downwards — so the tree renders with no role="figure".
```

### Why the delegation matters

`SankeyGroup` carries its own `<ChartAccessibility>` wrapper for **standalone use**. Inside `SankeyChart` the parent owns the wrapper, so the Chart automatically passes `accessibility={{ enabled: false }}` to the Group to avoid a nested `role="figure"`, duplicate hidden summary/table, and two `aria-live` regions racing on the same hover. You don't have to do anything — but if you compose `SankeyGroup` manually you should pass the same prop yourself.

See **[ChartAccessibility.md → Delegation Pattern](./ChartAccessibility.md)** and **[useChartAccessibility.md](./useChartAccessibility.md)** for the full a11y reference.

## Child Components

| Component     | Config Prop         | File                           | Description                        |
| ------------- | ------------------- | ------------------------------ | ---------------------------------- |
| `ChartHeader` | `chartHeaderConfig` | `./components/ChartHeader.tsx` | Title and subtitle                 |
| `ChartLegend` | `chartLegendConfig` | `./components/ChartLegend.tsx` | Legend with ChartKey items         |
| `DataDisplay` | `dataDisplayConfig` | `./components/DataDisplay.tsx` | KPI display (static or hover mode) |
| `SankeyGroup` | `sankeyGroupConfig` | `./components/SankeyGroup.tsx` | d3-sankey layout and interactions  |
| `ChartFooter` | `chartFooterConfig` | `./components/ChartFooter.tsx` | Source + notes annotations         |

## Performance Notes

- `detectedNodeInfo`, `resolvedLegendItems`, and `totalFlow` memoize off `data` to avoid re-deriving node topology each render.
- `SankeyGroup` memoizes the D3 layout off its own inputs; animated renders are throttled via motion tokens.
- All design tokens resolve via CSS custom properties — zero runtime JS token resolution overhead.

## Related Documentation

- [OrganizedPropsPattern.md](./OrganizedPropsPattern.md) — props pattern reference
- [SankeyGroup.md](./SankeyGroup.md) — atomic Sankey group (composition target)

- [useChartAccessibility.md](./useChartAccessibility.md) — reusable chart-level a11y hook

| File                                 | Description              |
| ------------------------------------ | ------------------------ |
| `src/charts/SankeyChart.tsx`         | Component implementation |
| `src/charts/SankeyChart.stories.tsx` | Storybook stories        |
